### Task 2: Mails and notices — Maria's inbox as the default Reply-To, `completionMail`, Maria's three summaries

Spec §6 (the student's mails, Maria's notices, the Reply-To) and decision D8. Rulings: none of R1–R6 applies; the Self-review's "Spec against the code" row 7 (U1) adds `hasPoints?` to `CompletionMailInput`. Nothing calls `completionMail` or the summaries yet: Tasks 4, 5, 7 and 10 do, after their commits (`later`), skipping sample addresses for the student's mail (Maria's notices go out for a sample student too).

**Four choices this task makes, and why.**
- **The Reply-To is decided in `sendMail`, once, for every mail** (spec D8: "covers all student mails, including login codes, payment confirmations and protocols"): a mail's own `replyTo` wins (Maria's notices name the student); otherwise `MARIA_EMAIL`, unless the mail goes to Maria herself. So the visitor's confirmation mail, which had no Reply-To, now has Maria's: two assertions of `tests/db/actions.test.ts` change with it (step 4).
- **No login code in these mails.** The button opens the page itself; she signs in there if she must (her session is usually alive: she has just submitted something). That keeps the mail one button and one link, and spends none of her three live logins.
- **One placeholder name.** The spec's subject "Palju õnne! Koolitus „{kursus}" on lõpetatud" / "Поздравляем! Обучение «{курс}» завершено" uses `{title}` in both dictionaries: `fill` and the i18n test know only `\{\w+\}` placeholders (a Cyrillic name is no placeholder), and `{title}` is the dictionaries' name for a course already. The Estonian closing quote is the dictionaries' `“` („…“), as in `mail.welcome.use`.
- **The count line.** The contract's draft `fixCount: "Parandada: {n} punkti"` would read "Parandada: 1 punkti"; the draft here, "Parandamist vajavaid punkte: {n}" / "Пунктов на исправление: {n}", puts the number last, which is right for every n in both languages. The key name is the plan's.

- [ ] **Step 6: `completionMail` and its links.** Append to `src/server/account-mail.ts` (after `protocolMail`; `boxRow` and the other helpers are defined above):

```ts
// ---------- the e-course completion's mails (phase e-course completion, spec §6) ----------

/** The e-course's page in the account: /konto/kursus/<slug> (the course in the path: an account page never has a query). */
export const ecourseUrl = (siteUrl: string, locale: Locale, slug: string): string =>
  `${siteUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}${href(locale, `/konto/kursus/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`)}`;

/** The e-course's knowledge test: /konto/kursus/<slug>/test. */
export const testUrl = (siteUrl: string, locale: Locale, slug: string): string => `${ecourseUrl(siteUrl, locale, slug)}/test`;

/** The e-course's practical work: /konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline (for a course without points: Maria's sent notes only). */
export const practicalUrl = (siteUrl: string, locale: Locale, slug: string): string => `${ecourseUrl(siteUrl, locale, slug)}/praktiline`;

export type CompletionMailKind =
  | "assessed" // Maria's assessment with "Paranda" points
  | "completed" // the course completed (any path)
  | "testPassed" // Maria accepted the open answers; practical work next
  | "testFix" // Maria asked to rewrite open answers
  | "reopened" // Maria reopened the test
  | "protocol" // a notes-only protocol of an e-course without points, first send
  | "protocolAgain"; // the same, sent again, or an approved assessment's notes re-sent

export type CompletionMailInput = {
  siteUrl: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  /** The account's language (clients.locale). */
  locale: Locale;
  slug: string;
  course: I18n;
  kind: CompletionMailKind;
  /** "assessed": how many points Maria marked "Paranda" (the box says it; absent or 0: no line). */
  fixCount?: number;
  /** "completed": the course has practical points, so the button opens the practical work (all "Kinnitatud"); else the e-course's page. */
  hasPoints?: boolean;
};

/**
 * The student's mails of the e-course completion (spec §6): the greeting, one line, the course in its box (an assessment adds how many points
 * to fix), and one button to the page it is about, written out under it. No login code: the button opens the page, and she signs in there if
 * she must. Never a note, an answer or a photo, only the link. The test's and practical work's links follow the kind (assessed,
 * protocol, protocolAgain and testPassed → the practical work; testFix and reopened → the test; completed → the practical work of a course with
 * points, else the e-course's page). Plain text and HTML; the caller never sends it to a sample address.
 */
export function completionMail(input: CompletionMailInput): Mail {
  const dict = getDict(input.locale);
  const m = dict.account.completionMail;
  const p = dict.account.protocolMail;
  const mail = dict.account.mail;
  const title = pick(input.course, input.locale);
  const practical = practicalUrl(input.siteUrl, input.locale, input.slug);
  const test = testUrl(input.siteUrl, input.locale, input.slug);
  const parts: Record<CompletionMailKind, { subject: string; lead: string; button: string; link: string }> = {
    assessed: { subject: m.assessedSubject, lead: m.assessedLead, button: m.assessedButton, link: practical },
    completed: {
      subject: oneLine(fill(m.completedSubject, { title })),
      lead: m.completedLead,
      button: m.completedButton,
      link: input.hasPoints ? practical : ecourseUrl(input.siteUrl, input.locale, input.slug),
    },
    testPassed: { subject: m.testPassedSubject, lead: m.testPassedLead, button: m.testPassedButton, link: practical },
    testFix: { subject: m.testFixSubject, lead: m.testFixLead, button: m.testFixButton, link: test },
    reopened: { subject: m.reopenedSubject, lead: m.reopenedLead, button: m.reopenedButton, link: test },
    protocol: { subject: p.subjectFirst, lead: p.leadFirst, button: p.button, link: practical },
    protocolAgain: { subject: p.subjectAgain, lead: p.leadAgain, button: p.button, link: practical },
  };
  const { subject, lead, button, link } = parts[input.kind];
  const greeting = hello(dict.account.dashboard, input.name);
  const lines = input.kind === "assessed" && input.fixCount ? [fill(m.fixCount, { n: input.fixCount })] : [];
  const text = [greeting, "", lead, "", title, ...lines, "", `${button}:`, link, "", mail.signature].join("\n");
  const html = mailCard(subject, input.locale, [
    greetingRow(greeting),
    paragraphRow(lead),
    boxRow(`<div style="font:600 18px/1.4 ${FONT};color:${INK};">${esc(title)}</div>` + lines.map((line) => `<div>${esc(line)}</div>`).join(""), 12),
    buttonRow(link, button),
    linkRow(link),
    signatureRow(mail),
  ]);
  return { to: input.email, subject, text, html };
}
```

```ts
// ---------- the e-course completion (spec §6: Maria's notices, each with a link to its item) ----------

/** Who and which e-course, for Maria's notices of this phase. `course` is the course's Estonian title. */
export type CompletionNotice = { accessId: number; name: string; email: string; course: string };

/** The rows every notice of this phase starts with: who, her address (the mail's Reply-To too), the course. */
const completionRows = (n: CompletionNotice): Row[] => [
  ["Õpilane", n.name],
  ["E-post", n.email],
  ["Koolitus", n.course],
];

/**
 * "Praktiline töö hindamiseks: {nimi}, {kursus}" (spec §6), with " (2. kord)" from the second submission on: the student sent her practical
 * work, or the points Maria asked her to redo. The link opens its assessment, the protocol screen of the access.
 */
export function practicalSubmittedSummary(n: CompletionNotice & { round: number }, adminUrl: string): Summary {
  const subject = `Praktiline töö hindamiseks: ${n.name}, ${n.course}${n.round > 1 ? ` (${n.round}. kord)` : ""}`;
  return { subject, text: body(subject, [...completionRows(n), ["Saadetud", `${n.round}. kord`]], `${adminUrl}/protokollid?ligipaas=${n.accessId}`), short: subject };
}

/** "Test ootab hindamist: {nimi}, {kursus}" (spec §6): an attempt passed its choice part and its open answers wait for Maria (or were rewritten). */
export function testReviewSummary(n: CompletionNotice & { attemptId: number; number: number }, adminUrl: string): Summary {
  const subject = `Test ootab hindamist: ${n.name}, ${n.course}`;
  return { subject, text: body(subject, [...completionRows(n), ["Katse", `${n.number}.`]], `${adminUrl}/hindamine/test?id=${n.attemptId}`), short: subject };
}

/** "Testi katsed otsas: {nimi}, {kursus}" (spec §6): every allowed try failed; "Ava test uuesti" in Hindamine gives her the course's tries again. */
export function triesUsedSummary(n: CompletionNotice & { tries: number }, adminUrl: string): Summary {
  const subject = `Testi katsed otsas: ${n.name}, ${n.course}`;
  return {
    subject,
    text: body(subject, [...completionRows(n), ["Katseid tehtud", String(n.tries)]], `${adminUrl}/hindamine`, "Uued katsed annab nupp „Ava test uuesti“ lehel Hindamine."),
    short: subject,
  };
}
```

### Task 3: The course editor — "Teadmiste test" (`course_tests`) and "Protokolli punktid" for e-courses

Spec §3.1 (the questions, their ids and limits, the pass mark, the tries), §5.1 (the two cards and their hints), §9 (unit: question and settings checks), ruling R1 (the test is a row of `course_tests`, never a column of `courses`: the public reads take whole `courses` rows). The test saves with the course, behind the course's own version check (`courses.updated_at`), in the same transaction as the course row and its images. A contact course has no test (its row goes when the type changes to contact). An e-course's "Protokolli punktid" are now kept (its practical points), so the protocols phase's pin "an e-course keeps none" flips. The editor is Estonian only and simple for Maria's tablet: a card per question with a kind switch, the text, and for a choice question its options with "Õige".

```ts
describe("saveCourseForm: 'Teadmiste test' and the e-course's points (e-course completion, spec §3.1, §5.1, R1)", () => {
  const qid = (n: number) => `q${String(n).padStart(7, "0")}`;
  const oid = (n: number, j: number) => `o${String(n * 10 + j).padStart(7, "0")}`;
  const choice = (n: number, text: string, options: [string, boolean][]): TestQuestion => ({
    id: qid(n),
    kind: "choice",
    text,
    options: options.map(([t, correct], j) => ({ id: oid(n, j), text: t, correct })),
  });
  const open = (n: number, text: string): TestQuestion => ({ id: qid(n), kind: "open", text });
  const storedTest = async (id: number) => (await db.select().from(courseTests).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, id)))[0] ?? null;
  /** The e-course's draft as stored, with `test` changed (and `over` on top). */
  const withTest = async (test: Partial<CourseDraft["test"]>, over: Partial<CourseDraft> = {}) => {
    const d = await load(online.id);
    return save({ ...d, ...over, test: { ...d.test, ...test } });
```

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { act, createElement, useState } from "react";
import { createRoot, type Root } from "react-dom/client";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { TestEditor, type TestErrors } from "@/components/admin/TestEditor";
import type { TestQuestion } from "@/db/schema";
import { emptyTestDraft, type TestDraft } from "@/domain/course-editor";

// "Teadmiste test" in the course editor (e-course completion, spec §5.1): the pass mark and the tries as typed, a card per question with its kind,
// its text and (a choice question) 2–6 options each with "Õige"; add, move and remove with the focus kept; the save's refusal shown in the card
// of the question it names (and on its option), or under the list.

declare global {
  var IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT: boolean;
}
globalThis.IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true;

let container: HTMLDivElement;
let root: Root;
let current: TestDraft;
let mounts = 0;
function Harness({ initial, errors }: { initial: TestDraft; errors: TestErrors }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial);
  current = value;
  return createElement(TestEditor, { value, onChange: setValue, errors });
}
// a new key each time: a new editor, as the course editor's reload gives one
const render = async (initial: TestDraft, errors: TestErrors = {}) => act(async () => root.render(createElement(Harness, { key: ++mounts, initial, errors })));
const $ = <T extends Element = HTMLElement>(selector: string) => container.querySelector<T>(selector);
const $$ = (selector: string) => [...container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector)];
const click = async (el: Element | null) => act(async () => (el as HTMLElement).click());
const type = async (el: Element | null, value: string) =>
  act(async () => {
    const field = el as HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement;
    const proto = field instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : HTMLInputElement.prototype;
    Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, "value")!.set!.call(field, value);
    field.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
const choice = (id: string, text: string, options: [string, boolean][]): TestQuestion => ({
  id,
  kind: "choice",
  text,
  options: options.map(([t, correct], j) => ({ id: `o${id.slice(1, 7)}${j}`, text: t, correct })),
});
const draft = (questions: TestQuestion[]): TestDraft => ({ ...emptyTestDraft(), questions });

beforeEach(() => {
  container = document.createElement("div");
  document.body.append(container);
  root = createRoot(container);
});
afterEach(async () => {
  await act(async () => root.unmount());
  container.remove();
});

test("'Lisa küsimus' adds a choice question with two options, its text takes the focus; the text, the options and 'Õige' go into the draft", async () => {
  await render(emptyTestDraft());
  const editor = $("[data-test-editor]")!;
  expect(editor.querySelector("h3")!.textContent).toBe("Teadmiste test");
  expect(editor.textContent).toContain("Muudatused kehtivad uutele katsetele; tehtud katsed jäävad nii, nagu need esitati.");
  expect(editor.textContent).toContain("Küsimusi veel pole");
  await click($("[data-question-add]"));
  expect($$("[data-question]")).toHaveLength(1);
  const text = $<HTMLTextAreaElement>('[data-question="0"] [data-question-text]')!;
  expect(document.activeElement).toBe(text);
  expect(container.querySelector(`label[for="${text.id}"]`)!.textContent).toBe("Küsimus 1");
  const [q] = current.questions;
  expect(q).toMatchObject({ kind: "choice", text: "", options: [{ text: "", correct: false }, { text: "", correct: false }] });
  if (q.kind !== "choice") throw new Error("a new question is a choice question");
  const ids = [q.id, ...q.options.map((o) => o.id)];
  expect(ids.every((id) => /^[0-9a-z]{8}$/.test(id))).toBe(true);
  expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(3);
  await type(text, "Mitu kihti värvi kanname?");
  await type($('[data-question="0"] [data-option="0"] [data-option-text]'), "Ühe");
  await type($('[data-question="0"] [data-option="1"] [data-option-text]'), "Kaks");
  await click($('[data-question="0"] [data-option="1"] [data-option-correct]'));
  expect(current.questions).toEqual([
    { id: q.id, kind: "choice", text: "Mitu kihti värvi kanname?", options: [{ id: q.options[0].id, text: "Ühe", correct: false }, { id: q.options[1].id, text: "Kaks", correct: true }] },
  ]);
  expect(text.maxLength).toBe(500);
  expect($<HTMLInputElement>('[data-question="0"] [data-option="0"] [data-option-text]')!.maxLength).toBe(200);
});

test("a choice question has 2–6 options: × is off at two, '+ Lisa vastusevariant' is off at six; a new option's field takes the focus", async () => {
  await render(draft([choice("q0000001", "Mis?", [["A", true], ["B", false]])]));
  const card = () => $('[data-question="0"]')!;
  const options = () => card().querySelectorAll("[data-option]");
  expect(card().querySelector("[data-option-remove]")!.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
  await click(card().querySelector("[data-option-remove]"));
  expect(options()).toHaveLength(2);
  await click(card().querySelector("[data-option-add]"));
  expect(options()).toHaveLength(3);
  expect(document.activeElement).toBe(card().querySelector('[data-option="2"] [data-option-text]'));
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) await click(card().querySelector("[data-option-add]"));
  expect(options()).toHaveLength(6);
  expect(card().querySelector("[data-option-add]")!.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
  await click(card().querySelector("[data-option-add]"));
  expect(options()).toHaveLength(6);
  const before = current.questions[0];
  if (before.kind !== "choice") throw new Error("a choice question");
  await click(card().querySelector('[data-option="1"] [data-option-remove]'));
  const after = current.questions[0];
  expect(after.kind === "choice" ? after.options.map((o) => o.id) : []).toEqual([before.options[0].id, ...before.options.slice(2).map((o) => o.id)]);
});

test("'Vaba vastusega' has no options and says how it is assessed; back to 'Valikvastustega' brings the options back", async () => {
  const q = choice("q0000001", "Mis kuulub ettevalmistusse?", [["Puhastamine", true], ["Värvimine", false], ["Kuju määramine", true]]);
  await render(draft([q]));
  expect($<HTMLInputElement>('[data-question="0"] [data-question-kind="choice"]')!.checked).toBe(true);
  await click($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-kind="open"]'));
  expect(current.questions).toEqual([{ id: "q0000001", kind: "open", text: "Mis kuulub ettevalmistusse?" }]);
  expect($$('[data-question="0"] [data-option]')).toHaveLength(0);
  expect($('[data-question="0"]')!.textContent).toContain("Õpilane kirjutab vastuse ise");
  await click($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-kind="choice"]'));
  expect(current.questions).toEqual([q]);
});

test("questions move ↑ / ↓ (off at the ends) and go with ×, the focus kept; at 50 'Lisa küsimus' adds nothing and says so", async () => {
  const a = choice("q0000001", "Esimene", [["A", true], ["B", false]]);
  const b: TestQuestion = { id: "q0000002", kind: "open", text: "Teine" };
  await render(draft([a, b]));
  expect($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-up]')!.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
  expect($('[data-question="1"] [data-question-down]')!.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
  expect($('[data-question="1"] [data-question-up]')!.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Liiguta küsimus 2 üles");
  await click($('[data-question="1"] [data-question-up]'));
  expect(current.questions.map((q) => q.id)).toEqual(["q0000002", "q0000001"]);
  expect($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-remove]')!.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Eemalda küsimus 1");
  await click($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-remove]'));
  expect(current.questions.map((q) => q.id)).toEqual(["q0000001"]);
  expect(document.activeElement).toBe($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-text]'));
  await click($('[data-question="0"] [data-question-remove]'));
  expect(current.questions).toEqual([]);
  expect(document.activeElement).toBe($("[data-question-add]"));

  await render(draft(Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i): TestQuestion => ({ id: `q${String(i + 1).padStart(7, "0")}`, kind: "open", text: `Küsimus ${i + 1}` }))));
  const add = $("[data-question-add]")!;
  expect(add.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
  await click(add);
  expect(current.questions).toHaveLength(50);
  expect($("[data-test-editor]")!.textContent).toContain("Rohkem kui 50 küsimust ei saa lisada.");
});

test("the pass mark and the tries are typed into the draft as text; their refusals are marked on the field", async () => {
  await render(emptyTestDraft());
  expect($<HTMLInputElement>("[data-test-pass]")!.value).toBe("80");
  expect($<HTMLInputElement>("[data-test-tries]")!.value).toBe("3");
  await type($("[data-test-pass]"), "90");
  await type($("[data-test-tries]"), "2");
  expect(current).toMatchObject({ passPercent: "90", tries: "2" });
  await render(emptyTestDraft(), { testPassPercent: "Sisesta täisarv.", testTries: "Sisesta täisarv." });
  for (const selector of ["[data-test-pass]", "[data-test-tries]"]) {
    const input = $(selector)!;
    expect(input.getAttribute("aria-invalid")).toBe("true");
    const errorId = input.getAttribute("aria-describedby")!.split(" ")[1];
    expect(document.getElementById(errorId)!.textContent).toBe("Sisesta täisarv.");
  }
});

test("the save's refusal is shown where it is: in the question's card (its option marked), or under the list", async () => {
  const qs = [choice("q0000001", "Esimene", [["A", true], ["B", false]]), choice("q0000002", "Teine", [["A", false], ["B", false]])];
  await render(draft(qs), { test: "Märgi vähemalt üks vastus õigeks.", at: { index: 1 } });
  expect($('[data-question="1"]')!.hasAttribute("data-invalid")).toBe(true);
  expect($('[data-question="1"]')!.textContent).toContain("Märgi vähemalt üks vastus õigeks.");
  expect($('[data-question="0"]')!.hasAttribute("data-invalid")).toBe(false);
  expect($("[data-test-editor]")!.hasAttribute("data-invalid")).toBe(false);

  await render(draft(qs), { test: "Täida küsimuse tekst ja iga vastusevariant.", at: { index: 0, option: 1 } });
  expect($('[data-question="0"] [data-option="1"] [data-option-text]')!.getAttribute("aria-invalid")).toBe("true");
  expect($('[data-question="0"] [data-option="0"] [data-option-text]')!.hasAttribute("aria-invalid")).toBe(false);

  await render(draft(qs), { test: "Testis saab olla kuni 50 küsimust.", at: { index: -1 } });
  expect($("[data-test-editor]")!.hasAttribute("data-invalid")).toBe(true);
  expect($$("[data-question][data-invalid]")).toHaveLength(0);
  expect($("[data-test-editor]")!.textContent).toContain("Testis saab olla kuni 50 küsimust.");
});
```

```ts
/** Where in a list a field's error is: the course editor's "Teadmiste test" names the question (0-based; -1: the list as a whole) and the option in it. */
export type FieldPlace = { index: number; option?: number };
```

  2. `EditResult` and `invalid` (lines 42–50) become:

```ts
/**
 * What a content form gets back. `fields`: the refused fields (with error "invalid"); `at`: where the error of a list field is (the course
 * editor's questions, FieldPlace). stale: the content was saved elsewhere since the editor loaded it (nothing saved). inUse: a session with
 * registrations cannot be deleted.
 */
export type EditResult =
  | { ok: true; id: number; created?: boolean; deleted?: boolean; saved?: SavedParts }
  | { ok: false; error: "invalid" | "notFound" | "stale" | "inUse" | "server"; fields?: Record<string, FieldError>; at?: FieldPlace };

export const invalid = (errors: Record<string, FieldError>, at?: FieldPlace): EditResult => ({ ok: false, error: "invalid", fields: errors, ...(at ? { at } : {}) });
```

```ts
/** The course editor's course: the course with its images and its "Teadmiste test" row (null without one; e-course completion, R1). */
export type EditCourse = AdminCourse & { test: CourseTest | null };

/** One course for the editor (drafts included), or null. */
export async function getCourseForEdit(db: Db, id: number): Promise<EditCourse | null> {
  const [course, [test]] = await Promise.all([
    db.query.courses.findFirst({ where: eq(courses.id, id), with: { images: { orderBy: imageOrder } } }),
    db.select().from(courseTests).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, id)).limit(1),
  ]);
  return course ? { ...course, test: test ?? null } : null;
}
```

  3. `CourseFields` (lines 107–108) becomes:

```ts
/** "Teadmiste test" as the editor saves it (e-course completion, R1): a row of its own, so the answer key never rides on a courses row. */
export type CourseTestFields = { questions: TestQuestion[]; passPercent: number; tries: number };
/** The course fields the editor writes (everything but id, sort and updatedAt), and the e-course's test (null: none, its row is deleted). */
export type CourseFields = Omit<CourseInput, "id" | "sort"> & { test: CourseTestFields | null };
```

  4. `saveCourseWithImages` (lines 110–148) becomes:

```ts
/**
 * The course editor's save: the course, its whole image list and its "Teadmiste test" row in ONE transaction.
 * - `id` null: a new course, placed after the others (sort = last + 1).
 * - `id` set: an update, refused as "stale" when `expected` (the updatedAt the editor loaded) is no longer the stored
 *   one — someone saved the course in another window meanwhile — so a save never overwrites changes it did not see.
 *   Compared to the millisecond, as JavaScript dates carry no microseconds.
 * - the test (e-course completion, R1): upserted into course_tests behind the same check, or its row deleted (a contact course).
 * `updatedAt` is set on every save. Returns the saved course with its images, "notFound" or "stale".
 */
export async function saveCourseWithImages(
  db: Db,
  target: { id: number | null; expected?: Date },
  fields: CourseFields,
  images: ImageInput[],
): Promise<AdminCourse | "notFound" | "stale"> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const { test, ...row } = fields;
    const values = { ...row, updatedAt: new Date() };
    let course: Course;
    if (target.id == null) {
      const [{ last }] = await tx.select({ last: sql<number | null>`max(${courses.sort})` }).from(courses);
      [course] = await tx.insert(courses).values({ ...values, sort: (last ?? 0) + 1 }).returning();
    } else {
      const same = target.expected ? sql`date_trunc('milliseconds', ${courses.updatedAt}) = ${target.expected.toISOString()}::timestamptz` : undefined;
      const [updated] = await tx.update(courses).set(values).where(and(eq(courses.id, target.id), same)).returning();
      if (!updated) {
        const [exists] = await tx.select({ id: courses.id }).from(courses).where(eq(courses.id, target.id));
        return exists ? "stale" : "notFound";
      }
      course = updated;
      await tx.delete(courseImages).where(eq(courseImages.courseId, course.id));
    }
    if (test)
      await tx
        .insert(courseTests)
        .values({ courseId: course.id, ...test, updatedAt: values.updatedAt })
        .onConflictDoUpdate({ target: courseTests.courseId, set: { ...test, updatedAt: values.updatedAt } });
    else await tx.delete(courseTests).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, course.id));
    const saved = images.length
      ? await tx
          .insert(courseImages)
          .values(images.map((img, i) => ({ courseId: course.id, key: img.key, alt: img.alt ?? null, sort: i })))
          .returning()
      : [];
    return { ...course, images: saved };
  });
}
```

```ts
/** The question list's problems (domain/completion.ts checkQuestions) as the field errors the editor shows under "Teadmiste test". */
const TEST_ERRORS: Record<Exclude<QuestionProblem["error"], "duplicateId">, FieldError> = {
  tooMany: "testTooMany",
  empty: "testEmpty",
  tooLong: "testTooLong",
  options: "testOptions",
  noCorrect: "testNoCorrect",
};

/** Where a question problem is, for the editor (EditResult.at): the question (-1: the list as a whole), and the option when it names one. */
const placeOf = (p: QuestionProblem): FieldPlace => ("option" in p && p.option !== undefined ? { index: p.index, option: p.option } : { index: p.index });
```

```ts
/**
 * The course editor's save. Field `data`: the editor's draft as JSON (CourseDraft). Only the chosen type's own fields
 * are stored; the other type's are emptied (a course is e-learning or contact, never both). "Protokolli punktid" are
 * both types': a contact course's protocol headings, an e-course's practical points. "Teadmiste test" is an e-course's
 * (course_tests, R1); a contact course's row is deleted. A new course (id null) is created after the others; an existing
 * one is refused as `stale` when it was saved elsewhere since `version`.
```

  5. The "Protokolli punktid" block (lines 105–110) becomes:

```ts
  // "Protokolli punktid": a contact course's headings (phase protocols), an e-course's practical points (e-course completion, spec §5.1); trimmed,
  // no blank rows, at most 30 of at most 120 characters. A pasted heading is cleaned first (toStorable: control characters and broken surrogates go):
  // Postgres refuses NUL in jsonb, and checkStages does not look; a heading is one line (its field is an input, which would drop a line break), so
  // Word's line or page break in it is a space between the words
  const heading = (s: string) => toStorable(s).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, " ");
  const stages = checkStages(d.protocolStages.map(heading));
  if (!stages.ok) c.fail("protocolStages", stages.error);
  // "Teadmiste test" (e-course completion, spec §3.1, §5.1, R1): an e-course's questions, pass mark and tries. A pasted question is cleaned as a
  // heading is; its text may keep its lines (a text box), an option is one line (an input). A problem names the question (and the option) it is
  // in, so the editor shows it there. The pass mark is 1–100 and the tries 1–10, whole numbers, never blank.
  let test: CourseFields["test"] = null;
  let testAt: FieldPlace | undefined;
  if (online) {
    const clean = (q: TestQuestion): TestQuestion =>
      q.kind === "open" ? { ...q, text: toStorable(q.text) } : { ...q, text: toStorable(q.text), options: q.options.map((o) => ({ ...o, text: heading(o.text) })) };
    const checked = checkQuestions(readQuestions(d.test.questions).map(clean));
    if (!checked.ok) {
      const { error } = checked.problem;
      if (error === "duplicateId") return { ok: false, error: "invalid" }; // never from the editor (newItemId): not a draft it made
      c.fail("test", TEST_ERRORS[error]);
      testAt = placeOf(checked.problem);
    }
    const passPercent = c.whole("testPassPercent", d.test.passPercent, PASS_RANGE.min, PASS_RANGE.max) ?? c.fail("testPassPercent", "whole");
    const tries = c.whole("testTries", d.test.tries, TRIES_RANGE.min, TRIES_RANGE.max) ?? c.fail("testTries", "whole");
    if (passPercent !== null && tries !== null) {
      const settings = checkSettings(passPercent, tries);
      if (!settings.ok) c.fail(settings.error === "pass" ? "testPassPercent" : "testTries", "whole");
      else if (checked.ok) test = { questions: checked.questions, passPercent, tries };
    }
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 9: The editor** — create `src/components/admin/TestEditor.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef } from "react";
import type { ChoiceOption, TestQuestion } from "@/db/schema";
import { newItemId, TEST_LIMITS } from "@/domain/completion";
import { moveItem, type TestDraft } from "@/domain/course-editor";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { Choice } from "./Choice";
import ui from "./ui.module.css";
import ed from "./editor.module.css";
import styles from "./TestEditor.module.css";

/** The save's refusals as the editor shows them: the three fields' texts, and where in the list the `test` one is (EditResult.at). */
export type TestErrors = { test?: string; testPassPercent?: string; testTries?: string; at?: { index: number; option?: number } };

const newOption = (): ChoiceOption => ({ id: newItemId(), text: "", correct: false });
/** A new question: a choice question with two empty options. */
const newQuestion = (): TestQuestion => ({ id: newItemId(), kind: "choice", text: "", options: [newOption(), newOption()] });

/** Where the focus goes after the next render: a question's text, an option's field, or "Lisa küsimus". */
type Focus = { question: number; option?: number } | "add" | null;

/**
 * "Teadmiste test" (e-course completion, spec §3.1, §5.1): an e-course's pass mark, tries and questions, saved with the course ("Salvesta").
 * A card per question: its kind ("Valikvastustega" / "Vaba vastusega"), its text, and for a choice question its 2–6 options, each with "Õige" (one
 * or more: more than one gives the student checkboxes); ↑ / ↓ / × as the other list editors (aria-disabled at the ends, the focus kept). Plain
 * text in the course's language, never translated. A question's and an option's id is made here (newItemId) and never reused: an attempt refers
 * to a question by its id. A choice question switched to "Vaba vastusega" keeps its options in memory, so switching back brings them back. The
 * save's refusal shows in the card of the question it names (its option marked), or under the list for the list as a whole.
 */
export function TestEditor({ value, onChange, errors }: { value: TestDraft; onChange: (v: TestDraft) => void; errors: TestErrors }) {
  const t = adminEt.courseEditor;
  const f = t.fields;
  const uid = useId();
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const addBtn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const focus = useRef<Focus>(null);
  const kept = useRef(new Map<string, ChoiceOption[]>());

  useEffect(() => {
    const target = focus.current;
    if (target === null) return;
    focus.current = null;
    if (target === "add") {
      addBtn.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    const card = root.current?.querySelector(`[data-question="${target.question}"]`);
    const field =
      target.option === undefined
        ? card?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-question-text]")
        : card?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-option="${target.option}"] [data-option-text]`);
    field?.focus();
  });

  const { questions } = value;
  const setQuestions = (list: TestQuestion[]) => onChange({ ...value, questions: list });
  const update = (i: number, q: TestQuestion) => setQuestions(questions.map((x, j) => (j === i ? q : x)));
  const full = questions.length >= TEST_LIMITS.questions;

  const add = () => {
    if (full) return;
    setQuestions([...questions, newQuestion()]);
    focus.current = { question: questions.length };
  };
  const remove = (i: number) => {
    setQuestions(questions.filter((_, j) => j !== i));
    focus.current = questions.length > 1 ? { question: Math.min(i, questions.length - 2) } : "add";
  };
  const move = (i: number, dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const j = i + dir;
    if (j < 0 || j >= questions.length) return;
    setQuestions(moveItem(questions, i, j));
  };
  const setKind = (i: number, kind: TestQuestion["kind"]) => {
    const q = questions[i];
    if (q.kind === kind) return;
    if (q.kind === "choice") {
      kept.current.set(q.id, q.options);
      update(i, { id: q.id, kind: "open", text: q.text });
    } else update(i, { id: q.id, kind: "choice", text: q.text, options: kept.current.get(q.id) ?? [newOption(), newOption()] });
  };
  const setOptions = (i: number, options: ChoiceOption[]) => {
    const q = questions[i];
    if (q.kind === "choice") update(i, { ...q, options });
  };
  const addOption = (i: number) => {
    const q = questions[i];
    if (q.kind !== "choice" || q.options.length >= TEST_LIMITS.maxOptions) return;
    setOptions(i, [...q.options, newOption()]);
    focus.current = { question: i, option: q.options.length };
  };
  const removeOption = (i: number, j: number) => {
    const q = questions[i];
    if (q.kind !== "choice" || q.options.length <= TEST_LIMITS.minOptions) return;
    setOptions(i, q.options.filter((_, k) => k !== j));
    focus.current = { question: i, option: Math.min(j, q.options.length - 2) };
  };

  // the save's refusal: in the card of the question it names, or for the list as a whole
  const at = errors.test ? errors.at : undefined;
  const listError = errors.test && (!at || at.index < 0 || at.index >= questions.length) ? errors.test : undefined;

  /** The pass mark or the tries: a short field of digits, as typed (the server parses it). */
  const setting = (key: "passPercent" | "tries", label: string, hint: string, error: string | undefined, maxLength: number) => {
    const id = `${uid}-${key}`;
    return (
      <div className={ui.field}>
        <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
        <input
          id={id}
          className={ui.input}
          type="text"
          inputMode="numeric"
          autoComplete="off"
          maxLength={maxLength}
          value={value[key]}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, [key]: e.target.value })}
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-hint ${id}-error` : `${id}-hint`}
          data-test-pass={key === "passPercent" ? "" : undefined}
          data-test-tries={key === "tries" ? "" : undefined}
        />
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className={ui.hint}>
          {hint}
        </p>
        {error && (
          <p id={`${id}-error`} className={ui.error}>
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={root}
      className={ed.list}
      data-test-editor=""
      role="group"
      aria-labelledby={`${uid}-title`}
      aria-describedby={listError ? `${uid}-hint ${uid}-error` : `${uid}-hint`}
      data-invalid={listError ? "" : undefined}
      tabIndex={listError ? -1 : undefined}
    >
      <div className={ed.listHead}>
        <h3 id={`${uid}-title`} className={ui.h3}>
          {t.sections.test}
        </h3>
      </div>
      <p id={`${uid}-hint`} className={ui.hint}>
        {f.testHint}
      </p>
      <div className={ed.grid}>
        {setting("passPercent", f.testPass, f.testPassHint, errors.testPassPercent, 3)}
        {setting("tries", f.testTries, f.testTriesHint, errors.testTries, 2)}
      </div>
      {questions.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={`${ui.muted} ${ui.small}`}>{f.testEmpty}</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className={ed.rows}>
          {questions.map((q, i) => {
            const n = i + 1;
            const id = `${uid}-q${i}`;
            const error = errors.test && at && at.index === i ? errors.test : undefined;
            return (
              <li key={q.id} className={ed.item} data-question={i} data-invalid={error ? "" : undefined} tabIndex={error ? -1 : undefined}>
                <span className={ed.num} aria-hidden="true">
                  {String(n).padStart(2, "0")}
                </span>
                <div className={styles.body}>
                  <fieldset className={ed.fieldset}>
                    <legend className={ui.sr}>{fill(f.testKind, { n })}</legend>
                    <div className={ed.choices}>
                      <Choice
                        className={ed.choice}
                        label={f.testKindChoice}
                        type="radio"
                        name={`${uid}-kind-${q.id}`}
                        value="choice"
                        checked={q.kind === "choice"}
                        onChange={() => setKind(i, "choice")}
                        data-question-kind="choice"
                      />
                      <Choice
                        className={ed.choice}
                        label={f.testKindOpen}
                        type="radio"
                        name={`${uid}-kind-${q.id}`}
                        value="open"
                        checked={q.kind === "open"}
                        onChange={() => setKind(i, "open")}
                        data-question-kind="open"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </fieldset>
                  <div className={ui.field}>
                    <label htmlFor={id}>{fill(f.testQuestion, { n })}</label>
                    <textarea
                      id={id}
                      className={ui.textarea}
                      rows={2}
                      maxLength={TEST_LIMITS.text}
                      value={q.text}
                      onChange={(e) => update(i, { ...q, text: e.target.value })}
                      aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
                      data-question-text=""
                    />
                  </div>
                  {q.kind === "choice" ? (
                    <div className={styles.options}>
                      <ol className={styles.optionList}>
                        {q.options.map((o, j) => {
                          const m = j + 1;
                          const oid = `${id}-o${j}`;
                          const marked = error !== undefined && at?.option === j;
                          return (
                            <li key={o.id} className={styles.option} data-option={j}>
                              <label htmlFor={oid} className={ui.sr}>
                                {fill(f.testOption, { q: n, n: m })}
                              </label>
                              <input
                                id={oid}
                                className={ui.input}
                                type="text"
                                maxLength={TEST_LIMITS.option}
                                autoComplete="off"
                                value={o.text}
                                onChange={(e) => setOptions(i, q.options.map((x, k) => (k === j ? { ...x, text: e.target.value } : x)))}
                                aria-invalid={marked || undefined}
                                aria-describedby={marked ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
                                data-option-text=""
                              />
                              <label className={`${ed.check} ${styles.correct}`}>
                                <input
                                  type="checkbox"
                                  checked={o.correct}
                                  onChange={(e) => setOptions(i, q.options.map((x, k) => (k === j ? { ...x, correct: e.target.checked } : x)))}
                                  data-option-correct=""
                                />
                                <span>{f.testCorrect}</span>
                              </label>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                className={ed.iconBtn}
                                aria-label={fill(f.testOptionRemove, { q: n, n: m })}
                                aria-disabled={q.options.length <= TEST_LIMITS.minOptions || undefined}
                                onClick={() => removeOption(i, j)}
                                data-option-remove=""
                              >
                                ×
                              </button>
                            </li>
                          );
                        })}
                      </ol>
                      <p className={ui.hint}>{f.testChoiceHint}</p>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn} ${ed.addBtn}`}
                        aria-disabled={q.options.length >= TEST_LIMITS.maxOptions || undefined}
                        onClick={() => addOption(i)}
                        data-option-add=""
                      >
                        + {f.testOptionAdd}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <p className={ui.hint}>{f.testOpenHint}</p>
                  )}
                  {error && (
                    <p id={`${id}-error`} className={ui.error}>
                      {error}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <span className={ed.tools}>
                  <button type="button" className={ed.iconBtn} aria-label={fill(f.testUp, { n })} aria-disabled={i === 0 || undefined} onClick={() => move(i, -1)} data-question-up="">
                    ↑
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={ed.iconBtn}
                    aria-label={fill(f.testDown, { n })}
                    aria-disabled={i === questions.length - 1 || undefined}
                    onClick={() => move(i, 1)}
                    data-question-down=""
                  >
                    ↓
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" className={ed.iconBtn} aria-label={fill(f.testRemove, { n })} onClick={() => remove(i)} data-question-remove="">
                    ×
                  </button>
                </span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}
      {listError && (
        <p id={`${uid}-error`} className={ui.error}>
          {listError}
        </p>
      )}
      <button ref={addBtn} type="button" className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn} ${ed.addBtn}`} aria-disabled={full || undefined} onClick={add} data-question-add="">
        + {f.testAdd}
      </button>
      {full && <p className={ui.hint}>{f.testFull}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
/* The course editor's "Teadmiste test" (e-course completion, spec §5.1): the parts of a question card, and an option's row (its field | "Õige" | ×).
   Built on editor.module.css's list rows (.item, .num, .tools, .iconBtn) and its checkbox row (.check); no colour of its own. */

.body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.options {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.optionList {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.option {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.correct {
  padding: 0 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* a phone: the option's field on its own line, "Õige" and × under it */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .option {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  }

  .option > input[type="text"] {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
}
```

```ts
async function readSnapshot(sql: postgres.Sql, slug: string): Promise<CourseSnapshot> {
  const [row] = await sql`select * from courses where slug = ${slug}`;
  if (!row) throw new Error(`e2e: course ${slug} not found — is the local DB seeded?`);
  const images = await sql<{ key: string; alt: unknown; sort: number }[]>`select key, alt, sort from course_images where course_id = ${row.id} order by sort, id`;
  const [test] = await sql<{ questions: unknown; pass_percent: number; tries: number }[]>`select questions, pass_percent, tries from course_tests where course_id = ${row.id}`;
  return { id: row.id as number, row: Object.fromEntries([...JSON_COLUMNS, ...PLAIN_COLUMNS].map((c) => [c, row[c]])), images: [...images], test: test ?? null };
}
```

```ts
/** A course's "Teadmiste test" row as stored (e-course completion, R1), or null without one. */
export async function storedCourseTest(courseId: number): Promise<{ questions: unknown; passPercent: number; tries: number } | null> {

    const [row] = await sql<{ questions: unknown; passPercent: number; tries: number }[]>`select questions, pass_percent as "passPercent", tries from course_tests where course_id = ${courseId}`;

  } finally {
    await sql.end();
  }
}
```

### Task 4: The completion core — `src/server/completion.ts`; the lesson paths call `completeIfDone`

Spec §4.4 (completed_at set in the step that passes the last required step, once, never cleared; "a passed step stays passed"), §4.1 (the step states' inputs), §3.4 (a protocol keeps its own copy of the points), §6 (the "completed" mail, after the commit, never to a sample address), §8 (the access expires or is revoked), D5. No ruling changes this task. The "completed" mail links the practical page for a course with points and the course page without: `mailCompletion` passes `hasPoints` (a plan ruling, Self-review row 7).

The lesson paths have no transaction today: each is one upsert. `completeIfDone` runs after it with the plain `db`. Its `UPDATE … where completed_at is null … returning` sets the date once whatever runs at the same moment. It is called only by the write that made its lesson done (`!row.done`). Each write comes before its own read, so of two lessons marked at once the later read sees both done. Only the call that set the date gets `completed: true`, and only its handler queues the mail. The JSON answers of `progress` and `tehtud` stay byte for byte as they are: `tests/db/lesson-api.test.ts` pins them with `toEqual`.

- Create: `app/src/server/completion.ts`
- Modify: `app/src/server/client-data.ts` (`activeAccess`, lines 254–268: its select gains the access's `id`)
- Modify: `app/src/server/lesson-data.ts` (header comment, lines 10–17; imports, line 7; `ProgressResult` / `DoneResult`, lines 39–41; `saveProgress`, lines 162–190; `markTextLessonDone`, lines 192–203)
- Modify: `app/src/server/account-api.ts` (imports, after line 25; `progress`, lines 490–513; `lessonDone`, lines 515–524)

- Consumes (Task 1), from `src/domain/completion.ts`: `TEST_DEFAULTS`; `readQuestions(value: unknown): TestQuestion[]`; `triesAllowed: (tries: number, extraTries: number) => number`; `testState(attempts: readonly { number: number; status: AttemptStatus }[], allowed: number): TestState`; `practicalStatus(p: { round: number; sentRound: number | null; sent: SentProtocol | null } | null): PracticalStatus`; `type StepInputs`; `type CourseSteps`; `courseSteps(i: StepInputs): CourseSteps`; `isComplete(i: StepInputs): boolean`.
- Consumes (Task 2), from `src/server/account-mail.ts`: `type CompletionMailKind`; `completionMail(input: CompletionMailInput): Mail` with `CompletionMailInput = { siteUrl; email; name; locale: Locale; slug; course: I18n; kind; fixCount?; hasPoints? }` (`hasPoints`: absent, "completed" links the course page; true, the practical page).
- Produces, from `src/server/completion.ts` (the plan's, verbatim):

  - `accessFor(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string): Promise<AccessWithCourse | null>`; `isActive: (a: Pick<AccessRow, "revokedAt" | "expiresAt">, now: Date) => boolean`; `lockAccess(tx: Db, accessId: number): Promise<AccessRow | null>`;
  - `type CourseSetup = { questions: TestQuestion[]; passPercent: number; tries: number; points: string[] }`; `courseSetup(db: Db, courseId: number): Promise<CourseSetup>`;

  - `completeIfDone(db: Db, accessId: number, now: Date): Promise<boolean>`;
  - `type CompletionJob = { accessId: number; email: string; name: string; locale: "et" | "ru"; slug: string; course: I18n; hasPoints: boolean }`; `completionJob(db: Db, accessId: number): Promise<CompletionJob | null>`; `mailCompletion(env: Env, siteUrl: string, job: CompletionJob, kind: CompletionMailKind, fixCount?: number): Promise<void>`.
- Produces (**added**): `queueCompletionMail(deps: { db: Db; env: Env; siteUrl: string; later: (task: () => Promise<unknown>) => void }, accessId: number): void` (the "completed" mail queued after the answer; the job is read then); `ProgressResult`'s and `DoneResult`'s `saved` variants gain `completed: boolean` **and `accessId: number`** (added: the handler's mail needs it); `activeAccess(…)` answers `{ id, course, expiresAt }` (the `id` added).
- Note for Tasks 5 and 10: the protocol's points decide `hasPoints` once a protocol exists (its own `stages`, spec §3.4); the course's `protocol_stages` only before.

```ts
 */
async function world(opts: { questions?: TestQuestion[]; points?: string[]; email?: string; locale?: "et" | "ru"; access?: Partial<typeof courseAccess.$inferInsert>; video?: boolean } = {}) {
  const [course] = await db
    .insert(courses)

    .returning();

  const [l1] = await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Esimene" }, kind: "text" }).returning();
  const [l2] = opts.video
    ? await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 2, title: { et: "Teine" }, videoId: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", videoStatus: "ready", durationSec: 100 }).returning()
    : await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 2, title: { et: "Teine" }, kind: "text" }).returning();
  if (opts.questions) await db.insert(courseTests).values({ courseId: course.id, questions: opts.questions });
  const [client] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: opts.email ?? "kati@example.com", name: "Kati Kask", locale: opts.locale ?? "et" }).returning();
  const [access] = await db
    .insert(courseAccess)
    .values({ clientId: client.id, courseId: course.id, grantedBy: "maria@example.test", expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + 180 * DAY), ...opts.access })
    .returning();
  const raw = newToken();
  await db.insert(clientSessions).values({ idHash: await sha256(raw), clientId: client.id, createdAt: NOW, expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + CLIENT_SESSION_TTL_MS) });
  return { course, l1, l2, client, access, cookie: `__Host-mslab_client=${raw}` };
}

/** The account API's deps; `flush` runs what was queued after the answer, as Next's after() does. */
function deps() {
  const tasks: (() => Promise<unknown>)[] = [];
  const d: AccountDeps = { db, env: env(), now: NOW, siteUrl: SITE, later: (task) => void tasks.push(task), dev: false };
  return { d, queued: () => tasks.length, flush: () => Promise.all(tasks.splice(0).map((task) => task())) };
}

describe("whose access", () => {
  test("accessFor finds her access to an e-course, with the course; never another client's, an unknown course or a contact course; lockAccess reads it in a transaction", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    expect(await accessFor(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm")).toEqual({
      id: w.access.id,
      clientId: w.client.id,
      courseId: w.course.id,
      expiresAt: w.access.expiresAt,
      revokedAt: null,
      extraTries: 0,
      completedAt: null,
      course: { id: w.course.id, slug: "e-kulm", title: { et: "Kulmude e-koolitus", ru: "Онлайн-курс бровей" } },
    });
    const [other] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: "mari@example.com" }).returning();
    expect(await accessFor(db, other.id, "e-kulm")).toBeNull();
    expect(await accessFor(db, w.client.id, "pole-olemas")).toBeNull();
    const [contact] = await db.insert(courses).values({ slug: "kontakt", type: "contact", level: "basic", title: { et: "Kontakt" }, summary: { et: "" }, body: { et: "" } }).returning();
    await db.insert(courseAccess).values({ clientId: w.client.id, courseId: contact.id, grantedBy: "maria@example.test", expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + DAY) });
    expect(await accessFor(db, w.client.id, "kontakt")).toBeNull();
    expect(await db.transaction(async (tx) => lockAccess(tx as unknown as Db, w.access.id))).toMatchObject({ id: w.access.id, extraTries: 0, completedAt: null });
    expect(await db.transaction(async (tx) => lockAccess(tx as unknown as Db, 999_999))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("Review Focus 4: an expired access is found (her results stay readable) and still completes (Maria's approving assessment); a revoked one is found, never active, and never completes", async () => {
    const w = await world({ access: { expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - DAY) } });
    await done(w.client.id, w.l1.id);
    await done(w.client.id, w.l2.id);
    const expired = (await accessFor(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm"))!;
    expect(expired.id).toBe(w.access.id);
    expect(isActive(expired, NOW)).toBe(false);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, NOW)).toBe(true);

    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ completedAt: null, revokedAt: NOW, expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + DAY) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    const revoked = (await accessFor(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm"))!;
    expect(revoked.revokedAt).toEqual(NOW);
    expect(isActive(revoked, NOW)).toBe(false);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, NOW)).toBe(false);
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toBeNull();
    // her lesson pages answer 404 when it is not active: no lesson write, nothing completes from there
    expect((await post(deps().d, w.cookie, `/kursus/e-kulm/${w.l2.id}/tehtud`)).status).toBe(404);

    expect(isActive({ revokedAt: null, expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + 1) }, NOW)).toBe(true);
    expect(isActive({ revokedAt: null, expiresAt: NOW }, NOW)).toBe(false); // it ends at its moment, as activeAccess's `expires_at > now`
  });
});

    await done(w.client.id, w.l2.id);

    expect(await stepInputs(db, await accessRow(w.access.id))).toEqual({
      lessonsDone: 2,

      hasQuestions: true,
      test: { kind: "passed" },

      practical: "review",
      practicalRound: 1,
      completedAt: null,

    // the course's points changed after the protocol was made: the protocol's copy decides

    expect((await stepInputs(db, await accessRow(w.access.id))).hasPoints).toBe(true);
    await db.update(protocols).set({ stages: [] }).where(eq(protocols.accessId, w.access.id));
    await db.update(courses).set({ protocolStages: ["Kulmude kuju"] }).where(eq(courses.id, w.course.id));
    expect((await stepInputs(db, await accessRow(w.access.id))).hasPoints).toBe(false); // a notes-only protocol made while the course had none
  });

  test("loadSteps: locked steps before the lessons, the test open after them; a completed lessons-only course: every step done, none it lacks", async () => {

      lessons: { done: 0, total: 2, state: "open" },
      test: { state: "locked" },
      practical: { state: "locked", round: 0 },
      completedAt: null,
    });
    await done(w.client.id, w.l1.id);
    await done(w.client.id, w.l2.id);
    expect((await loadSteps(db, await accessRow(w.access.id))).test).toMatchObject({ state: "open" });
    await db.delete(courseTests);
    await db.update(courses).set({ protocolStages: [] });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ completedAt: NOW });
    expect(await loadSteps(db, await accessRow(w.access.id))).toEqual({ lessons: { done: 2, total: 2, state: "done" }, test: null, practical: null, completedAt: NOW.toISOString() });
  });
});

describe("completeIfDone (spec §4.4)", () => {

    const w = await world({ questions: [Q1] });
    await done(w.client.id, w.l1.id);
    await done(w.client.id, w.l2.id);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, NOW)).toBe(false); // the test is still to pass
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toBeNull();
    await passed(w.client.id, w.course.id);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, NOW)).toBe(true);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, new Date(NOW.getTime() + DAY))).toBe(false);
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toEqual(NOW);
    expect(infoLog()).toContain(`[completion] access ${w.access.id}: completed`);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, 999_999, NOW)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a passed step stays passed: a lesson or questions added after the completion never clear it", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await done(w.client.id, w.l1.id);
    await done(w.client.id, w.l2.id);
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, NOW)).toBe(true);
    const [m] = await db.select().from(courseModules);
    await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 3, title: { et: "Uus" }, kind: "text" });
    await db.insert(courseTests).values({ courseId: w.course.id, questions: [Q1] });
    expect(await completeIfDone(db, w.access.id, new Date(NOW.getTime() + DAY))).toBe(false);
    const access = await accessRow(w.access.id);
    expect(access.completedAt).toEqual(NOW);
    expect(await loadSteps(db, access)).toMatchObject({ lessons: { state: "done" }, test: { state: "done" }, completedAt: NOW.toISOString() });
  });

  test("inside the caller's transaction: it is rolled back with it", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await done(w.client.id, w.l1.id);
    await done(w.client.id, w.l2.id);
    await expect(
      db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        expect(await completeIfDone(tx as unknown as Db, w.access.id, NOW)).toBe(true);
        tx.rollback();
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow();
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { and, eq, isNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { clients, courseAccess, courses, courseTests, protocols, testAttempts, type TestQuestion } from "@/db/schema";
import { courseSteps, isComplete, practicalStatus, readQuestions, TEST_DEFAULTS, testState, triesAllowed, type CourseSteps, type StepInputs } from "@/domain/completion";
import { isSampleAddress } from "@/domain/email";
import { readStages } from "@/domain/protocols";
import type { I18n } from "@/i18n/field";
import { completionMail, type CompletionMailKind } from "./account-mail";
import { courseOutline } from "./lesson-outline";
import { logFailure, logNote } from "./log";
import { mailConfigured, sendMail, type Env } from "./notify";

// The e-course's completion (e-course completion, spec §4.1, §4.4, D5), without Next.js: whose access a request is about (in any state: an
// expired one's results stay readable, Maria still assesses it), its lock (FOR UPDATE: the first lock of every write about one access), the
// course's test and points, what the step states are made of, and completeIfDone, the ONE place course_access.completed_at is set. Each path
// that can finish the last step calls it after its write — the last lesson (lesson-data.ts), a passed test (test-attempts.ts), an approving
// assessment (assessment.ts) — and only the call that set it mails "completed", after the commit. Logs carry the access's id only.

export type AccessRow = { id: number; clientId: number; courseId: number; expiresAt: Date; revokedAt: Date | null; extraTries: number; completedAt: Date | null };
export type AccessWithCourse = AccessRow & { course: { id: number; slug: string; title: I18n } };

const accessColumns = {
  id: courseAccess.id,
  clientId: courseAccess.clientId,
  courseId: courseAccess.courseId,
  expiresAt: courseAccess.expiresAt,
  revokedAt: courseAccess.revokedAt,
  extraTries: courseAccess.extraTries,
  completedAt: courseAccess.completedAt,
};

/** The access of this client to the e-course `slug`, in any state (revoked and expired too); null without one or for a contact course. */
export async function accessFor(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string): Promise<AccessWithCourse | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ ...accessColumns, course: { id: courses.id, slug: courses.slug, title: courses.title } })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .where(and(eq(courseAccess.clientId, clientId), eq(courses.slug, slug), eq(courses.type, "e_learning")))
    .limit(1);
  return row ?? null;
}

/** Not revoked and not ended (the same rule as client-data.ts activeAccess: `expires_at > now`). */
export const isActive = (a: Pick<AccessRow, "revokedAt" | "expiresAt">, now: Date): boolean => a.revokedAt === null && a.expiresAt > now;

/** SELECT … FOR UPDATE of the access row (inside a transaction): every write about one access takes it first; null when it is gone. */
export async function lockAccess(tx: Db, accessId: number): Promise<AccessRow | null> {
  const [row] = await tx.select(accessColumns).from(courseAccess).where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId)).for("update");
  return row ?? null;
}

export type CourseSetup = { questions: TestQuestion[]; passPercent: number; tries: number; points: string[] };

/** The course's test (R1: its course_tests row; no questions, 80 % and 3 tries without one) and its points (readStages(courses.protocol_stages)). */
export async function courseSetup(db: Db, courseId: number): Promise<CourseSetup> {
  const [[course], [test]] = await Promise.all([
    db.select({ points: courses.protocolStages }).from(courses).where(eq(courses.id, courseId)).limit(1),
    db.select().from(courseTests).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, courseId)).limit(1),
  ]);
  return {
    questions: readQuestions(test?.questions ?? []),
    passPercent: test?.passPercent ?? TEST_DEFAULTS.passPercent,
    tries: test?.tries ?? TEST_DEFAULTS.tries,
    points: readStages(course?.points ?? []),
  };
}

/**
 * Everything courseSteps needs, read for one access: the lessons (courseOutline: the visible ones, as the e-course page counts them), the
 * attempts, the protocol. The points are the protocol's own copy once it exists (spec §3.4: a later change of the course's points reaches only
 * protocols not made yet), the course's before.
 */
export async function stepInputs(db: Db, access: AccessRow, setup?: CourseSetup): Promise<StepInputs> {
  const [s, outline, attempts, [protocol]] = await Promise.all([
    setup ?? courseSetup(db, access.courseId),
    courseOutline(db, access.courseId, access.clientId),
    db.select({ number: testAttempts.number, status: testAttempts.status }).from(testAttempts).where(and(eq(testAttempts.clientId, access.clientId), eq(testAttempts.courseId, access.courseId))),
    db.select({ stages: protocols.stages, round: protocols.round, sentRound: protocols.sentRound, sent: protocols.sent }).from(protocols).where(eq(protocols.accessId, access.id)).limit(1),
  ]);
  return {
    lessonsDone: outline.progress.done,
    lessonsTotal: outline.progress.total,
    hasQuestions: s.questions.length > 0,
    test: testState(attempts, triesAllowed(s.tries, access.extraTries)),
    hasPoints: protocol ? protocol.stages.length > 0 : s.points.length > 0,
    practical: practicalStatus(protocol ?? null),
    practicalRound: protocol?.round ?? 0,
    completedAt: access.completedAt,
  };
}

/** The steps of one access, as the "Lõpetamine" block and the drawer's line show them. */
export async function loadSteps(db: Db, access: AccessRow): Promise<CourseSteps> {
  return courseSteps(await stepInputs(db, access));
}

/**
 * Sets course_access.completed_at = now when every present step is done and it is still null (one UPDATE … where completed_at is null);
 * true when THIS call set it (the caller mails "completed"). Runs inside the caller's transaction when given one (`tx as unknown as Db`):
 * it is then committed or rolled back with the step that completed the course. Never for a revoked access; an expired one completes (Maria
 * may assess it, spec §8). Never cleared: a lesson or a question added later leaves it (spec §4.4).
 */
export async function completeIfDone(db: Db, accessId: number, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
  const [access] = await db.select(accessColumns).from(courseAccess).where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId)).limit(1);
  if (!access || access.completedAt !== null || access.revokedAt !== null) return false;
  if (!isComplete(await stepInputs(db, access))) return false;
  const set = await db
    .update(courseAccess)
    .set({ completedAt: now })
    .where(and(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId), isNull(courseAccess.completedAt)))
    .returning(); // (returning(fields) has no common overload on the Db union: the whole row)
  if (set.length === 0) return false;
  console.info(`[completion] access ${accessId}: completed`);
  return true;
}

export type CompletionJob = { accessId: number; email: string; name: string; locale: "et" | "ru"; slug: string; course: I18n; hasPoints: boolean };

/** Who to mail about an access (the client's address, name and language; the course, and whether it has points: the protocol's copy decides once it exists). */
export async function completionJob(db: Db, accessId: number): Promise<CompletionJob | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ email: clients.email, name: clients.name, locale: clients.locale, slug: courses.slug, course: courses.title, points: courses.protocolStages, stages: protocols.stages })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(courseAccess.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(protocols, eq(protocols.accessId, courseAccess.id))
    .where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    accessId,
    email: row.email,
    name: row.name,
    locale: row.locale === "ru" ? "ru" : "et",
    slug: row.slug,
    course: row.course,
    hasPoints: row.stages ? row.stages.length > 0 : readStages(row.points).length > 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Sends completionMail of `kind` to the job's student: never to a sample address, nothing when Resend is not set up (local runs, e2e). A mail
 * Resend does not take is logged by the access's id and never undoes what was saved. Logs `[completion] access N: the <kind> mail …`.
 */
export async function mailCompletion(env: Env, siteUrl: string, job: CompletionJob, kind: CompletionMailKind, fixCount?: number): Promise<void> {
  if (isSampleAddress(job.email) || !mailConfigured(env)) return;
  try {
    const mail = completionMail({
      siteUrl,
      email: job.email,
      name: job.name,
      locale: job.locale,
      slug: job.slug,
      course: job.course,
      kind,
      hasPoints: job.hasPoints,
      ...(fixCount !== undefined ? { fixCount } : {}),
    });
    if (await sendMail(env, mail)) console.info(`[completion] access ${job.accessId}: the ${kind} mail sent`);
    else logNote(`[completion] access ${job.accessId}: the ${kind} mail was not sent`);
  } catch (e) {
    logFailure(`[completion] access ${job.accessId}: the ${kind} mail failed`, e);
  }
}

/** The "completed" mail of an access, queued after the answer (`later`): who and what are read then, so the answer never waits for the mail. */
export function queueCompletionMail(deps: { db: Db; env: Env; siteUrl: string; later: (task: () => Promise<unknown>) => void }, accessId: number): void {
  deps.later(async () => {
    const job = await completionJob(deps.db, accessId);
    if (job) await mailCompletion(deps.env, deps.siteUrl, job, "completed");
  });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The e-course the client has access to right now (not revoked, not expired), or null. Whether the course is still published does not
 * matter: access is granted to the client and stays until it ends; only the favourites are limited to published courses.
 * Also the lesson endpoints' first check (lesson-data.ts), whose write may complete the access by its `id` (e-course completion).
 */
export async function activeAccess(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string, now: Date) {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ id: courseAccess.id, course: { id: courses.id, slug: courses.slug, title: courses.title }, expiresAt: courseAccess.expiresAt })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .where(and(eq(courseAccess.clientId, clientId), eq(courses.slug, slug), isNull(courseAccess.revokedAt), gt(courseAccess.expiresAt, now)))
    .limit(1);
  return row ?? null;
}
```

  4. `saveProgress` becomes (the doc comment stays as it is):

```ts
export async function saveProgress(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string, lessonId: number, watchedSec: number, now: Date): Promise<ProgressResult> {
  const opened = await openLesson(db, clientId, slug, lessonId, now);
  if (opened.kind !== "open") return opened;
  const { access, row, outline } = opened;
  if (completion(row) !== "watch" || row.durationSec === null) return { kind: "video" };
  if (watchedSec > row.durationSec + 5) return { kind: "range" };
  const kept = acceptProgress({ watchedSec: row.watchedSec, clockAt: row.clockAt }, watchedSec, now);
  const [saved] = await db
    .insert(lessonProgress)
    .values({ clientId, lessonId, watchedSec: kept.watchedSec, clockAt: kept.clockAt, doneAt: isWatched(kept.watchedSec, row.durationSec) ? now : null, updatedAt: now })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: [lessonProgress.clientId, lessonProgress.lessonId],
      set: {
        watchedSec: sql`greatest(${lessonProgress.watchedSec}, excluded.watched_sec)`,
        clockAt: sql`greatest(${lessonProgress.clockAt}, excluded.clock_at)`,
        doneAt: sql`coalesce(${lessonProgress.doneAt}, excluded.done_at)`,
        updatedAt: now,
      },
    })
    .returning(); // (returning(fields) has no common overload on the Db union: the whole row)
  const done = saved.doneAt !== null;
  // done by this report (it was not when the lesson was read): maybe the course's last step
  const completed = done && !row.done ? await completeIfDone(db, access.id, now) : false;
  return { kind: "saved", done, next: nextLessonAfter(outline.lessons, lessonId), completed, accessId: access.id };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * POST tehtud ("Märgi tehtuks"): a text lesson (kind "text") only — any video lesson is "video" (409); done once (a second time changes nothing,
 * and completes nothing).
 */
export async function markTextLessonDone(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string, lessonId: number, now: Date): Promise<DoneResult> {
  const opened = await openLesson(db, clientId, slug, lessonId, now);
  if (opened.kind !== "open") return opened;
  const { access, row, outline } = opened;
  if (completion(row) !== "mark") return { kind: "video" };
  await db
    .insert(lessonProgress)
    .values({ clientId, lessonId, doneAt: now, updatedAt: now })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({ target: [lessonProgress.clientId, lessonProgress.lessonId], set: { doneAt: sql`coalesce(${lessonProgress.doneAt}, excluded.done_at)`, updatedAt: now } });
  const completed = row.done ? false : await completeIfDone(db, access.id, now);
  return { kind: "saved", next: nextLessonAfter(outline.lessons, lessonId), completed, accessId: access.id };
}
```
