### Task 5: The knowledge test's server — `src/server/test-attempts.ts`

Spec §3.3 (attempts, the frozen copy, grading, tries), §4.2 (the student's states, "changed" uses no try), §5.2 group 3 and §5.4 (Maria's review, "Ava test uuesti"), §6 (the student's mails and Maria's three notices), §4.4 (a passed test completes a course without points), §8 (two devices; Maria edits the questions; the access expires during review; revoked), D2, D3. Rulings: R1 (the questions, the mark and the tries come from `course_tests` through `courseSetup`).

Every write is ONE transaction. It locks `course_access` first (`lockAccess`), then reads the attempts, so two submits at once run one after the other and the second sees the first. A submit carries the answers only. The server reads the course's CURRENT questions and refuses `changed` when the ids differ (Review Focus 3).

**One try for a double tap.** The lock alone would let a second tap after a failed first one make attempt 2. So a submit is a repeat when its answers equal her newest attempt's and the course's questions equal that attempt's copy. Grading the same answers gives the same result, so a new attempt would only use a try. A repeat is answered with the view as it is and writes nothing (Review Focus 2). Different answers from a second device are a real second try while tries are left. While the first attempt waits for Maria, they are `closed`. The unique `(client, course, number)` index is the backstop: a write that raced past the lock throws, and nothing is saved.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/server/test-attempts.ts`
- Test: `app/tests/db/test-attempts.test.ts` (new)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 1), from `src/db/schema.ts`: `testAttempts`, `courseTests`, `courseAccess` (`extraTries`, `completedAt`); `type TestAttempt`, `type TestQuestion`, `type TestAnswers = Record<string, string[] | string>`, `type OpenReview = Record<string, { verdict: Verdict; comment: string }>`, `type AttemptStatus = "failed" | "review" | "fix" | "passed"`.
- Consumes (Task 1), from `src/domain/completion.ts`: `readQuestions`; `publicQuestions(questions): PublicQuestion[]`; `checkAnswers(questions, raw): { ok: true; answers: TestAnswers } | { ok: false; error: "changed" | "incomplete" | "tooLong" }`; `grade(questions, answers): { correct: number; total: number; wrong: number[] }`; `percentOf(correct, total): number`; `submitStatus(questions, correct, total, passPercent): AttemptStatus`; `checkReview(questions, raw): { ok: true; review: OpenReview } | { ok: false; error: "incomplete" | "comment" | "tooLong" }`; `reviewStatus(review): "passed" | "fix"`; `fixAnswers(review: OpenReview | null): string[]`; `triesAllowed(tries, extraTries)`; `testState(attempts, allowed): TestState`; `type PublicQuestion`, `type TestState`.
- Consumes (Task 2): from `src/server/messages.ts` `type CompletionNotice = { accessId: number; name: string; email: string; course: string }`, `type Summary`, `testReviewSummary(n: CompletionNotice & { attemptId: number; number: number }, adminUrl: string): Summary`, `triesUsedSummary(n: CompletionNotice & { tries: number }, adminUrl: string): Summary`; from `src/server/account-mail.ts` `type CompletionMailKind` (kinds used: `"completed"`, `"testPassed"`, `"testFix"`, `"reopened"`); from `src/server/notify.ts` `notifyMaria(env, subject, text, { short, replyTo, siteUrl })`, `adminUrl(base)`, `type Env`.
- Consumes (Task 4), from `src/server/completion.ts`: `accessFor`, `isActive`, `lockAccess`, `courseSetup`, `completeIfDone`, `completionJob`, `mailCompletion`; `type AccessWithCourse`, `type CourseSetup`, `type CompletionJob`.
- Produces (the plan's, verbatim): `TestDeps`, `AttemptView`, `TestView`, `testView(db, clientId, slug, now): Promise<TestView | null>`, `SubmitResult`, `submitAttempt(deps, clientId, slug, raw)`, `resubmitAnswers(deps, clientId, slug, attemptId, raw)`, `ReviewResult`, `reviewAttempt(deps, adminEmail, attemptId, raw)`, `reopenTest(deps, adminEmail, accessId)`. `raw` is the request body's `answers` (Task 6) or the review form's `review` (Task 12), as sent.
- For Tasks 6 and 12, the meaning of the fields:
  - `TestView.tries` is the tries allowed (the course's plus `extra_tries`: "Katse 2/3"), and `triesLeft` is that minus the attempts made, at least 0.
  - `AttemptView.wrong` and `.questions` come from the attempt's own copy.
  - A resubmission sets the attempt's `submittedAt` to its time (Hindamine's "sent at").

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test** `tests/db/test-attempts.test.ts`:

```ts
import { asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { clients, courseAccess, courseModules, courses, courseTests, lessonProgress, lessons, testAttempts, type TestAnswers, type TestQuestion } from "@/db/schema";
import { publicQuestions } from "@/domain/completion";
import { loadSteps } from "@/server/completion";
import type { Env } from "@/server/notify";
import { reopenTest, resubmitAnswers, reviewAttempt, submitAttempt, testView, type SubmitResult, type TestDeps, type TestView } from "@/server/test-attempts";
import { fakeKv, stubFetch } from "../fakes";
import { makeTestDb } from "./helpers";

// The knowledge test's server (e-course completion, spec §3.3, §4.2, §5.4, §6, §8; §9 DB): grading at once against the course's current
// questions, the frozen copy, the tries with extra_tries, the open answers' review and their rewrite (no try), "Ava test uuesti", the completion
// by a passed test, Maria's notices and the student's mails after the commit, and the refusals that write nothing. Two submits at once on real
// Postgres: tests/e2e/completion-race.spec.ts.

const NOW = new Date("2026-10-13T09:00:00Z");
const LATER = new Date("2026-10-14T09:00:00Z");
const DAY = 86_400_000;
const SITE = "https://mslab.example";
const MARIA = "maria@example.test";

const Q1: TestQuestion = { id: "q0000001", kind: "choice", text: "Mitu kihti värvi kanname?", options: [{ id: "o0000011", text: "Ühe", correct: false }, { id: "o0000012", text: "Kaks", correct: true }] };
const Q2: TestQuestion = {
  id: "q0000002",
  kind: "choice",
  text: "Mis kuulub ettevalmistusse?",
  options: [
    { id: "o0000021", text: "Puhastamine", correct: true },
    { id: "o0000022", text: "Kuju määramine", correct: true },
    { id: "o0000023", text: "Värvimine", correct: false },
  ],
};
const OPEN: TestQuestion = { id: "q0000003", kind: "open", text: "Kirjelda, kuidas valmistad kulmud ette." };
const Q4: TestQuestion = { id: "q0000004", kind: "choice", text: "Kui kaua värv mõjub?", options: [{ id: "o0000041", text: "5 minutit", correct: true }, { id: "o0000042", text: "1 tund", correct: false }] };

const RIGHT: TestAnswers = { [Q1.id]: ["o0000012"], [Q2.id]: ["o0000021", "o0000022"] };
/** 1 of 2 right: 50 %, under the 80 % mark; question 1 wrong. */
const WRONG: TestAnswers = { [Q1.id]: ["o0000011"], [Q2.id]: ["o0000021", "o0000022"] };
const ANSWER = "Puhastan ja määran kuju.";

let db: Db;
let resend: ReturnType<typeof stubFetch>;
beforeEach(async () => {
  db = await makeTestDb();
  resend = stubFetch((url) => (url.includes("resend") ? Response.json({ id: "email_1" }) : Response.json({})));
  for (const method of ["info", "error"] as const) vi.spyOn(console, method).mockImplementation(() => {});
});
afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});

/**
 * The e-course "e-kulm" (`points` its protocol_stages; none by default) with one text lesson, done unless `lessonsDone` is false; its test
 * (`questions`, Q1 and Q2 by default; 80 %; `tries`, 3 by default); Kati Kask (kati@example.com unless `email` says otherwise) with six months of
 * access (`access` replaces fields).
 */
async function world(opts: { questions?: TestQuestion[]; points?: string[]; tries?: number; lessonsDone?: boolean; email?: string; access?: Partial<typeof courseAccess.$inferInsert> } = {}) {
  const [course] = await db
    .insert(courses)
    .values({ slug: "e-kulm", type: "e_learning", level: "basic", title: { et: "Kulmude e-koolitus", ru: "Онлайн-курс бровей" }, summary: { et: "" }, body: { et: "" }, price: 9500, published: true, protocolStages: opts.points ?? [] })
    .returning();
  const [m] = await db.insert(courseModules).values({ courseId: course.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Alustame" } }).returning();
  const [lesson] = await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Sissejuhatus" }, kind: "text" }).returning();
  await db.insert(courseTests).values({ courseId: course.id, questions: opts.questions ?? [Q1, Q2], passPercent: 80, tries: opts.tries ?? 3 });
  const [client] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: opts.email ?? "kati@example.com", name: "Kati Kask" }).returning();
  const [access] = await db.insert(courseAccess).values({ clientId: client.id, courseId: course.id, grantedBy: MARIA, expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + 180 * DAY), ...opts.access }).returning();
  if (opts.lessonsDone !== false) await db.insert(lessonProgress).values({ clientId: client.id, lessonId: lesson.id, doneAt: NOW });
  return { course, lesson, client, access };
}

const env = (): Env => ({ KV: fakeKv(), MAIL_FROM: "MS LAB <info@send.example>", MARIA_EMAIL: MARIA, SITE_URL: SITE, RESEND_API_KEY: "re_test" });
/** `flush` runs every queued task, as Next's after() does. */
function deps(now = NOW) {
  const tasks: (() => Promise<unknown>)[] = [];
  const d: TestDeps = { db, env: env(), siteUrl: SITE, now, later: (task) => void tasks.push(task) };
  return { d, queued: () => tasks.length, flush: () => Promise.all(tasks.splice(0).map((task) => task())) };
}
type SentMail = { to: string; subject: string; text: string };
const mails = () => resend.calls.filter((c) => c.url.includes("resend")).map((c) => c.body as SentMail);
const toMaria = () => mails().filter((m) => m.to === MARIA);
const toKati = () => mails().filter((m) => m.to === "kati@example.com");
const stored = (clientId: number) => db.select().from(testAttempts).where(eq(testAttempts.clientId, clientId)).orderBy(asc(testAttempts.number));
const accessRow = async (id: number) => (await db.select().from(courseAccess).where(eq(courseAccess.id, id)))[0];
const infoLog = () => vi.mocked(console.info).mock.calls.flat().join("\n");
const viewOf = (r: SubmitResult): TestView => {
  expect(r.kind).toBe("submitted");
  return (r as Extract<SubmitResult, { kind: "submitted" }>).view;
};

describe("testView", () => {
  test("the course's questions without the answer key, the state and the tries; locked before the lessons; read-only once the access has ended", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const view = (await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW))!;
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ course: { slug: "e-kulm", title: { et: "Kulmude e-koolitus" } }, state: { kind: "none" }, passPercent: 80, tries: 3, triesLeft: 3, last: null, locked: false, readOnly: false });
    expect(view.questions).toEqual(publicQuestions([Q1, Q2]));
    expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain('"correct"'); // the answer key never leaves the server
    expect((await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", new Date(NOW.getTime() + 200 * DAY)))!.readOnly).toBe(true);
    await db.delete(lessonProgress);
    expect((await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW))!.locked).toBe(true);
  });

  test("null: another client, an unknown course, a course without questions, a revoked access, a contact course", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const [other] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: "mari@example.com" }).returning();
    expect(await testView(db, other.id, "e-kulm", NOW)).toBeNull();
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "pole-olemas", NOW)).toBeNull();
    await db.update(courseTests).set({ questions: [] });
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW)).toBeNull();
    await db.update(courseTests).set({ questions: [Q1] });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: NOW });
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW)).toBeNull();
    const [contact] = await db.insert(courses).values({ slug: "kontakt", type: "contact", level: "basic", title: { et: "Kontakt" }, summary: { et: "" }, body: { et: "" } }).returning();
    await db.insert(courseAccess).values({ clientId: w.client.id, courseId: contact.id, grantedBy: MARIA, expiresAt: LATER });
    await db.insert(courseTests).values({ courseId: contact.id, questions: [Q1] });
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "kontakt", NOW)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("submitAttempt", () => {
  test("graded at once: a failed choice part uses a try and names the wrong questions, the copy kept; a pass on a course with points mails nobody and opens the practical work", async () => {
    const w = await world({ points: ["Kulmude kuju", "Värvimine"] });
    const { d, queued } = deps();
    const failed = viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG));
    expect(failed).toMatchObject({
      state: { kind: "open" },
      tries: 3,
      triesLeft: 2,
      last: { number: 1, status: "failed", percent: 50, wrong: [1], answers: WRONG, review: null, submittedAt: NOW.toISOString() },
    });
    expect(failed.last!.questions).toEqual(publicQuestions([Q1, Q2]));
    expect(JSON.stringify(failed)).not.toContain('"correct"');
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toMatchObject([{ number: 1, status: "failed", correct: 1, total: 2, answers: WRONG, questions: [Q1, Q2], submittedAt: NOW, review: null, reviewedAt: null }]);

    const passed = viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", RIGHT));
    expect(passed).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "passed" }, triesLeft: 1, last: { number: 2, status: "passed", percent: 100, wrong: [] } });
    expect(queued()).toBe(0); // an automatic result mails nobody: she is on the page
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toBeNull(); // the practical work is still to come
    expect((await loadSteps(db, await accessRow(w.access.id))).practical).toMatchObject({ state: "open" });
    const rows = await stored(w.client.id);
    expect(infoLog()).toContain(`[test] attempt ${rows[0].id}: submitted (failed)`);
    expect(infoLog()).toContain(`[test] attempt ${rows[1].id}: submitted (passed)`);
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG)).toEqual({ kind: "closed" }); // passed: nothing more to take
  });

  test("the tries are the course's and extra_tries; when the last one fails the state is 'used', Maria hears it once, and nothing more is taken", async () => {
    const w = await world({ tries: 2 });
    const { d, queued, flush } = deps();
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG));
    expect(queued()).toBe(0);
    const used = viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { [Q1.id]: ["o0000011"], [Q2.id]: ["o0000021"] }));
    expect(used).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "used" }, tries: 2, triesLeft: 0, last: { number: 2, status: "failed" } });
    expect(queued()).toBe(1);
    await flush();
    expect(toMaria()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toMaria()[0].subject).toContain("Testi katsed otsas: Kati Kask, Kulmude e-koolitus");
    expect(toMaria()[0].text).toContain(`${SITE}/admin/hindamine`);
    expect(toKati()).toEqual([]);
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", RIGHT)).toEqual({ kind: "closed" });
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toHaveLength(2);
    // extra tries (as "Ava test uuesti" gives them) open it again
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ extraTries: 2 }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW)).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "open" }, tries: 4, triesLeft: 2 });
    expect(viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", RIGHT)).last).toMatchObject({ number: 3, status: "passed" });
  });

  test("refusals write nothing and use no try: locked before the lessons, incomplete or too long answers, an ended access; another client's or a revoked access is notFound", async () => {
    const w = await world({ questions: [Q1, OPEN], lessonsDone: false });
    const { d } = deps();
    const good = { [Q1.id]: ["o0000012"], [OPEN.id]: ANSWER };
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", good)).toEqual({ kind: "closed" }); // the test opens once every lesson is done
    await db.insert(lessonProgress).values({ clientId: w.client.id, lessonId: w.lesson.id, doneAt: NOW });
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...good, [Q1.id]: [] })).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "incomplete" });
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...good, [OPEN.id]: "   " })).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "incomplete" });
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...good, [OPEN.id]: "x".repeat(2001) })).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "tooLong" });
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...good, [Q1.id]: ["o0000011", "o0000012"] })).toEqual({ kind: "changed" }); // two options on a one-answer question
    for (const body of ["x", null, [good]]) expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", body)).toEqual({ kind: "changed" }); // not answers at all
    expect(await submitAttempt(deps(new Date(NOW.getTime() + 200 * DAY)).d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", good)).toEqual({ kind: "closed" }); // the access has ended
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toEqual([]);
    const [other] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: "mari@example.com" }).returning();
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, other.id, "e-kulm", good)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: NOW });
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", good)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("open answers: Maria's review and the rewrite", () => {
  test("review: Maria hears it; 'Paranda' mails the student; only those answers may change, no try used, Maria hears it again; accepted completes a course without points", async () => {
    const w = await world({ questions: [Q1, Q2, OPEN] });
    const { d, flush } = deps();
    const answers = { ...RIGHT, [OPEN.id]: ANSWER };
    const waiting = viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", answers));
    expect(waiting).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "review" }, triesLeft: 2, last: { number: 1, status: "review", percent: 100 } });
    const [attempt] = await stored(w.client.id);
    await flush();
    expect(toMaria()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toMaria()[0].subject).toContain("Test ootab hindamist: Kati Kask, Kulmude e-koolitus");
    expect(toMaria()[0].text).toContain(`${SITE}/admin/hindamine/test?id=${attempt.id}`);
    expect(toMaria()[0].text).not.toContain(ANSWER); // a notice carries the link, never an answer
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: "Teine vastus" })).toEqual({ kind: "closed" }); // waiting for Maria

    const COMMENT = "Kirjelda ka, kuidas kulmud puhastad.";
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "fix", comment: COMMENT } })).toEqual({ kind: "reviewed", status: "fix", completed: false });
    expect((await stored(w.client.id))[0]).toMatchObject({ status: "fix", review: { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "fix", comment: COMMENT } }, reviewedAt: NOW, reviewedBy: MARIA });
    expect(infoLog()).toContain(`[test] attempt ${attempt.id}: reviewed (fix)`);
    await flush();
    expect(toKati()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toKati()[0].subject).toBe("Vaata üle oma testi vastused");
    expect(toKati()[0].text).toContain(`${SITE}/konto/kursus/e-kulm/test`);
    expect(toKati()[0].text).not.toContain(COMMENT); // her comment is on the page only
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW)).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "fix" }, last: { review: { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "fix", comment: COMMENT } } } });

    // the rewrite: only the "Paranda" answer may change
    const later = deps(LATER);
    expect(await resubmitAnswers(later.d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", attempt.id, { ...answers, [Q1.id]: ["o0000011"], [OPEN.id]: "Uus vastus" })).toEqual({ kind: "changed" });
    expect(await resubmitAnswers(later.d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", attempt.id, { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: " " })).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "incomplete" });
    expect(await resubmitAnswers(later.d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", 999_999, { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: "Uus vastus" })).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
    const NEW = "Puhastan kulmud, kuivatan ja määran kuju.";
    const rewritten = viewOf(await resubmitAnswers(later.d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", attempt.id, { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: NEW }));
    expect(rewritten).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "review" }, triesLeft: 2, last: { id: attempt.id, number: 1, status: "review", answers: { [OPEN.id]: NEW } } });
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toHaveLength(1); // the same attempt: no try used
    expect((await stored(w.client.id))[0].submittedAt).toEqual(LATER);
    expect(later.queued()).toBe(1);
    // the same rewrite again (a double tap): nothing written, no second notice
    viewOf(await resubmitAnswers(later.d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", attempt.id, { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: NEW }));
    expect(later.queued()).toBe(1);
    await later.flush();
    expect(toMaria()).toHaveLength(2);

    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "ok", comment: "" } })).toEqual({ kind: "reviewed", status: "passed", completed: true });
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toEqual(NOW);
    await flush();
    // the course is completed: its own mail, not "Test on sooritatud"
    expect(toKati().map((m) => m.subject)).toEqual(["Vaata üle oma testi vastused", expect.stringContaining("Palju õnne!")]);
  });

  test("a review is refused without a verdict for every open answer, or a 'Paranda' without its comment; stale once not waiting; notFound for an unknown attempt or a revoked access; Review Focus 4: an ended access is still reviewed", async () => {
    const w = await world({ questions: [Q1, Q2, OPEN], points: ["Kulmude kuju"] });
    const { d, flush } = deps();
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...RIGHT, [OPEN.id]: ANSWER }));
    const [attempt] = await stored(w.client.id);
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, {})).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "incomplete" });
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "fix", comment: "  " } })).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "comment" });
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "fix", comment: "x".repeat(2001) } })).toEqual({ kind: "invalid", error: "tooLong" });
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, 999_999, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "ok", comment: "" } })).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
    expect((await stored(w.client.id))[0]).toMatchObject({ status: "review", review: null, reviewedAt: null });

    // the access ends meanwhile: Maria still reviews it (spec §8)
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - 1000) });
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "ok", comment: "" } })).toEqual({ kind: "reviewed", status: "passed", completed: false });
    await flush();
    expect(toKati()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toKati()[0].subject).toBe("Test on sooritatud");
    expect(toKati()[0].text).toContain(`${SITE}/konto/kursus/e-kulm/praktiline`);
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "ok", comment: "" } })).toEqual({ kind: "stale" }); // reviewed already (her other device)
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: NOW });
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "ok", comment: "" } })).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
  });
});

describe("reopenTest", () => {
  test("'Ava test uuesti' adds the course's tries once they are used up and mails the student; otherwise not needed; an unknown or revoked access is notFound", async () => {
    const w = await world({ tries: 1 });
    const { d, flush } = deps();
    expect(await reopenTest(d, MARIA, w.access.id)).toEqual({ kind: "notNeeded" }); // no attempt yet
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG));
    await flush(); // Maria's "Testi katsed otsas"
    expect(await reopenTest(d, MARIA, w.access.id)).toEqual({ kind: "reopened", triesLeft: 1 });
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).extraTries).toBe(1);
    expect(infoLog()).toContain(`[test] access ${w.access.id}: reopened`);
    await flush();
    expect(toKati()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toKati()[0].subject).toBe("Test on sinu jaoks uuesti avatud");
    expect(toKati()[0].text).toContain(`${SITE}/konto/kursus/e-kulm/test`);
    expect(await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW)).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "open" }, tries: 2, triesLeft: 1 });
    expect(await reopenTest(d, MARIA, w.access.id)).toEqual({ kind: "notNeeded" });
    expect(await reopenTest(d, MARIA, 999_999)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: NOW });
    expect(await reopenTest(d, MARIA, w.access.id)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
  });
});

describe("completion by the test (spec §4.4)", () => {
  test("a pass on a course without points completes it, once, and mails 'completed' with the course's link", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const { d, queued, flush } = deps();
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", RIGHT));
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toEqual(NOW);
    expect(infoLog()).toContain(`[completion] access ${w.access.id}: completed`);
    expect(queued()).toBe(1);
    await flush();
    expect(toKati()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toKati()[0].subject).toContain("Palju õnne!");
    expect(toKati()[0].subject).toContain("Kulmude e-koolitus");
    expect(toKati()[0].text).toContain(`${SITE}/konto/kursus/e-kulm`);
    expect(toKati()[0].text).not.toContain("/praktiline");
  });

  test("a sample address completes without a mail", async () => {
    const w = await world({ email: "kati@example.test" });
    const { d, flush } = deps();
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", RIGHT));
    expect((await accessRow(w.access.id)).completedAt).toEqual(NOW);
    await flush();
    expect(mails()).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("Review Focus 2: two submits at once (a double tap, two devices)", () => {
  test("the same answers twice at once make one attempt and one try, a failed one too; once more later (her answer lost on the way) still that one", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const { d } = deps();
    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG), submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG)]);
    expect([a.kind, b.kind]).toEqual(["submitted", "submitted"]);
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(viewOf(a)).toMatchObject({ triesLeft: 2, last: { number: 1, status: "failed" } });
    expect(viewOf(b)).toMatchObject({ triesLeft: 2, last: { number: 1, status: "failed" } });
    expect(viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG))).toMatchObject({ triesLeft: 2 });
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("open answers: one attempt waiting for Maria and one notice; a second device's other answers are closed meanwhile", async () => {
    const w = await world({ questions: [Q1, Q2, OPEN] });
    const { d, queued } = deps();
    const answers = { ...RIGHT, [OPEN.id]: ANSWER };
    await Promise.all([submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", answers), submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", answers)]);
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toMatchObject([{ number: 1, status: "review" }]);
    expect(queued()).toBe(1);
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: "Teise seadme vastus" })).toEqual({ kind: "closed" });
    expect(queued()).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe("Review Focus 3: Maria changes the test while a student is on it", () => {
  test("a submit made for the old questions is refused as changed: no try used, nothing written; an earlier attempt keeps its own copy", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const { d } = deps();
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", WRONG)); // attempt 1, on Q1 and Q2
    await db.update(courseTests).set({ questions: [Q1, Q4] }).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, w.course.id)); // Maria's edit
    expect(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", RIGHT)).toEqual({ kind: "changed" });
    expect(await stored(w.client.id)).toHaveLength(1);
    const view = (await testView(db, w.client.id, "e-kulm", NOW))!;
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ state: { kind: "open" }, triesLeft: 2 });
    expect(view.questions).toEqual(publicQuestions([Q1, Q4])); // a new attempt answers the questions as they are now
    expect(view.last!.questions).toEqual(publicQuestions([Q1, Q2])); // the attempt shows the copy it answered
    expect((await stored(w.client.id))[0].questions).toEqual([Q1, Q2]);
    expect(viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", { [Q1.id]: ["o0000012"], [Q4.id]: ["o0000041"] })).last).toMatchObject({ number: 2, status: "passed" });
  });

  test("a 'Paranda' rewrite is checked against the attempt's own copy, whatever the course's questions are now", async () => {
    const w = await world({ questions: [Q1, Q2, OPEN] });
    const { d } = deps();
    const answers = { ...RIGHT, [OPEN.id]: ANSWER };
    viewOf(await submitAttempt(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", answers));
    const [attempt] = await stored(w.client.id);
    expect(await reviewAttempt(d, MARIA, attempt.id, { [OPEN.id]: { verdict: "fix", comment: "Lisa puhastamine." } })).toMatchObject({ kind: "reviewed", status: "fix" });
    await db.update(courseTests).set({ questions: [Q4] }).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, w.course.id));
    const rewritten = viewOf(await resubmitAnswers(d, w.client.id, "e-kulm", attempt.id, { ...answers, [OPEN.id]: "Puhastan, kuivatan ja määran kuju." }));
    expect(rewritten.last).toMatchObject({ id: attempt.id, status: "review" });
    expect(rewritten.last!.questions).toEqual(publicQuestions([Q1, Q2, OPEN]));
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create** `src/server/test-attempts.ts`:

```ts
import { and, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { courseAccess, protocols, testAttempts, type AttemptStatus, type OpenReview, type TestAnswers, type TestAttempt } from "@/db/schema";
import {
  checkAnswers, checkReview, fixAnswers, grade, percentOf, publicQuestions, readQuestions, reviewStatus, submitStatus, testState, triesAllowed,
  type PublicQuestion, type TestState,
} from "@/domain/completion";
import { pick, type I18n } from "@/i18n/field";
import type { CompletionMailKind } from "./account-mail";
import { accessFor, completeIfDone, completionJob, courseSetup, isActive, lockAccess, mailCompletion, type AccessWithCourse, type CompletionJob, type CourseSetup } from "./completion";
import { courseOutline } from "./lesson-outline";
import { testReviewSummary, triesUsedSummary, type CompletionNotice, type Summary } from "./messages";
import { adminUrl, notifyMaria, type Env } from "./notify";

// The knowledge test (e-course completion, spec §3.3, §4.2, §5.4, D2, D3), without Next.js: the student's view and her submits (account-api.ts
// takes the client from the session), Maria's review and "Ava test uuesti" (the admin's server actions). Every write is ONE transaction that
// locks the course_access row first (completion.ts lockAccess) and then reads the attempts, so two submits at once (a double tap, two devices)
// run one after the other and the second sees the first's attempt; the unique (client, course, number) index is the backstop. The student is only
// ever served publicQuestions (no answer key), and the result names the wrong questions' numbers, never the right options. An attempt keeps a
// frozen copy of the questions it answered: a later edit of the course never changes it, and a submit made for other questions than the
// course's current ones is refused as `changed` (no try, nothing written). Mails and Maria's notices go after the commit (`later`). Logs carry ids.

export type TestDeps = { db: Db; env: Env; siteUrl: string; now: Date; later: (task: () => Promise<unknown>) => void };

export type AttemptView = {
  id: number;
  number: number;
  status: AttemptStatus;
  percent: number;
  wrong: number[];
  /** The attempt's frozen copy, public. */
  questions: PublicQuestion[];
  answers: TestAnswers;
  review: OpenReview | null;
  submittedAt: string;
};

export type TestView = {
  course: { slug: string; title: I18n };
  state: TestState;
  passPercent: number;
  /** The tries allowed: the course's and extra_tries ("Katse 2/3"). */
  tries: number;
  /** The tries allowed less the attempts made, at least 0. */
  triesLeft: number;
  /** The course's current questions (for a new attempt). */
  questions: PublicQuestion[];
  /** The newest attempt. */
  last: AttemptView | null;
  /** The lessons are not done and no attempt exists. */
  locked: boolean;
  /** The access has expired (results only). */
  readOnly: boolean;
  /** The course has practical points: its protocol's own copy once one exists (spec §3.4), else the course's (the passed state links the practical page only then). */
  hasPoints: boolean;
};

export type SubmitResult =
  | { kind: "submitted"; view: TestView }
  | { kind: "changed" }
  | { kind: "invalid"; error: "incomplete" | "tooLong" }
  /** Locked, used, waiting for Maria, passed, or expired. */
  | { kind: "closed" }
  | { kind: "notFound" };

export type ReviewResult = { kind: "reviewed"; status: "passed" | "fix"; completed: boolean } | { kind: "invalid"; error: "incomplete" | "comment" | "tooLong" } | { kind: "stale" } | { kind: "notFound" };

type ReopenResult = { kind: "reopened"; triesLeft: number } | { kind: "notNeeded" } | { kind: "notFound" };

/** Work for after the commit: Maria's notice, the student's mail. */
type Task = () => Promise<void>;
/** What a transaction answers: the result, and what goes out once it is committed. */
type Done<R> = { result: R; after: Task[] };

/** Two answers to one question alike: the same text, or the same options in any order. */
function sameAnswer(a: string[] | string | undefined, b: string[] | string | undefined): boolean {
  if (typeof a === "string" || typeof b === "string") return a === b;
  if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;
  const x = [...a].sort();
  const y = [...b].sort();
  return x.every((v, i) => v === y[i]);
}

const sameAnswers = (a: TestAnswers, b: TestAnswers): boolean => {
  const keys = Object.keys(a);
  return keys.length === Object.keys(b).length && keys.every((k) => sameAnswer(a[k], b[k]));
};

/** Two JSON values alike, whatever the order of their keys (jsonb keeps its own). */
function sameJson(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
  if (Array.isArray(a) || Array.isArray(b)) return Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => sameJson(x, b[i]));
  if (a !== null && b !== null && typeof a === "object" && typeof b === "object") {
    const ka = Object.keys(a);
    return ka.length === Object.keys(b).length && ka.every((k) => sameJson((a as Record<string, unknown>)[k], (b as Record<string, unknown>)[k]));
  }
  return a === b;
}

/** Her attempts at the course, newest first. */
const attemptsOf = (db: Db, access: { clientId: number; courseId: number }) =>
  db.select().from(testAttempts).where(and(eq(testAttempts.clientId, access.clientId), eq(testAttempts.courseId, access.courseId))).orderBy(desc(testAttempts.number));

/** An attempt as she sees it: graded from its own copy, which is all it shows. */
function attemptView(a: TestAttempt): AttemptView {
  const questions = readQuestions(a.questions);
  return {
    id: a.id,
    number: a.number,
    status: a.status,
    percent: percentOf(a.correct, a.total),
    wrong: grade(questions, a.answers).wrong,
    questions: publicQuestions(questions),
    answers: a.answers,
    review: a.review,
    submittedAt: a.submittedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

/** The test page's data for one access (read inside a write's transaction too, so it shows that write). */
async function buildView(db: Db, access: AccessWithCourse, setup: CourseSetup, now: Date): Promise<TestView> {
  const [rows, outline, [protocol]] = await Promise.all([
    attemptsOf(db, access),
    courseOutline(db, access.courseId, access.clientId),
    db.select({ stages: protocols.stages }).from(protocols).where(eq(protocols.accessId, access.id)).limit(1),
  ]);
  const allowed = triesAllowed(setup.tries, access.extraTries);
  return {
    course: { slug: access.course.slug, title: access.course.title },
    state: testState(rows, allowed),
    passPercent: setup.passPercent,
    tries: allowed,
    triesLeft: Math.max(0, allowed - rows.length),
    questions: publicQuestions(setup.questions),
    last: rows[0] ? attemptView(rows[0]) : null,
    locked: rows.length === 0 && outline.progress.done < outline.progress.total,
    readOnly: !isActive(access, now),
    hasPoints: protocol ? protocol.stages.length > 0 : setup.points.length > 0,
  };
}

/** Maria's notice about a student (Task 2's summaries): her name, or her address when she gave none. */
const noticeOf = (job: CompletionJob): CompletionNotice => ({ accessId: job.accessId, name: job.name.trim() || job.email, email: job.email, course: pick(job.course, "et") });

/** Maria's notice by mail and Telegram (spec §6), Reply-To the student; logged by the attempt's id only. */
async function notify(deps: TestDeps, label: string, s: Summary, replyTo: string): Promise<void> {
  const r = await notifyMaria(deps.env, s.subject, s.text, { short: s.short, replyTo, siteUrl: deps.siteUrl });
  console.info(`${label}: Maria notified by e-mail: ${r.mail}, Telegram: ${r.telegram}`);
}

const queue = (deps: TestDeps, after: readonly Task[]): void => {
  for (const task of after) deps.later(task);
};

/** null: no access (any state but revoked is shown; revoked → null), a contact course, or a course without questions. */
export async function testView(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string, now: Date): Promise<TestView | null> {
  const access = await accessFor(db, clientId, slug);
  if (!access || access.revokedAt !== null) return null;
  const setup = await courseSetup(db, access.courseId);
  if (setup.questions.length === 0) return null;
  return buildView(db, access, setup, now);
}

/**
 * A new attempt (spec §3.3, §4.2): lock the access, check it is active, check the answers against the course's CURRENT questions (other ids:
 * `changed`, no try, nothing written), then the state and the tries; grade, insert with the copy, and after the commit notify Maria when it
 * waits for her ("review") or when it was the last try ("used"), and mail "completed" when the pass completed the course. A repeat — the same
 * answers to the same questions as her newest attempt (a double tap, a second device, a retry whose answer was lost) — is answered with the view
 * as it is and writes nothing: the same answers grade the same, so a new attempt would only use a try (Review Focus 2). `raw`: the body's answers.
 */
export async function submitAttempt(deps: TestDeps, clientId: number, slug: string, raw: unknown): Promise<SubmitResult> {
  const peek = await accessFor(deps.db, clientId, slug);
  if (!peek || peek.revokedAt !== null) return { kind: "notFound" };
  const done = await deps.db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<Done<SubmitResult> & { attempt?: { id: number; status: AttemptStatus } }> => {
    const t = tx as unknown as Db;
    const stop = (result: SubmitResult): Done<SubmitResult> => ({ result, after: [] });
    const locked = await lockAccess(t, peek.id);
    if (!locked || locked.revokedAt !== null) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    const access: AccessWithCourse = { ...locked, course: peek.course };
    const setup = await courseSetup(t, access.courseId);
    if (setup.questions.length === 0) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    if (!isActive(access, deps.now)) return stop({ kind: "closed" });
    const answers = checkAnswers(setup.questions, raw);
    if (!answers.ok) return stop(answers.error === "changed" ? { kind: "changed" } : { kind: "invalid", error: answers.error });
    const rows = await attemptsOf(t, access);
    const newest = rows[0];
    if (newest && sameAnswers(newest.answers, answers.answers) && sameJson(readQuestions(newest.questions), setup.questions))
      return stop({ kind: "submitted", view: await buildView(t, access, setup, deps.now) });
    const allowed = triesAllowed(setup.tries, access.extraTries);
    const state = testState(rows, allowed);
    if (state.kind !== "none" && state.kind !== "open") return stop({ kind: "closed" });
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      // the test opens once every lesson is done (spec D5); once an attempt exists, a lesson added later never locks it again (§4.4)
      const { progress } = await courseOutline(t, access.courseId, access.clientId);
      if (progress.done < progress.total) return stop({ kind: "closed" });
    }
    const graded = grade(setup.questions, answers.answers);
    const status = submitStatus(setup.questions, graded.correct, graded.total, setup.passPercent);
    const [row] = await tx
      .insert(testAttempts)
      .values({
        clientId: access.clientId,
        courseId: access.courseId,
        number: (newest?.number ?? 0) + 1,
        questions: setup.questions,
        answers: answers.answers,
        correct: graded.correct,
        total: graded.total,
        status,
        submittedAt: deps.now,
      })
      .returning();
    const completed = status === "passed" && (await completeIfDone(t, access.id, deps.now));
    const view = await buildView(t, access, setup, deps.now);
    const job = await completionJob(t, access.id);
    const after: Task[] = [];
    if (job) {
      const label = `[test] attempt ${row.id}`;
      if (status === "review") after.push(() => notify(deps, label, testReviewSummary({ ...noticeOf(job), attemptId: row.id, number: row.number }, adminUrl(deps.siteUrl)), job.email));
      if (view.state.kind === "used") after.push(() => notify(deps, label, triesUsedSummary({ ...noticeOf(job), tries: allowed }, adminUrl(deps.siteUrl)), job.email));
      if (completed) after.push(() => mailCompletion(deps.env, deps.siteUrl, job, "completed"));
    }
    return { result: { kind: "submitted", view }, after, attempt: { id: row.id, status } };
  });
  if (done.attempt) console.info(`[test] attempt ${done.attempt.id}: submitted (${done.attempt.status})`);
  queue(deps, done.after);
  return done.result;
}

/**
 * The "Paranda" answers rewritten (spec §4.2, §3.3): the same attempt, checked against its OWN copy of the questions (an edit of the course since
 * does not matter); only the answers Maria marked "fix" may change, every other one must be as stored (else `changed`). The attempt goes back to
 * "review" with its new answers and time; no try is used; Maria is notified again after the commit. The same rewrite again while it waits is a
 * repeat: the view, nothing written, no second notice.
 */
export async function resubmitAnswers(deps: TestDeps, clientId: number, slug: string, attemptId: number, raw: unknown): Promise<SubmitResult> {
  const peek = await accessFor(deps.db, clientId, slug);
  if (!peek || peek.revokedAt !== null) return { kind: "notFound" };
  const done = await deps.db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<Done<SubmitResult> & { rewritten?: number }> => {
    const t = tx as unknown as Db;
    const stop = (result: SubmitResult): Done<SubmitResult> => ({ result, after: [] });
    const locked = await lockAccess(t, peek.id);
    if (!locked || locked.revokedAt !== null) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    const access: AccessWithCourse = { ...locked, course: peek.course };
    const [attempt] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(testAttempts)
      .where(and(eq(testAttempts.id, attemptId), eq(testAttempts.clientId, access.clientId), eq(testAttempts.courseId, access.courseId)))
      .limit(1);
    if (!attempt) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    if (!isActive(access, deps.now)) return stop({ kind: "closed" });
    const questions = readQuestions(attempt.questions);
    const answers = checkAnswers(questions, raw);
    if (!answers.ok) return stop(answers.error === "changed" ? { kind: "changed" } : { kind: "invalid", error: answers.error });
    const setup = await courseSetup(t, access.courseId);
    if (attempt.status === "review" && sameAnswers(attempt.answers, answers.answers)) return stop({ kind: "submitted", view: await buildView(t, access, setup, deps.now) });
    if (attempt.status !== "fix") return stop({ kind: "closed" });
    const open = new Set(fixAnswers(attempt.review));
    if (questions.some((q) => !open.has(q.id) && !sameAnswer(attempt.answers[q.id], answers.answers[q.id]))) return stop({ kind: "changed" });
    await tx.update(testAttempts).set({ answers: answers.answers, status: "review", submittedAt: deps.now }).where(eq(testAttempts.id, attempt.id));
    const view = await buildView(t, access, setup, deps.now);
    const job = await completionJob(t, access.id);
    const after: Task[] = job
      ? [() => notify(deps, `[test] attempt ${attempt.id}`, testReviewSummary({ ...noticeOf(job), attemptId: attempt.id, number: attempt.number }, adminUrl(deps.siteUrl)), job.email)]
      : [];
    return { result: { kind: "submitted", view }, after, rewritten: attempt.id };
  });
  if (done.rewritten !== undefined) console.info(`[test] attempt ${done.rewritten}: rewritten (review)`);
  queue(deps, done.after);
  return done.result;
}

/**
 * Maria's review of an attempt in "review" (spec §5.4), else `stale` (reviewed already, on her other device): lock the access, store the review,
 * when and by whom, and the status (every open answer "ok": passed, else fix); a pass may complete the course. After the commit the student's
 * mail: "completed" when it completed the course, "testFix" for a rewrite, "testPassed" when the practical work is next (a course with points).
 * An expired access is still reviewed (spec §8); a revoked one is notFound. `raw`: the review form's verdicts and comments.
 */
export async function reviewAttempt(deps: TestDeps, adminEmail: string, attemptId: number, raw: unknown): Promise<ReviewResult> {
  const [peek] = await deps.db
    .select({ accessId: courseAccess.id })
    .from(testAttempts)
    .innerJoin(courseAccess, and(eq(courseAccess.clientId, testAttempts.clientId), eq(courseAccess.courseId, testAttempts.courseId)))
    .where(eq(testAttempts.id, attemptId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!peek) return { kind: "notFound" };
  const done = await deps.db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<Done<ReviewResult>> => {
    const t = tx as unknown as Db;
    const stop = (result: ReviewResult): Done<ReviewResult> => ({ result, after: [] });
    const access = await lockAccess(t, peek.accessId);
    if (!access || access.revokedAt !== null) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    const [attempt] = await tx.select().from(testAttempts).where(eq(testAttempts.id, attemptId)).limit(1);
    if (!attempt) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    if (attempt.status !== "review") return stop({ kind: "stale" });
    const review = checkReview(readQuestions(attempt.questions), raw);
    if (!review.ok) return stop({ kind: "invalid", error: review.error });
    const status = reviewStatus(review.review);
    await tx.update(testAttempts).set({ review: review.review, status, reviewedAt: deps.now, reviewedBy: adminEmail }).where(eq(testAttempts.id, attemptId));
    const completed = status === "passed" && (await completeIfDone(t, access.id, deps.now));
    const job = await completionJob(t, access.id);
    const kind: CompletionMailKind | null = completed ? "completed" : status === "fix" ? "testFix" : job?.hasPoints ? "testPassed" : null;
    return { result: { kind: "reviewed", status, completed }, after: job && kind ? [() => mailCompletion(deps.env, deps.siteUrl, job, kind)] : [] };
  });
  if (done.result.kind === "reviewed") console.info(`[test] attempt ${attemptId}: reviewed (${done.result.status})`);
  queue(deps, done.after);
  return done.result;
}

/**
 * "Ava test uuesti" (spec §5.2, D3): when every allowed try failed ("used"), extra_tries grows by the course's tries, and after the commit the
 * student gets "reopened"; otherwise `notNeeded`. Under the access lock, so two taps add the tries once (the second finds the test open). A
 * revoked access is notFound. `adminEmail`: the admin who asked (course_access has no column for it; the reopen shows as extra_tries).
 */
export async function reopenTest(deps: TestDeps, adminEmail: string, accessId: number): Promise<ReopenResult> {
  const done = await deps.db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<Done<ReopenResult>> => {
    const t = tx as unknown as Db;
    const stop = (result: ReopenResult): Done<ReopenResult> => ({ result, after: [] });
    const access = await lockAccess(t, accessId);
    if (!access || access.revokedAt !== null) return stop({ kind: "notFound" });
    const setup = await courseSetup(t, access.courseId);
    const rows = await attemptsOf(t, access);
    const allowed = triesAllowed(setup.tries, access.extraTries);
    if (testState(rows, allowed).kind !== "used") return stop({ kind: "notNeeded" });
    await tx.update(courseAccess).set({ extraTries: access.extraTries + setup.tries }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId));
    const job = await completionJob(t, accessId);
    return {
      result: { kind: "reopened", triesLeft: Math.max(0, allowed + setup.tries - rows.length) },
      after: job ? [() => mailCompletion(deps.env, deps.siteUrl, job, "reopened")] : [],
    };
  });
  if (done.result.kind === "reopened") console.info(`[test] access ${accessId}: reopened`);
  queue(deps, done.after);
  return done.result;
}
```

### Task 6: The student's test — `GET|POST /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/test`, `POST …/test/uuesti`, the static `/konto/kursus/<slug>/test` shell, `TestPage`

Spec §4.2 (the test page), §4 intro (static shells, `private, no-store`, a revoked access answers 404, an expired one is read-only), §7 (the routes, test submits 10 an hour), §9 (gate). Review Focus 3 and 5. Rulings: R1 (the questions live in `course_tests`; the student only ever gets `publicQuestions`), R5's rule that an account page has no query (the course is in the path).

**The routes are matched before the lesson paths.** `GET /kursus/<slug>/test` already matches `LESSON_PATH` today (its lesson group is `[^/]+`) and answers 404 (`parseRowId("test")` is null). `TEST_PATH` is tried first, and a test path with a method it does not have answers 404 there, never falling through to the lessons.

**The page.** One screen, one plain next-step sentence, one primary button:
- locked (the lessons not done, no attempt): "Avaneb, kui kõik õppetunnid on tehtud." and "Tagasi koolitusele";
- none / open after "Proovi uuesti": the questions, numbered, "Katse {n}/{max}", "Esita test" → an inline confirmation "Kas esitad testi? Katse {n}/{max}." (not `window.confirm`: a phone's native dialog is not styled and a test cannot drive it);
- open (her last try failed): "Said {percent} %, vaja {pass} %. Valesti vastatud: {list}." and "Proovi uuesti ({n} katset jäänud)";
- used: the last result and "Katsed on otsas. Maria sai teate ja avab testi sulle uuesti.";
- review: "Ootab Maria hinnangut" and her answers, read-only;
- fix: Maria's comment under each answer to rewrite, the rest read-only, "Saada uuesti" (uses no try, so no confirmation);
- passed: "Test on sooritatud" and "Ava praktiline töö" (a course with points), else "Tagasi koolitusele";
- readOnly (the access has ended): her results only.

Her answers wait in `localStorage` `mslab-test:<slug>` (`{ answers, at }`) until an attempt is accepted. A `changed` refusal shows "Test on vahepeal muutunud, laadi leht uuesti" with the reload as the one button; the reload keeps the stored answers of the questions (and options) that still exist and sends only those.

```ts
/** One request to /api/konto<path>: GET without a body, POST with one (a string goes as it is), or `method`. */
async function call(cookie: string | null, path: string, body?: unknown, method?: string): Promise<Response> {
  const init: RequestInit = {
    method: method ?? (body === undefined ? "GET" : "POST"),
    headers: cookie ? { cookie } : {},
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : typeof body === "string" ? body : JSON.stringify(body),
  };
  return (await handleAccountApi(new Request(`${SITE}/api/konto${path}`, init), deps()))!;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The answer to a test submit or rewrite (test-attempts.ts SubmitResult): 200 `{ ok: true, ...TestView }` with the outcome; 409 `changed` (the
 * questions changed since the page loaded) or `closed`; 400 `incomplete` or `tooLong`; 404.
 */
function testAnswer(session: ClientSession, result: SubmitResult): Response {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case "submitted":
      return clientResponse(session, { ok: true, ...result.view });
    case "changed":
    case "closed":
      return clientResponse(session, { ok: false, error: result.kind }, 409);
    case "invalid":
      return clientResponse(session, { ok: false, error: result.error }, 400);
    default:
      return clientResponse(session, { ok: false }, 404);
  }
}

/** The attempt id of a rewrite's body: a positive integer the database can hold, or null. */
```

```ts

/**
 * GET /kursus/:slug/test (e-course completion, spec §4.2): the student's knowledge test (test-attempts.ts TestView) — the course's questions
 * without their answer key, the state and the tries left, her newest attempt (its own copy of the questions, her answers, the score, the
 * numbers of the choice questions she got wrong, Maria's review). 404 without the access (a revoked one too), for a contact course and for
 * a course without questions.
 */
async function testPage(request: Request, deps: AccountDeps, rawSlug: string): Promise<Response> {
  const session = await requireClient(request, deps);
  if (session instanceof Response) return session;
  const slug = parseSlug(rawSlug);
  const view = slug === null ? null : await testView(deps.db, session.clientId, slug, deps.now);
  return view ? clientResponse(session, { ok: true, ...view }) : clientResponse(session, { ok: false }, 404);
}

/**
 * POST /kursus/:slug/test `{ answers }` (spec §4.2): a new attempt, graded at once (test-attempts.ts submitAttempt, under the access's lock:
 * a double tap or a second device makes one try; the newest attempt's own answers sent again to unchanged questions are that attempt: its
 * view, nothing written). 200 `{ ok: true, ...TestView }` with the outcome; 409 `{ error: "changed" }` (Maria changed
 * the questions since the page loaded: no try used, nothing stored) or `{ error: "closed" }` (locked, waiting for Maria, passed, out of
 * tries, or the access has ended); 400 `{ error: "incomplete" | "tooLong" | "answers" }`; 429 `{ error: "rate" }` after 10 in an hour; 404.
 */
async function submitTest(request: Request, deps: AccountDeps, rawSlug: string): Promise<Response> {
  const session = await requireClient(request, deps);
  if (session instanceof Response) return session;
  const slug = parseSlug(rawSlug);
  if (slug === null) return clientResponse(session, { ok: false }, 404);
  const body = await readObject(request, TEST_BODY_CHARS);
  if (body === null) return badInput(session, "answers");
  const limited = await testLimited(deps, session);
  if (limited) return limited;
  return testAnswer(session, await submitAttempt(deps, session.clientId, slug, body.answers));
}

/**
 * POST /kursus/:slug/test/uuesti `{ attemptId, answers }` (spec §4.2): the answers Maria marked "Paranda" rewritten (test-attempts.ts
 * resubmitAnswers: the same attempt back to her review, no try used). The answers as POST /kursus/:slug/test's, and 400 `{ error:
 * "attemptId" }`.
 */
async function resubmitTest(request: Request, deps: AccountDeps, rawSlug: string): Promise<Response> {
  const session = await requireClient(request, deps);
  if (session instanceof Response) return session;
  const slug = parseSlug(rawSlug);
  if (slug === null) return clientResponse(session, { ok: false }, 404);
  const body = await readObject(request, TEST_BODY_CHARS);
  if (body === null) return badInput(session, "answers");
  const attemptId = attemptIdOf(body.attemptId);
  if (attemptId === null) return badInput(session, "attemptId");
  const limited = await testLimited(deps, session);
  if (limited) return limited;
  return testAnswer(session, await resubmitAnswers(deps, session.clientId, slug, attemptId, body.answers));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The page.**
  1. Create `src/components/account/TestPage.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/site/Icon";
import { Notice } from "@/components/site/Notice";
import ui from "@/components/site/ui.module.css";
import type { TestAnswers } from "@/db/schema";
import { TEST_LIMITS, type PublicQuestion } from "@/domain/completion";
import { pick } from "@/i18n/field";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { href } from "@/i18n/href";
import type { Locale } from "@/i18n/locales";
import { isDone, sendJson } from "@/lib/json-request";
import type { AttemptView, TestView } from "@/server/test-attempts";
import { AccountLoader, type Reload } from "./AccountLoader";
import { GreetingSkeleton } from "./CardSkeleton";
import type { TestTexts } from "./texts";
import page from "./AccountPage.module.css";
import styles from "./TestPage.module.css";

// The student's knowledge test (e-course completion, spec §4.2). This file runs on the students' phones: no lookbehind here nor in what it
// imports (tests/unit/old-safari.test.ts).

/** GET /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/test's answer, and an accepted submit's: the test as it stands for her. */
type TestAnswer = TestView & { ok: true };

/** Why a submit did not go through: the line under the questions. */
type Problem = "incomplete" | "tooLong" | "changed" | "rate" | "failed";

/** Her unsent answers in this browser, per course (spec §4.2): `{ answers, at }`, kept until an attempt is accepted, so a reload loses nothing. */
export const draftKey = (slug: string): string => `mslab-test:${slug}`;

/** The draft's answers; anything else in the store (another shape, a store that is off) is no draft. Never throws. */
function readDraft(slug: string): TestAnswers {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(draftKey(slug));
    const answers: unknown = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as { answers?: unknown } | null)?.answers : null;
    if (typeof answers !== "object" || answers === null || Array.isArray(answers)) return {};
    const out: TestAnswers = {};
    for (const [id, a] of Object.entries(answers)) {
      if (typeof a === "string") out[id] = a;
      else if (Array.isArray(a) && a.every((x) => typeof x === "string")) out[id] = a as string[];
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function writeDraft(slug: string, answers: TestAnswers): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(draftKey(slug), JSON.stringify({ answers, at: new Date().toISOString() }));
  } catch {
    // a private window or a full store: the page still works, only a reload would lose the answers
  }
}

function clearDraft(slug: string): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(draftKey(slug));
  } catch {
    // as above
  }
}

/**
 * The answers of `from` that fit `questions`, in their order: a choice keeps the options still there (one for a single-answer question), an
 * open question its text; answers to questions that are gone are left out. What a changed test (Maria's edit) keeps of a draft, and what a
 * submit sends.
 */
function fitting(questions: readonly PublicQuestion[], from: TestAnswers): TestAnswers {
  const out: TestAnswers = {};
  for (const q of questions) {
    const a = from[q.id];
    if (q.kind === "open") {
      if (typeof a === "string") out[q.id] = a;
    } else if (Array.isArray(a)) {
      const known = q.options.filter((o) => a.includes(o.id)).map((o) => o.id);
      const kept = q.multiple ? known : known.slice(0, 1);
      if (kept.length > 0) out[q.id] = kept;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const answered = (q: PublicQuestion, a: string[] | string | undefined): boolean => (q.kind === "open" ? typeof a === "string" && a.trim() !== "" : Array.isArray(a) && a.length > 0);

/** What the questions and the state are: a new answer that changes them starts the page's body afresh (its form reads the draft again). */
const shapeOf = (v: TestView): string =>
  [v.state.kind, v.last?.id ?? 0, ...v.questions.map((q) => (q.kind === "choice" ? `${q.id}:${q.options.map((o) => o.id).join(".")}` : q.id))].join(",");

/**
 * The personal part of /konto/kursus/<slug>/test (the page is a static shell, the same for every visitor): loads GET
 * /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/test in the browser (AccountLoader: skeleton, signed out → the login page, another device, error + retry). No
 * test for her (no access, a revoked one, a course without questions): "Seda testi ei leitud." with the way back to the course.
 */
export function TestPage({ slug, locale, t }: { slug: string; locale: Locale; t: TestTexts }) {
  const course = href(locale, `/konto/kursus/${slug}`);
  return (
    <AccountLoader<TestAnswer>
      path={`/api/konto/kursus/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/test`}
      locale={locale}
      t={{ ...t.loader, loading: t.loading }}
      skeleton={
        <div className={`${ui.wrap} ${page.wait}`}>
          <GreetingSkeleton />
        </div>
      }
      notFound={
        <div data-account-state="noTest">
          <Notice title={t.notFound}>
            <Link className={ui.btn} href={course}>
              {t.back}
              <Icon name="arrow" />
            </Link>
          </Notice>
        </div>
      }
      render={(data, reload) => <TestBody key={shapeOf(data)} data={data} slug={slug} locale={locale} t={t} reload={reload} />}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * The test as it stands, one plain sentence and at most one primary button per state (phase 2a spec 2.1 rule 5): locked (the lessons not
 * done) → the way back; none → the questions; open (the last try failed) → her score, then "Proovi uuesti" → the questions again; used →
 * Maria's promise; review → "Ootab Maria hinnangut" with her answers; fix → the answers to rewrite; passed → the practical work (a course
 * with points) or the course; readOnly (the access has ended) → her results only. An accepted submit's answer replaces the view, and the
 * focus goes to its outcome (the button she pressed is gone).
 */
function TestBody({ data, slug, locale, t, reload }: { data: TestAnswer; slug: string; locale: Locale; t: TestTexts; reload: Reload }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<TestAnswer>(data);
  const [retrying, setRetrying] = useState(false);
  const status = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const moved = useRef(false);
  const api = `/api/konto/kursus/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/test`;
  const courseHref = href(locale, `/konto/kursus/${slug}`);
  const { last } = view;
  const kind = view.locked ? "locked" : view.readOnly ? "readOnly" : view.state.kind;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!moved.current) return;
    moved.current = false;
    status.current?.focus();
  }, [view]);

  const accepted = (next: TestAnswer) => {
    moved.current = true;
    setRetrying(false);
    setView(next);
  };

  /** The outcome's line: what her newest attempt came to (focused after a submit). */
  const outcome = (text: string, wrong?: number[]) => (
    <p ref={status} className={styles.status} tabIndex={-1} data-test-result="" data-test-wrong={wrong?.join(",")}>
      {text}
    </p>
  );
  const failedLine = (a: AttemptView) => outcome(fill(t.result, { percent: a.percent, pass: view.passPercent, list: a.wrong.join(", ") }), a.wrong);
  const lastLine = (a: AttemptView) => (a.status === "failed" ? failedLine(a) : outcome(a.status === "review" ? t.review : a.status === "fix" ? t.fix : t.passed));
  const back = (main: boolean) =>
    main ? (
      <Link className={ui.btn} href={courseHref} data-test-back="">
        {t.back}
        <Icon name="arrow" />
      </Link>
    ) : (
      <Link className={ui.btnOutline} href={courseHref} data-test-back="">
        {t.back}
      </Link>
    );
  const form = <AttemptForm view={view} slug={slug} api={api} t={t} reload={reload} onAccepted={accepted} />;

  let body: ReactNode = null;
  switch (kind) {
    case "locked":
      body = (
        <>
          <p className={styles.lead}>{t.locked}</p>
          {back(true)}
        </>
      );
      break;
    case "readOnly":
      body = (
        <>
          <p className={styles.lead}>{t.readOnly}</p>
          {last && lastLine(last)}
          {last && (last.status === "review" || last.status === "fix") && <AnswerList attempt={last} t={t} />}
          {back(true)}
        </>
      );
      break;
    case "none":
      body = form;
      break;
    case "open":
      body =
        retrying || !last ? (
          form
        ) : (
          <>
            {failedLine(last)}
            <button type="button" className={ui.btn} onClick={() => setRetrying(true)} data-test-retry="">
              {view.triesLeft === 1 ? t.retryOne : fill(t.retry, { n: view.triesLeft })}
            </button>
            {back(false)}
          </>
        );
      break;
    case "used":
      body = (
        <>
          {last && failedLine(last)}
          <p className={styles.lead}>{t.used}</p>
          {back(false)}
        </>
      );
      break;
    case "review":
      body = (
        <>
          {outcome(t.review)}
          <p className={styles.lead}>{t.reviewLead}</p>
          {last && <AnswerList attempt={last} t={t} />}
          {back(false)}
        </>
      );
      break;
    case "fix":
      body = last ? (
        <>
          {outcome(t.fix)}
          <FixForm attempt={last} slug={slug} api={api} t={t} reload={reload} onAccepted={accepted} />
        </>
      ) : (
        back(true)
      );
      break;
    case "passed":
      body = (
        <>
          {outcome(t.passed)}
          {view.hasPoints ? (
            <Link className={ui.btn} href={href(locale, `/konto/kursus/${slug}/praktiline`)} data-test-next="">
              {t.practical}
              <Icon name="arrow" />
            </Link>
          ) : (
            back(true)
          )}
        </>
      );
      break;
  }

  return (
    <div className={`${ui.wrap} ${page.page}`} data-test-page="" data-test-state={kind}>
      <div className={page.column}>
        <p className={styles.eyebrow}>{t.title}</p>
        <h1 className={page.title}>{pick(view.course.title, locale)}</h1>
        {body}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * One submit at a time (a second tap while one is on its way sends nothing). Accepted: the draft goes and the page shows the outcome. A
 * session that ended (401) reloads quietly (the login page, or "another device"); gone (404) or no longer open (409 closed: a second device,
 * Maria) reloads the page, which then shows what is true now. Anything else stays on the form with its line, her answers kept.
 */
function useSubmit(slug: string, reload: Reload, onAccepted: (next: TestAnswer) => void) {
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<Problem | null>(null);
  const busy = useRef(false);
  const send = async (path: string, body: object): Promise<void> => {
    if (busy.current) return;
    busy.current = true;
    setSending(true);
    setProblem(null);
    const answer = await sendJson(path, body);
    busy.current = false;
    setSending(false);
    const error = answer.data.error;
    if (isDone(answer)) {
      clearDraft(slug);
      onAccepted(answer.data as unknown as TestAnswer);
    } else if (answer.status === 401) void reload({ quiet: true });
    else if (answer.status === 404 || (answer.status === 409 && error === "closed")) void reload();
    else if (answer.status === 409 && error === "changed") setProblem("changed");
    else if (answer.status === 400 && (error === "incomplete" || error === "tooLong")) setProblem(error);
    else setProblem(answer.status === 429 ? "rate" : "failed");
  };
  return { sending, problem, setProblem, send };
}

/** The line under the questions. A changed test's: "laadi leht uuesti" with the reload as the one button (a submit would be refused again). */
function ProblemLine({ problem, t, reload }: { problem: Problem; t: TestTexts; reload: Reload }) {
  const text =
    problem === "changed" ? t.changed : problem === "incomplete" ? t.incomplete : problem === "tooLong" ? fill(t.tooLong, { max: TEST_LIMITS.answer }) : problem === "rate" ? t.rate : t.failed;
  return (
    <div className={styles.problem} role="alert" data-test-error={problem}>
      <p className={styles.problemText}>{text}</p>
      {problem === "changed" && (
        <button type="button" className={ui.btn} onClick={() => void reload()}>
          {t.reload}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * A new attempt: the course's current questions, the try's number ("Katse 2/3"), the pass mark when there are choice questions. Every answer
 * goes into the draft as she gives it. "Esita test" checks that every question is answered, then asks once more, inline (a phone's own
 * dialog is neither the site's look nor testable); only "Jah, esita" sends, and sends only the answers that fit the questions.
 */
function AttemptForm({ view, slug, api, t, reload, onAccepted }: { view: TestAnswer; slug: string; api: string; t: TestTexts; reload: Reload; onAccepted: (next: TestAnswer) => void }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const { questions } = view;
  const made = view.last?.number ?? 0;
  const n = made + 1;
  const max = made + view.triesLeft;
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<TestAnswers>(() => fitting(questions, readDraft(slug)));
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const { sending, problem, setProblem, send } = useSubmit(slug, reload, onAccepted);
  const form = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const yes = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (confirming) yes.current?.focus();
  }, [confirming]);

  const change = (id: string, value: string[] | string) => {
    const next = { ...answers, [id]: value };
    setAnswers(next);
    writeDraft(slug, next);
    if (problem === "incomplete") setProblem(null);
  };
  const ask = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const missing = questions.find((q) => !answered(q, answers[q.id]));
    if (missing) {
      setConfirming(false);
      setProblem("incomplete");
      form.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-question="${missing.id}"] input, [data-question="${missing.id}"] textarea`)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setProblem(null);
    setConfirming(true);
  };
  const confirm = async () => {
    await send(api, { answers: fitting(questions, answers) });
    setConfirming(false);
  };
  const hasChoice = questions.some((q) => q.kind === "choice");

  return (
    <form ref={form} className={styles.form} onSubmit={ask} noValidate>
      <p className={styles.lead}>{t.lead}</p>
      <p className={styles.meta}>
        {fill(t.attempt, { n, max })}
        {hasChoice && ` · ${fill(t.need, { pass: view.passPercent })}`}
      </p>
      <div className={styles.questions}>
        {questions.map((q, i) => (
          <QuestionField key={q.id} q={q} number={i + 1} value={answers[q.id]} onChange={(v) => change(q.id, v)} uid={uid} t={t} />
        ))}
      </div>
      {problem && <ProblemLine problem={problem} t={t} reload={reload} />}
      {problem === "changed" ? null : confirming ? (
        <div className={styles.confirm} data-test-confirm="">
          <p className={styles.confirmText}>{fill(t.confirm, { n, max })}</p>
          <div className={styles.actions}>
            <button ref={yes} type="button" className={ui.btn} onClick={() => void confirm()} aria-disabled={sending || undefined} data-confirm="yes">
              {sending ? t.sending : t.confirmYes}
            </button>
            <button type="button" className={ui.btnOutline} onClick={() => setConfirming(false)} data-confirm="no">
              {t.confirmNo}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button type="submit" className={ui.btn} data-test-submit="">
          {t.submit}
        </button>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * Maria's "Paranda" (spec §4.2): the attempt's own questions; the answers she marked open for rewriting with her comment under each, the
 * rest read-only. "Saada uuesti" sends the whole attempt back (the accepted answers as they were) and uses no try, so it asks nothing first.
 */
function FixForm({ attempt, slug, api, t, reload, onAccepted }: { attempt: AttemptView; slug: string; api: string; t: TestTexts; reload: Reload; onAccepted: (next: TestAnswer) => void }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const review = attempt.review ?? {};
  const toFix = attempt.questions.filter((q) => review[q.id]?.verdict === "fix").map((q) => q.id);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<TestAnswers>(() => {
    const draft = readDraft(slug);
    const out: TestAnswers = { ...attempt.answers };
    for (const id of toFix) {
      const text = draft[id];
      if (typeof text === "string") out[id] = text;
    }
    return out;
  });
  const { sending, problem, setProblem, send } = useSubmit(slug, reload, onAccepted);

  const change = (id: string, value: string[] | string) => {
    const next = { ...answers, [id]: value };
    setAnswers(next);
    writeDraft(slug, next);
    if (problem === "incomplete") setProblem(null);
  };
  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const blank = toFix.find((id) => {
      const a = answers[id];
      return typeof a !== "string" || a.trim() === "";
    });
    if (blank) {
      setProblem("incomplete");
      return;
    }
    void send(`${api}/uuesti`, { attemptId: attempt.id, answers });
  };

  return (
    <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
      <p className={styles.lead}>{t.fixLead}</p>
      <div className={styles.questions}>
        {attempt.questions.map((q, i) => {
          const open = toFix.includes(q.id);
          return (
            <QuestionField
              key={q.id}
              q={q}
              number={i + 1}
              value={answers[q.id]}
              onChange={open ? (v) => change(q.id, v) : undefined}
              uid={uid}
              t={t}
              locked={!open}
              comment={open ? review[q.id]?.comment : undefined}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {problem && <ProblemLine problem={problem} t={t} reload={reload} />}
      {problem !== "changed" && (
        <button type="submit" className={ui.btn} aria-disabled={sending || undefined} data-test-submit="">
          {sending ? t.sending : t.resubmit}
        </button>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

/** Her answers as she sent them, read-only (waiting for Maria, or after the access ended), with Maria's comment where she asked for a fix. */
function AnswerList({ attempt, t }: { attempt: AttemptView; t: TestTexts }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const review = attempt.review ?? {};
  return (
    <section className={styles.answers} aria-labelledby={`${uid}-answers`}>
      <h2 id={`${uid}-answers`} className={styles.answersTitle}>
        {t.answers}
      </h2>
      {attempt.questions.map((q, i) => (
        <QuestionField key={q.id} q={q} number={i + 1} value={attempt.answers[q.id]} uid={uid} t={t} locked comment={review[q.id]?.verdict === "fix" ? review[q.id]?.comment : undefined} />
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * One question, numbered, Maria's text as she wrote it: a choice question is a fieldset of rows, each its radio (one right option) or
 * checkbox ("Vali kõik õiged") with the option's text, the whole row the 44 px target; an open question is a text box with its count.
 * `locked`: shown, not changed (a disabled fieldset, a read-only box). `comment`: Maria's, under the answer.
 */
function QuestionField({
  q,
  number,
  value,
  onChange,
  uid,
  t,
  locked = false,
  comment,
}: {
  q: PublicQuestion;
  number: number;
  value: string[] | string | undefined;
  onChange?: (value: string[] | string) => void;
  uid: string;
  t: TestTexts;
  locked?: boolean;
  comment?: string;
}) {
  const name = `${uid}-${q.id}`;
  if (q.kind === "choice") {
    const picked = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    const toggle = (id: string, on: boolean) => {
      if (!q.multiple) return onChange?.([id]);
      const set = new Set(picked);
      if (on) set.add(id);
      else set.delete(id);
      onChange?.(q.options.filter((o) => set.has(o.id)).map((o) => o.id));
    };
    return (
      <fieldset className={styles.question} data-question={q.id} disabled={locked}>
        <legend className={styles.label}>
          {number}. {q.text}
        </legend>
        {q.multiple && <p className={styles.hint}>{t.multiple}</p>}
        <div className={styles.options}>
          {q.options.map((o) => (
            <label key={o.id} className={styles.option}>
              <input type={q.multiple ? "checkbox" : "radio"} name={name} value={o.id} checked={picked.includes(o.id)} onChange={(e) => toggle(o.id, e.target.checked)} data-answer-option={o.id} />
              <span>{o.text}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </fieldset>
    );
  }
  const text = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
  return (
    <div className={styles.question} data-question={q.id}>
      <label htmlFor={name} className={styles.label}>
        {number}. {q.text}
      </label>
      <textarea
        id={name}
        className={styles.text}
        rows={4}
        maxLength={TEST_LIMITS.answer}
        value={text}
        readOnly={locked}
        onChange={(e) => onChange?.(e.target.value)}
        aria-describedby={locked ? undefined : `${name}-count`}
        data-answer-open=""
      />
      {!locked && (
        <p id={`${name}-count`} className={styles.count}>
          {fill(t.count, { n: text.length, max: TEST_LIMITS.answer })}
        </p>
      )}
      {comment && (
        <p className={styles.comment} data-test-review-comment={q.id}>
          <span className={styles.commentLabel}>{t.comment}</span>
          {comment}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
