```ts
  height: 1365,
});
const stored = (id: number): Answer => ({ status: 200, data: { ok: true, photo: photo(id) } });

const mount = async (locale: Locale = "et") => {
  await act(async () => root.render(createElement(PracticalPage, { slug: "veebikursus", locale, t: practicalTexts(getDict(locale)) })));
  await settle();
};
/** Picks `files` with point `index`'s "Lisa foto" (the file input's change, as a phone's picker gives it). */
const pick = async (index: number, files: File[]) => {
  const input = $(`[data-point='${index}'] [data-photo-add] input[type=file]`) as HTMLInputElement | null;
  expect(input, `point ${index}'s "Lisa foto"`).not.toBeNull();
  Object.defineProperty(input, "files", { value: files, configurable: true });
  await act(async () => {
    input!.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  await settle();
};
const answer = async (i: number, a: Answer) => {
  await act(async () => sent[i].resolve(a));
  await settle();
};
const pending = () => $$("[data-photo-pending]").map((e) => e.getAttribute("data-photo-pending"));
const photos = (index: number) => $$(`[data-point='${index}'] [data-photo]`).map((e) => e.getAttribute("data-photo"));

beforeEach(() => {
  sent = [];
  reads = [view()];
  write = () => json(500, {});
  previews = 0;
  fetchMock.mockReset();
  fetchMock.mockImplementation(async (input, init) => {
    if ((init?.method ?? "GET") === "GET") return json(200, reads.length > 1 ? reads.shift()! : reads[0]);
    return write(String(input), init!.method!);
  });
  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
  upload.mockReset();
  upload.mockImplementation((path, form, onProgress, signal) => new Promise<Answer>((resolve) => sent.push({ path, form, progress: onProgress, signal, resolve })));
  prepare.mockReset();
  prepare.mockImplementation(async (file: File) => prepared(file.name));
  vi.spyOn(URL, "createObjectURL").mockImplementation(() => `blob:preview-${++previews}`);
  vi.spyOn(URL, "revokeObjectURL").mockImplementation(() => {});
  container = document.createElement("div");
  document.body.append(container);
  root = createRoot(container);
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await act(async () => root.unmount());
  container.remove();
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});

describe("photos on a phone (Review Focus 1)", () => {
  test("three photos go one at a time with their progress; the one that fails on a weak signal keeps its prepared copy for 'Proovi uuesti', the others are stored", async () => {
    await mount();
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe(API);
    await pick(0, [jpg("a.jpg"), jpg("b.jpg"), jpg("c.jpg")]);
    // one at a time: the first is made smaller and sent, the other two wait their turn
    expect(prepare).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(sent[0].path).toBe(`${API}/foto`);
    expect(pending()).toEqual(["uploading", "waiting", "waiting"]);
    const form = sent[0].form;
    expect([form.get("stage"), form.get("width"), form.get("height")]).toEqual(["0", "2048", "1365"]);
    expect((form.get("full") as File).name).toBe("foto.jpg");
    expect(await (form.get("full") as File).text()).toBe("a.jpg-full");
    expect(await (form.get("thumb") as File).text()).toBe("a.jpg-pisi");
    // its progress, as the share sent
    await act(async () => sent[0].progress(0.45));
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='uploading'] [data-photo-progress] [role=progressbar]")!.getAttribute("aria-valuenow")).toBe("45");
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='uploading']")!.textContent).toContain("Laadin üles… 45 %");
    await answer(0, stored(101));
    expect(photos(0)).toEqual(["101"]);
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(2);
    // the second one on a weak signal: no answer at all; the third goes on
    await answer(1, { status: 0, data: {} });
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(3);
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='failed']")!.textContent).toContain("Üleslaadimine ei õnnestunud.");
    await answer(2, stored(103));
    expect(photos(0)).toEqual(["101", "103"]);
    expect(pending()).toEqual(["failed"]);
    // "Proovi uuesti": the same prepared photo again — not made again, not picked again
    await click($("[data-photo-retry]"));
    expect(prepare).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(await (sent[3].form.get("full") as File).text()).toBe("b.jpg-full");
    await answer(3, stored(102));
    expect(photos(0)).toEqual(["101", "103", "102"]);
    expect(pending()).toEqual([]);
    // three photos: no more "Lisa foto" on that point; the other point keeps its own
    expect($("[data-point='0'] [data-photo-add]")).toBeNull();
    expect($("[data-point='1'] [data-photo-add]")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("a photo the browser cannot open (HEIC in Chrome) says so in its row and is never sent; it can be taken away; one too big says that", async () => {
    prepare.mockRejectedValueOnce(new ShrinkError("decode"));
    await mount();
    await pick(1, [jpg("IMG_0001.HEIC")]);
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(0);
    const row = $("[data-point='1'] [data-photo-pending='decode']")!;
    expect(row.querySelector("[role=alert]")!.textContent).toBe("Seda pilti ei saa avada. Vali JPG või PNG pilt.");
    expect(row.querySelector("[data-photo-retry]")).toBeNull();
    await click(row.querySelector("[data-photo-remove]"));
    expect(pending()).toEqual([]);
    prepare.mockRejectedValueOnce(new ShrinkError("size"));
    await pick(1, [jpg("suur.jpg")]);
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='tooBig'] [role=alert]")!.textContent).toBe("See pilt on liiga suur. Vali teine pilt.");
  });

  test("the server's refusals: a photo it will not take (400) is not offered again; 409 'full' says so; 409 'closed' loads the page again quietly", async () => {
    await mount();
    await pick(0, [jpg("a.jpg")]);
    await answer(0, { status: 400, data: { ok: false, error: "content" } });
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='refused'] [role=alert]")!.textContent).toBe("Seda pilti ei saa saata. Vali teine pilt.");
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='refused'] [data-photo-retry]")).toBeNull();
    await click($("[data-photo-pending='refused'] [data-photo-remove]"));
    await pick(0, [jpg("b.jpg")]);
    await answer(1, { status: 409, data: { ok: false, error: "full" } });
    expect($("[data-photo-pending='full'] [role=alert]")!.textContent).toBe("Sellel punktil on juba 3 fotot.");
    await click($("[data-photo-pending='full'] [data-photo-remove]"));
    // sent from another device meanwhile: the page shows what is true now
    reads = [view({ status: "review", round: 1, points: [point(0, { photos: [photo(7)] }), point(1, { photos: [photo(8)] })] })];
    await pick(0, [jpg("c.jpg")]);
    const reads0 = fetchMock.mock.calls.length;
    await answer(2, { status: 409, data: { ok: false, error: "closed" } });
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.length).toBe(reads0 + 1);
    expect(pending()).toEqual([]);
    expect($("[data-practical-page]")!.getAttribute("data-practical-status")).toBe("review");
  });

  test("'Lisa foto' opens the phone's camera or gallery: any image, no capture attribute; several at once, up to the free places", async () => {
    await mount();
    const input = $("[data-point='0'] [data-photo-add] input[type=file]") as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(input.getAttribute("accept")).toBe("image/*");
    expect(input.hasAttribute("capture")).toBe(false);
    expect(input.multiple).toBe(true);
    expect($("[data-point='0'] [data-photo-add] label")!.textContent).toContain("Lisa foto");
    await pick(0, [jpg("a.jpg"), jpg("b.jpg"), jpg("c.jpg"), jpg("d.jpg")]);
    expect(pending()).toHaveLength(3); // three fit on a point; the fourth is not taken
  });

  test("leaving the page stops the upload under way", async () => {
    await mount();
    await pick(0, [jpg("a.jpg")]);
    const signal = sent[0].signal!;
    expect(signal.aborted).toBe(false);
    await act(async () => root.unmount());
    expect(signal.aborted).toBe(true);
    root = createRoot(container); // for afterEach
  });
});

describe("removing and sending", () => {
  test("a stored photo of the round being prepared: its thumbnail, the full photo in a new tab, and its remove; a failed removal says so and keeps it", async () => {
    reads = [view({ points: [point(0, { photos: [photo(101), photo(102)] }), point(1)] })];
    let status = 500;
    write = (url, method) => (method === "DELETE" && url === `${API}/foto/101` ? json(status, status === 200 ? { ok: true } : {}) : json(500, {}));
    await mount();
    expect($("[data-photo='101'] img")!.getAttribute("src")).toBe("/api/konto/praktiline/foto/101/pisi");
    const link = $("[data-photo='101'] a")!;
    expect([link.getAttribute("href"), link.getAttribute("target")]).toEqual(["/api/konto/praktiline/foto/101", "_blank"]);
    expect($("[data-photo='101'] [data-photo-remove]")!.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Eemalda foto 1");
    await click($("[data-photo='101'] [data-photo-remove]"));
    expect(photos(0)).toEqual(["101", "102"]);
    expect($("[data-practical-error]")!.textContent).toBe("Fotot ei õnnestunud eemaldada. Proovi uuesti.");
    status = 200;
    await click($("[data-photo='101'] [data-photo-remove]"));
    expect(photos(0)).toEqual(["102"]);
    expect($("[data-practical-error]")!.textContent).toBe("");
  });

  test("'Saada hindamiseks' waits for a photo on every point and for the uploads, asks once, then the page says 'Ootab hindamist' and takes nothing more", async () => {
    reads = [view({ points: [point(0, { photos: [photo(101)] }), point(1)] })];
    write = (url, method) =>
      method === "POST" && url === `${API}/saada`
        ? json(200, view({ status: "review", round: 1, points: [point(0, { photos: [photo(101)] }), point(1, { photos: [photo(102)] })] }))
        : json(500, {});
    await mount();
    const submit = $("[data-practical-submit]")!;
    expect(submit.textContent).toBe("Saada hindamiseks");
    expect(submit.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
    expect(container.textContent).toContain("Lisa igale punktile vähemalt üks foto.");
    await click(submit);
    expect($("[data-practical-confirm]")).toBeNull(); // not ready: nothing is asked
    await pick(1, [jpg("b.jpg")]);
    expect($("[data-practical-submit]")!.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
    expect(container.textContent).toContain("Oota, kuni kõik fotod on üles laaditud.");
    await answer(0, stored(102));
    expect($("[data-practical-submit]")!.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBeNull();
    await click($("[data-practical-submit]"));
    expect(container.textContent).toContain("Kas saadad töö hindamiseks? Pärast saatmist fotosid muuta ei saa.");
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe($("[data-practical-confirm]"));
    await click($("[data-practical-confirm]"));
    const posts = fetchMock.mock.calls.filter(([, init]) => init?.method === "POST");
    expect(posts.map(([url]) => url)).toEqual([`${API}/saada`]);
    expect($("[data-practical-page]")!.getAttribute("data-practical-status")).toBe("review");
    expect($("[data-practical-lead]")!.textContent).toBe("Ootab hindamist. Maria vaatab fotod üle ja saadab sulle hinnangu.");
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe($("[data-practical-lead]"));
    for (const gone of ["[data-practical-submit]", "[data-photo-add]", "[data-photo-remove]"]) expect($(gone), gone).toBeNull();
    expect(photos(1)).toEqual(["102"]);
  });

  test("a send the server refuses: the points still without a photo are named; too many sends: the rate line", async () => {
    reads = [view({ points: [point(0, { photos: [photo(101)] }), point(1, { photos: [photo(102)] })] })];
    let refusal = json(409, { ok: false, error: "missing", points: [1] });
    write = () => refusal;
    await mount();
    await click($("[data-practical-submit]"));
    await click($("[data-practical-confirm]"));
    expect($("[data-practical-error]")!.textContent).toBe("Lisa foto neile punktidele: 2.");
    refusal = json(429, { ok: false, error: "rate" });
    await click($("[data-practical-submit]"));
    await click($("[data-practical-confirm]"));
    expect($("[data-practical-error]")!.textContent).toBe("Liiga palju katseid. Proovi mõne minuti pärast.");
  });
});

    expect($("[data-practical-submit]")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("all approved: 'Kõik punktid on kinnitatud.' and 'Lõpetatud' with the date; nothing to add, remove or send", async () => {
    reads = [
      view({
        status: "passed",

      }),

    expect($("[data-practical-completed]")!.textContent).toBe("Lõpetatud 14.11.2026");
```

  1. Create `src/components/account/PhotoSlot.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/site/Icon";
import ui from "@/components/site/ui.module.css";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import type { PhotoView } from "@/server/practical";
import { ProgressBar } from "./ProgressBar";
import type { PracticalTexts } from "./texts";
import styles from "./PracticalPage.module.css";

/** A practical photo's address (R5): the full photo, or its thumbnail (…/pisi); each a 302 to a 5-minute signed address, for her only. */
export const photoUrl = (id: number, thumb = false): string => `/api/konto/praktiline/foto/${id}${thumb ? "/pisi" : ""}`;

/** Where a photo picked on the page is: waiting its turn, being made smaller, on its way, or why it stopped. */
export type PendingState = "waiting" | "preparing" | "uploading" | "failed" | "decode" | "tooBig" | "refused" | "full";

/** A photo that stopped: it stays in its row with the reason until it is sent again ("failed" only) or taken away. */
export const stopped = (state: PendingState): boolean => state !== "waiting" && state !== "preparing" && state !== "uploading";

/** The line of a pending photo's row. */
function pendingLine(state: PendingState, percent: number, t: PracticalTexts): string {
  switch (state) {
    case "waiting":
      return t.waiting;
    case "preparing":
      return t.preparing;
    case "uploading":
      return fill(t.uploading, { percent });
    case "failed":
      return t.uploadFailed;
    case "decode":
      return t.decode;
    case "tooBig":
      return t.tooBig;
    case "refused":
      return t.refused;
    case "full":
      return t.full;
  }
}

type Props = { t: PracticalTexts } & (
  | { kind: "photo"; photo: PhotoView; n: number; onRemove: (() => void) | null; busy: boolean }
  | { kind: "pending"; state: PendingState; progress: number; preview: string | null; onRetry(): void; onRemove(): void }
);

/**
 * One row of a point's photos (e-course completion, spec §4.3): a stored photo — its thumbnail and name opening the full photo in a new
 * tab, and its remove while the point takes photos — or a photo on its way — its thumbnail as made in the browser, where it is (with the
 * share sent), "Proovi uuesti" when the connection failed, why it stopped, and its remove once it is not moving.
 */
export function PhotoSlot(props: Props) {
  const { t } = props;
  if (props.kind === "photo") {
    const { photo, n, onRemove, busy } = props;
    const name = fill(t.photo, { n });
    return (
      <li className={styles.photo} data-photo={photo.id}>
        <a className={styles.photoLink} href={photoUrl(photo.id)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          <span className={styles.thumbBox}>
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- a private photo behind her session (a 302 to a signed address): next/image would fetch it without her cookie */}
            <img className={styles.thumb} src={photoUrl(photo.id, true)} alt="" width={72} height={72} loading="lazy" decoding="async" />
          </span>
          <span>{name}</span>
        </a>
        {onRemove ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.remove}
            aria-label={fill(t.removePhoto, { n })}
            aria-disabled={busy || undefined}
            onClick={() => !busy && onRemove()}
            data-photo-remove=""
          >
            <Icon name="close" size={18} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <span />
        )}
      </li>
    );
  }
  const { state, progress, preview, onRetry, onRemove } = props;
  const percent = Math.round(progress * 100);
  const line = pendingLine(state, percent, t);
  return (
    <li className={styles.photo} data-photo-pending={state}>
      <div className={styles.pendingMain}>
        <span className={styles.thumbBox}>
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- the browser's own copy (a blob: address) of the photo being sent */}
          {preview && <img className={styles.thumb} src={preview} alt="" width={72} height={72} />}
        </span>
        <div className={styles.pendingText}>
          {state === "uploading" ? (
            <div className={styles.progress} data-photo-progress="">
              <span className={styles.status}>{line}</span>
              <ProgressBar done={percent} total={100} label={line} />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className={stopped(state) ? styles.problem : styles.status} role={stopped(state) ? "alert" : undefined}>
              {line}
            </span>
          )}
          {state === "failed" && (
            <button type="button" className={styles.retry} onClick={onRetry} data-photo-retry="">
              {t.retry}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {state !== "preparing" && state !== "uploading" ? (
        <button type="button" className={styles.remove} aria-label={t.removePending} onClick={onRemove} data-photo-remove="">
          <Icon name="close" size={18} />
        </button>
      ) : (
        <span />
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * "Lisa foto" (spec §4.3): the phone's camera or gallery — any image, and no `capture`, so the phone offers both. Several at once, up to
 * the point's `free` places (the rest of a larger pick is not taken). The input is reset at once, so the same photo can be picked again.
 */
export function AddPhoto({ free, onPick, t }: { free: number; onPick(files: File[]): void; t: PracticalTexts }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className={styles.addRow} data-photo-add="">
      <input
        id={id}
        className={ui.srOnly}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        multiple={free > 1}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const files = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []).slice(0, free);
          e.target.value = "";
          if (files.length > 0) onPick(files);
        }}
      />
      <label htmlFor={id} className={styles.add}>
        <span className={styles.plus} aria-hidden="true">
          +
        </span>
        {t.add}
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```

  2. Create `src/components/account/PracticalPage.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/site/Icon";
import { Notice } from "@/components/site/Notice";
import ui from "@/components/site/ui.module.css";
import { PHOTOS_PER_POINT, type PracticalStatus } from "@/domain/completion";
import { pick } from "@/i18n/field";
import { fill, formatDate } from "@/i18n/format";
import { href } from "@/i18n/href";
import type { Locale } from "@/i18n/locales";
import { isDone, sendJson } from "@/lib/json-request";
import { preparePhoto, ShrinkError, type PreparedPhoto } from "@/lib/shrink-image";
import type { PhotoView, PointView, PracticalView } from "@/server/practical";
import { AccountLoader, type Reload } from "./AccountLoader";
import { GreetingSkeleton } from "./CardSkeleton";
import { uploadPhoto } from "./photo-upload";
import { AddPhoto, PhotoSlot, photoUrl, stopped, type PendingState } from "./PhotoSlot";
import type { PracticalTexts } from "./texts";
import page from "./EcoursePage.module.css";
import styles from "./PracticalPage.module.css";

/** GET /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline's answer (server/practical.ts PracticalView). */
type PracticalAnswer = PracticalView & { ok: true };

/**
 * A photo picked on the page and not stored yet: the picked file, its made-smaller copy once made (kept, so "Proovi uuesti" sends the same
 * photo again without picking it), where it is, the share sent, and the local address of its thumbnail shown in its row.
 */
type Pending = { id: number; stage: number; file: File; prepared: PreparedPhoto | null; state: PendingState; progress: number; preview: string | null };

/** A ref that focuses its element once, when it appears. */
const focusOnMount = (el: HTMLElement | null) => el?.focus();

/** A local address for a prepared thumbnail, shown while it uploads; null where the browser gives none. */
function previewOf(blob: Blob): string | null {
  try {
    return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Frees a thumbnail's local address. */
function forget(url: string | null): void {
  if (!url) return;
  try {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  } catch {
    // nothing to free
  }
}

/**
 * The personal part of /konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline (e-course completion, spec §4.3; the page is a static shell, the same for every
 * visitor): loads GET /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline in the browser (AccountLoader: skeleton, signed out → the login page, another
 * device, error + retry), then the practical work (PracticalBody). Not open yet: "Praktiline töö avaneb, kui eelnevad sammud on tehtud.";
 * none for her (no access, a revoked one, no points and no notes sent): "Praktilist tööd ei leitud."; both with the way back to the course.
 */
export function PracticalPage({ slug, locale, t }: { slug: string; locale: Locale; t: PracticalTexts }) {
  const back = (
    <Link className={ui.btn} href={href(locale, `/konto/kursus/${slug}`)}>
      {t.back}
      <Icon name="arrow" />
    </Link>
  );
  return (
    <AccountLoader<PracticalAnswer>
      path={`/api/konto/kursus/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/praktiline`}
      locale={locale}
      t={{ ...t.loader, loading: t.loading }}
      skeleton={
        <div className={`${ui.wrap} ${page.wait}`}>
          <GreetingSkeleton />
        </div>
      }
      notFound={
        <div data-account-state="notFound">
          <Notice title={t.notFound}>{back}</Notice>
        </div>
      }
      render={(data, reload) =>
        data.locked ? (
          <div data-account-state="locked">
            <Notice title={t.locked}>{back}</Notice>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <PracticalBody data={data} slug={slug} locale={locale} t={t} reload={reload} />
        )
      }
    />
  );
}

/**
 * The practical work, top to bottom: the eyebrow, the course, the one sentence for the status (or, after the access ended, that it is
 * read-only); "Lõpetatud {date}" once all is approved and the course completed; Maria's points (PointCard); her general notes and the day
 * she sent them; the one button ("Saada hindamiseks", or "Saada uuesti" in a "Paranda" round) with its confirmation, why it waits, and why
 * a step failed; the quiet way back.
 * Uploads (spec §4.3, Review Focus 1): each picked photo is made smaller (lib/shrink-image.ts preparePhoto) and sent (photo-upload.ts) one
 * at a time for the whole page, in the order picked; a failure keeps the prepared copy for "Proovi uuesti" and the queue goes on. A 401, a
 * 404 or a "closed" (sent from another device) loads the page again quietly, which then shows what is true now. Leaving the page stops
 * the upload under way.
 */
function PracticalBody({ data, slug, locale, t, reload }: { data: PracticalAnswer; slug: string; locale: Locale; t: PracticalTexts; reload: Reload }) {
  const api = `/api/konto/kursus/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/praktiline`;
  const [view, setView] = useState<PracticalAnswer>(data);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(data);
  if (loaded !== data) {
    // a quiet reload brought what is true now: it replaces the page's copy (React's way of resetting state from a new prop, in the render)
    setLoaded(data);
    setView(data);
  }
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Pending[]>([]);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const lead = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const submitButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const generalId = useId();
  const confirmId = useId();
  const hintId = useId();
  // The queue's working state, read and written by the handlers only (never in the render): the list as last set, the next local id,
  // whether the queue runs, the upload it may stop, the page still there, a send or a removal under way, and where the focus goes next.
  const work = useRef({ items: [] as Pending[], next: 1, running: false, alive: true, abort: null as AbortController | null, sending: false, removing: false, sent: false, refocus: false });

  useEffect(() => {
    const w = work.current;
    w.alive = true;
    return () => {
      // the page is left: the upload under way stops, and the thumbnails' local addresses are freed
      w.alive = false;
      w.abort?.abort();
      for (const p of w.items) forget(p.preview);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const w = work.current;
    if (w.sent && view.status === "review") {
      // sent just now: the sentence that says so takes the focus (a screen reader reads it)
      w.sent = false;
      lead.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [view.status]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const w = work.current;
    if (!confirming && w.refocus) {
      w.refocus = false;
      submitButton.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [confirming]);

  const update = (change: (list: Pending[]) => Pending[]) => {
    const w = work.current;
    w.items = change(w.items);
    setItems(w.items);
  };
  const patch = (id: number, change: Partial<Pending>) => update((list) => list.map((p) => (p.id === id ? { ...p, ...change } : p)));
  const drop = (id: number) =>
    update((list) => {
      forget(list.find((p) => p.id === id)?.preview ?? null);
      return list.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
    });
  const addStored = (stage: number, photo: PhotoView) =>
    setView((v) => ({ ...v, points: v.points.map((p) => (p.index === stage ? { ...p, photos: [...p.photos, photo] } : p)) }));

  /** One photo: made smaller (once), then sent with its progress; the answer decides what stays. */
  const send = async (item: Pending): Promise<void> => {
    const w = work.current;
    let prepared = item.prepared;
    if (!prepared) {
      patch(item.id, { state: "preparing" });
      try {
        prepared = await preparePhoto(item.file);
      } catch (e) {
        if (w.alive) patch(item.id, { state: e instanceof ShrinkError && e.problem === "size" ? "tooBig" : "decode" });
        return;
      }
      if (!w.alive) return;
      patch(item.id, { prepared, preview: previewOf(prepared.thumb) });
    }
    patch(item.id, { state: "uploading", progress: 0 });
    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("stage", String(item.stage));
    form.set("width", String(prepared.width));
    form.set("height", String(prepared.height));
    form.set("full", prepared.full, "foto.jpg");
    form.set("thumb", prepared.thumb, "pisi.jpg");
    const abort = new AbortController();
    w.abort = abort;
    const answer = await uploadPhoto(`${api}/foto`, form, (fraction) => patch(item.id, { progress: fraction }), abort.signal);
    w.abort = null;
    if (!w.alive) return;
    const photo = answer.data.photo as PhotoView | undefined;
    if (answer.status === 200 && answer.data.ok === true && photo) {
      drop(item.id);
      addStored(item.stage, photo);
    } else if (answer.status === 400 || answer.status === 413) patch(item.id, { state: "refused" });
    else if (answer.status === 409 && answer.data.error === "full") patch(item.id, { state: "full" });
    else if (answer.status === 401 || answer.status === 404 || answer.status === 409) {
      // signed out, the access gone, or sent or closed meanwhile (another device): the page shows what is true now
      drop(item.id);
      void reload({ quiet: true });
    } else patch(item.id, { state: "failed" }); // no answer, a refusal for now (429), a server or storage failure: "Proovi uuesti"
  };

  /** The queue: one photo at a time for the whole page, in the order picked, so a weak connection is not split between uploads. */
  const run = async () => {
    const w = work.current;
    if (w.running) return;
    w.running = true;
    try {
      for (let next = w.items.find((p) => p.state === "waiting"); next && w.alive; next = w.items.find((p) => p.state === "waiting")) await send(next);
    } finally {
      w.running = false;
    }
  };

  const pickFiles = (stage: number, files: File[]) => {
    const w = work.current;
    update((list) => [...list, ...files.map((file) => ({ id: w.next++, stage, file, prepared: null, state: "waiting" as const, progress: 0, preview: null }))]);
    setError(null);
    void run();
  };

  const retry = (id: number) => {
    patch(id, { state: "waiting", progress: 0 });
    void run();
  };

  const removePhoto = async (photoId: number) => {
    const w = work.current;
    if (w.removing) return;
    w.removing = true;
    setRemoving(photoId);
    setError(null);
    const answer = await sendJson(`${api}/foto/${photoId}`, {}, { method: "DELETE" });
    w.removing = false;
    setRemoving(null);
    if (isDone(answer)) setView((v) => ({ ...v, points: v.points.map((p) => ({ ...p, photos: p.photos.filter((ph) => ph.id !== photoId) })) }));
    else if (answer.status === 401 || answer.status === 404 || answer.status === 409) void reload({ quiet: true });
    else setError(t.removeFailed);
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    const w = work.current;
    if (w.sending) return;
    if (w.items.length > 0) {
      // a photo was picked after the button was pressed: it goes first
      setConfirming(false);
      setError(t.waitUploads);
      return;
    }
    w.sending = true;
    setSending(true);
    setError(null);
    const answer = await sendJson(`${api}/saada`, {});
    w.sending = false;
    setSending(false);
    setConfirming(false);
    if (isDone(answer)) {
      w.sent = true;
      setView(answer.data as unknown as PracticalAnswer);
    } else if (answer.status === 409 && answer.data.error === "missing" && Array.isArray(answer.data.points)) {
      // the points are 0-based, as the stages; she reads them from 1
      setError(fill(t.missing, { points: (answer.data.points as number[]).map((i) => i + 1).join(", ") }));
      void reload({ quiet: true });
    } else if (answer.status === 401 || answer.status === 404 || answer.status === 409) void reload({ quiet: true });
    else setError(answer.status === 429 ? t.rate : t.failed);
  };

  const cancel = () => {
    if (work.current.sending) return;
    work.current.refocus = true;
    setConfirming(false);
  };

  const { status } = view;
  const canAct = status === "open" || status === "fix";
  const editing = canAct && !view.readOnly;
  /** A point that takes photos now: every point in the first round, the "Paranda" points in a fix round. */
  const takes = (p: PointView) => editing && (status === "open" || p.verdict === "fix");
  const needed = view.points.filter(takes);
  const moving = items.some((p) => !stopped(p.state));
  const ready = needed.length > 0 && needed.every((p) => p.photos.length > 0) && items.length === 0;
  const hint = ready ? "" : moving ? t.waitUploads : items.length > 0 ? t.clearFailed : status === "fix" ? t.needFixPhotos : t.needPhotos;
  const leadText = view.notesOnly
    ? null
    : view.readOnly && canAct
      ? t.readOnly
      : status === "open"
        ? t.leadOpen
        : status === "review"
          ? t.leadReview
          : status === "fix"
            ? t.leadFix
            : t.leadPassed;

  return (
    <div className={`${ui.wrap} ${page.page}`} data-practical-page="" data-practical-status={status}>
      <div className={styles.column}>
        <p className={styles.eyebrow}>{view.notesOnly ? t.protocolTitle : t.title}</p>
        <h1 className={page.title}>{pick(view.course.title, locale)}</h1>
        {leadText && (
          <p ref={lead} className={styles.lead} tabIndex={-1} data-practical-lead="">
            {leadText}
          </p>
        )}
        {status === "passed" && view.completedAt && (
          <p className={styles.completed} data-practical-completed="">
            <Icon name="check" size={18} />
            {fill(t.completed, { date: formatDate(new Date(view.completedAt), locale) })}
          </p>
        )}
        {view.points.length > 0 && (
          <ol className={styles.points}>
            {view.points.map((p) => (
              <PointCard
                key={p.index}
                point={p}
                status={status}
                takes={takes(p)}
                pending={items.filter((i) => i.stage === p.index)}
                removing={removing}
                t={t}
                onPick={pickFiles}
                onRetry={retry}
                onDrop={drop}
                onRemove={(id) => void removePhoto(id)}
              />
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
        {view.generalNote.trim() !== "" && (
          <section className={styles.general} aria-labelledby={generalId} data-general-note="">
            <h2 id={generalId} className={styles.generalTitle}>
              {t.general}
            </h2>
            <p className={styles.note}>{view.generalNote}</p>
          </section>
        )}
        {view.sentAt && (status === "fix" || status === "passed" || view.notesOnly) && (
          <p className={styles.sent}>{fill(t.sent, { date: formatDate(new Date(view.sentAt), locale) })}</p>
        )}
        {editing && (
          <div className={styles.actions}>
            {confirming ? (
              <div className={styles.confirm} role="group" aria-labelledby={confirmId}>
                <p id={confirmId} className={styles.confirmText}>
                  {t.confirm}
                </p>
                <div className={styles.confirmButtons}>
                  <button
                    ref={focusOnMount}
                    type="button"
                    className={`${ui.btn} ${styles.send}`}
                    aria-disabled={sending || undefined}
                    onClick={() => void submit()}
                    data-practical-confirm=""
                  >
                    {sending ? t.sending : t.confirmYes}
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" className={`${ui.btnOutline} ${styles.send}`} onClick={cancel}>
                    {t.cancel}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                ref={submitButton}
                type="button"
                className={`${ui.btn} ${styles.send}`}
                aria-disabled={!ready || undefined}
                aria-describedby={hint ? hintId : undefined}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!ready) return;
                  setError(null);
                  setConfirming(true);
                }}
                data-practical-submit=""
              >
                {status === "fix" ? t.resubmit : t.submit}
              </button>
            )}
            <p id={hintId} className={styles.hint}>
              {confirming ? "" : hint}
            </p>
            <p className={styles.error} role="alert" data-practical-error="">
              {error ?? ""}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
        <p className={styles.back}>
          <Link className={ui.link} href={href(locale, `/konto/kursus/${slug}`)} data-practical-back="">
            {t.back}
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type PointProps = {
  point: PointView;
  status: PracticalStatus;
  takes: boolean;
  pending: Pending[];
  removing: number | null;
  t: PracticalTexts;
  onPick(stage: number, files: File[]): void;
  onRetry(id: number): void;
  onDrop(id: number): void;
  onRemove(photoId: number): void;
};

/**
 * One of Maria's points: its number and title as she wrote it; her verdict — "Kinnitatud" always (an approved point stays approved),
 * "Paranda" only while the status is fix (after the resubmission it belongs to the round she is looking at again) — with her note; the
 * photos (stored, then on their way); "Lisa foto" while the point takes photos and has a free place; "Varasemad fotod" folded.
 */
function PointCard({ point, status, takes, pending, removing, t, onPick, onRetry, onDrop, onRemove }: PointProps) {
  const shown = point.verdict === "ok" || (point.verdict === "fix" && status === "fix");
  const count = point.photos.length + pending.length;
  return (
    <li className={styles.point} data-point={point.index}>
      <h2 className={styles.pointTitle}>
        <span className={styles.num}>{point.index + 1}</span>
        <span>{point.title}</span>
      </h2>
      {shown && point.verdict && (
        <p className={styles.verdict} data-point-verdict={point.verdict}>
          {point.verdict === "ok" && <Icon name="check" size={18} />}
          {point.verdict === "ok" ? t.approved : t.fix}
        </p>
      )}
      {shown && point.note.trim() !== "" && (
        <p className={styles.note} data-point-note="">
          {point.note}
        </p>
      )}
      {count > 0 && (
        <ul className={styles.photos}>
          {point.photos.map((photo, i) => (
            <PhotoSlot key={`s${photo.id}`} kind="photo" photo={photo} n={i + 1} onRemove={takes ? () => onRemove(photo.id) : null} busy={removing === photo.id} t={t} />
          ))}
          {pending.map((p) => (
            <PhotoSlot key={`p${p.id}`} kind="pending" state={p.state} progress={p.progress} preview={p.preview} onRetry={() => onRetry(p.id)} onRemove={() => onDrop(p.id)} t={t} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {takes && count < PHOTOS_PER_POINT && <AddPhoto free={PHOTOS_PER_POINT - count} onPick={(files) => onPick(point.index, files)} t={t} />}
      {point.earlier.length > 0 && (
        <details className={styles.earlier} data-earlier="">
          <summary>{t.earlier}</summary>
          <ul className={styles.earlierList}>
            {point.earlier.map((photo) => (
              <li key={photo.id}>
                <a className={styles.earlierLink} href={photoUrl(photo.id)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- a private photo behind her session (a 302 to a signed address) */}
                  <img src={photoUrl(photo.id, true)} alt={fill(t.earlierPhoto, { round: photo.round })} width={56} height={56} loading="lazy" decoding="async" />
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

  3. Create `src/components/account/PracticalPage.module.css`:

```css
/* The student's practical work /konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline (e-course completion, spec §4.3), phone first: the eyebrow, the course, the
   one sentence; Maria's points as cards (prototype B's card: white, thin line), each with its verdict and her note, its photos as rows (a
   72 px thumbnail and its name, or where its upload is, and the 44 px remove), "Lisa foto" as a dashed row, the earlier rounds folded; the
   general notes; the one button and its confirmation. The page and its title are EcoursePage.module.css's. Tokens only; nothing moves, so
   prefers-reduced-motion has nothing to stop. */

.column {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  max-width: 760px;
}

.eyebrow {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-body);
}

.lead {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font: 400 17px/1.6 var(--font-body);
}

.lead:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.lead:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.completed {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ok);
  font: 600 16px/1.5 var(--font-body);
}

.points {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.point {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: var(--paper);
}

.pointTitle {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: baseline;
  margin: 0;
  font: 600 17px/1.4 var(--font-body);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.num {
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font: 400 13px/1 var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.verdict {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 0;
  font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-body);
}

.verdict[data-point-verdict="ok"] {
  color: var(--ok);
}

.verdict[data-point-verdict="fix"] {
  color: var(--warn);
}

.note {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--canvas);
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--font-body);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.photos {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

/* a row: the thumbnail with its name (or where its upload is), and the remove at the end */
.photo {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 44px;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}

.photoLink,
.pendingMain {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 72px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-body);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.photoLink:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 14px;
}

.thumbBox {
  display: block;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--canvas);
}

.thumb {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.pendingText {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.progress {
  justify-self: stretch;
}

.status {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-body);
}

.problem {
  color: var(--bad);
  font: 500 13px/1.45 var(--font-body);
}

.retry {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--font-body);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.remove {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.remove[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: progress;
}

.retry:focus-visible,
.remove:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.addRow {
  position: relative;
}

.add {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--muted);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-body);
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* the input is visually hidden: its focus shows on the row */
.addRow:focus-within .add {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.plus {
  font: 300 26px/1 var(--font-display);
}

.earlier > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font: 500 14px/1.3 var(--font-body);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.earlier > summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.earlierList {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.earlierLink {
  display: block;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--canvas);
}

.earlierLink img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.general {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.generalTitle {
  margin: 0;
  font: 400 24px/1.25 var(--font-display);
}

.sent {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-body);
}

.actions {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.confirm {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  justify-self: stretch;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  background: var(--canvas);
}

.confirmText {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 500 16px/1.5 var(--font-body);
}

.confirmButtons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.hint {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body);
}

.error {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--bad);
  font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body);
}

.back {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .point {
    padding: 16px;
  }

  /* a whole-width button: the easiest target on a phone */
  .send {
    width: 100%;
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 19: The static shell.** Create `src/app/[locale]/(site)/konto/kursus/[slug]/praktiline/page.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { AccountShell } from "@/components/account/AccountShell";
import { PracticalPage } from "@/components/account/PracticalPage";
import { practicalTexts, shellTexts } from "@/components/account/texts";
import { getDict, isLocale } from "@/i18n/locales";
import { isSlug } from "@/lib/slug";

type Props = { params: Promise<{ locale: string; slug: string }> };

/** Rendered on the first visit of a course's practical work and then cached, like kursus/[slug] (app/[locale]/layout.tsx). */
export function generateStaticParams(): { slug: string }[] {
  return [];
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { locale } = await params;
  if (!isLocale(locale)) return {};
  const d = getDict(locale);
  return { title: `${d.account.practical.title} — ${d.common.siteName}` };
}

/**
 * An e-course's practical work (e-course completion, spec §4.3): /konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline. A static shell, the same for every visitor
 * (no cookies, headers, query or database read here; the course is in the path). The browser loads the student's work from
 * GET /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline (PracticalPage): only her own access, only Maria's sent assessment.
 */
export default async function PracticalShellPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { locale, slug } = await params;
  if (!isLocale(locale) || !isSlug(slug)) notFound();
  const d = getDict(locale);
  return (
    <AccountShell tab="courses" locale={locale} t={shellTexts(d)}>
      <PracticalPage slug={slug} locale={locale} t={practicalTexts(d)} />
    </AccountShell>
  );
}
```

### Task 9: "Lõpetamine" on the e-course page and "Lõpetatud" on its card

Spec §4.1 (the four steps, the locked reasons, skipped steps, the card's "Lõpetatud" with the date), §4.3 last bullet (an e-course without points whose notes-only protocol Maria sent shows "Vaata protokolli", opening the practical page with her notes only), §4.4 (a set `completed_at` shows as done). Review Focus 5. Rulings: none apply (R1–R6 concern other tasks).

**The block.** Below the module list of `/konto/kursus/<slug>`: Õppetunnid → Teadmiste test → Praktiline töö → Lõpetatud, each with a round mark (its number while ahead, ✓ done, a lock while it waits), its name, its state in one line (a locked step says why), and the way in once it is open: the test → `/konto/kursus/<slug>/test`, the practical work → `/konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline`. A step the course does not have is not shown (`steps.test` / `steps.practical` null). The link of the step she acts in (open, or "Paranda") is the page's one button **once the lessons are done** (then "Jätka" is gone, so the page still has one primary); otherwise it is a text link ("Vaata tulemust", "Vaata praktilist tööd"). A course without lessons yet ("Sisu lisandub peagi.") shows no block unless it is completed.

**The data.** `EcourseView.completion = CourseSteps & { protocolSent }`, filled by `loadEcourse` with Task 4's `loadSteps`. `loadEcourse` reads the access with Task 4's `accessFor` (not `activeAccess`, which since Task 4 returns the id but not the whole row `loadSteps` takes) and keeps its rule with `isActive` (an ended or revoked access is `null`, as before); `protocolSent` is one small read of the access protocol's `sent_at`. Once a protocol exists, its own copy of the points decides whether the course "has points" (`loadSteps` does this): an e-course whose notes-only protocol was created keeps "Vaata protokolli" even if Maria adds points to the course later. `EcourseCard.completedAt` is on every card `loadDashboard` makes, also after the access has ended; the card prints "Lõpetatud {date}" next to "Läbitud ✓" (the lessons line keeps its logic).

**The admin's read-only view** (`/admin/opilased/[id]/vaade/[slug]`) renders `EcourseView` on the server with `readOnly`: the step links are inert spans, aria-disabled, like "Jätka" — no page change is needed, its data comes from `loadEcourse`.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";

import { clients, courseAccess, courseModules, courses, courseTests, lessonProgress, lessons, protocols, testAttempts, type TestQuestion } from "@/db/schema";
import { loadDashboard, loadEcourse, type EcourseView as EcourseData } from "@/server/client-data";
import { makeTestDb } from "./helpers";

// "Lõpetamine" and "Lõpetatud" (e-course completion, spec §4.1, §4.3, §4.4) against a real (PGlite) database: the e-course page's data
// carries the path's steps (server/completion.ts loadSteps) as the student walks it, a skipped step is null, "Vaata protokolli" only for an
// e-course without points whose notes Maria sent; the dashboard's card carries completed_at, also after the access ended; and Maria's
// read-only view of the course shows the steps with their links inert.

const state = vi.hoisted(() => ({ db: null as unknown }));
vi.mock("@/db/client", () => ({ getDb: () => state.db }));
vi.mock("@/server/auth", async (importOriginal) => ({ ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("@/server/auth")>()), requireAdmin: async () => "maria@example.test" }));

import ViewCoursePage from "@/app/admin/(panel)/opilased/[id]/vaade/[slug]/page";
import { EcourseView } from "@/components/account/EcourseView";

const NOW = new Date("2026-11-14T10:00:00Z");
const DAY = 86_400_000;
const POINTS = ["Ettevalmistus", "Värvimine"];
const QUESTION: TestQuestion = {
  id: "q1aaaaaa",
  kind: "choice",
  text: "Millest alustad kulmude kuju määramist?",
  options: [
    { id: "o1aaaaaa", text: "Näo proportsioonidest", correct: true },
    { id: "o2aaaaaa", text: "Juuste värvist", correct: false },
  ],
};

let db: Db;
beforeEach(async () => {
  db = await makeTestDb();
  state.db = db;
  vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});
});
afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());

/** An e-course of two text lessons with the test (one choice question) unless `questions` is false and these `points`; Kati (Russian) with six months of access. */
async function world(over: { questions?: boolean; points?: string[] } = {}) {
  const base = { level: "basic" as const, summary: { et: "" }, body: { et: "" } };
  const [course] = await db
    .insert(courses)
    .values({ ...base, slug: "veebikursus", type: "e_learning", title: { et: "Veebikursus", ru: "Онлайн-курс" }, price: 9500, published: true, protocolStages: over.points ?? POINTS })
    .returning();
  if (over.questions !== false) await db.insert(courseTests).values({ courseId: course.id, questions: [QUESTION] });
  const [m] = await db.insert(courseModules).values({ courseId: course.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Teooria" } }).returning();
  const [l1] = await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Üks" }, kind: "text" }).returning();
  const [l2] = await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: m.id, position: 2, title: { et: "Kaks" }, kind: "text" }).returning();
  const [kati] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: "kati@example.test", name: "Kati Tamm", locale: "ru" }).returning();
  const [access] = await db.insert(courseAccess).values({ clientId: kati.id, courseId: course.id, grantedBy: "admin@example.test", expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + 180 * DAY) }).returning();
  return { course, l1, l2, kati, access };
}
type World = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof world>>;

const lessonsDone = (w: World) => db.insert(lessonProgress).values([w.l1, w.l2].map((l) => ({ clientId: w.kati.id, lessonId: l.id, doneAt: NOW })));
const completionOf = async (w: World) => (await loadEcourse(db, w.kati.id, "veebikursus", NOW))!.completion;

describe("the e-course page's steps (loadEcourse)", () => {
  test("they follow her path: lessons, the test, the practical work; a set completed_at makes every step done", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({
      lessons: { done: 0, total: 2, state: "open" },
      test: { state: "locked" },
      practical: { state: "locked", round: 0 },
      completedAt: null,
      protocolSent: false,
    });
    await lessonsDone(w);
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({ lessons: { done: 2, total: 2, state: "done" }, test: { state: "open", triesLeft: 3 }, practical: { state: "locked" } });
    await db.insert(testAttempts).values({
      clientId: w.kati.id, courseId: w.course.id, number: 1, questions: [QUESTION], answers: { [QUESTION.id]: ["o1aaaaaa"] }, correct: 1, total: 1, status: "passed", submittedAt: NOW,
    });
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({ test: { state: "done" }, practical: { state: "open", round: 0 } });
    await db.insert(protocols).values({ accessId: w.access.id, stages: POINTS.map((title) => ({ title, note: "" })), round: 1, submittedAt: NOW });
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({ practical: { state: "review", round: 1 } });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ completedAt: NOW }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({
      lessons: { state: "done" },
      test: { state: "done" },
      practical: { state: "done" },
      completedAt: NOW.toISOString(),
      protocolSent: false,
    });
  });

  test("a course without questions has no test step, one without points no practical step (null: the block skips them)", async () => {
    const w = await world({ questions: false, points: [] });
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({ lessons: { done: 0, total: 2, state: "open" }, test: null, practical: null, completedAt: null });
  });

  test("'Vaata protokolli' (protocolSent): only for an e-course without points, and only once Maria has sent its notes", async () => {
    const w = await world({ points: [] });
    expect((await completionOf(w)).protocolSent).toBe(false);
    const [p] = await db.insert(protocols).values({ accessId: w.access.id, stages: [], generalNote: "Tubli!" }).returning();
    expect((await completionOf(w)).protocolSent).toBe(false); // a draft
    await db.update(protocols).set({ sent: { stages: [], generalNote: "Tubli!" }, sentAt: NOW, sentVersion: 1 }).where(eq(protocols.id, p.id));
    expect((await completionOf(w)).protocolSent).toBe(true);
    // the protocol's own copy of the points decides once it exists (spec §3.4: a later change reaches only protocols not created yet)
    await db.update(courses).set({ protocolStages: POINTS }).where(eq(courses.id, w.course.id));
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({ practical: null, protocolSent: true });
  });

  test("with points the practical work is the protocol: a sent assessment has its own step, never 'Vaata protokolli'", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await lessonsDone(w);
    await db.insert(protocols).values({
      accessId: w.access.id,
      stages: POINTS.map((title) => ({ title, note: "" })),
      round: 1,
      submittedAt: NOW,
      sentRound: 1,
      verdicts: ["ok", "fix"],
      sent: { stages: POINTS.map((title) => ({ title, note: "" })), generalNote: "", verdicts: ["ok", "fix"] },
      sentAt: NOW,
      sentVersion: 1,
    });
    expect(await completionOf(w)).toMatchObject({ practical: { round: 1 }, protocolSent: false });
  });

  test("the page stays for an active access only, as before: a completed course whose access ended has no page (its card keeps the date)", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ completedAt: NOW, expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - DAY) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    expect(await loadEcourse(db, w.kati.id, "veebikursus", NOW)).toBeNull();
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() + DAY), revokedAt: NOW }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    expect(await loadEcourse(db, w.kati.id, "veebikursus", NOW)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("the card's 'Lõpetatud' (loadDashboard)", () => {
  test("completedAt: null before, the date after, and still there once the access has ended", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const card = async () => (await loadDashboard(db, w.kati.id, NOW))!.cards[0];
    expect(await card()).toMatchObject({ kind: "ecourse", completedAt: null });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ completedAt: NOW }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    expect(await card()).toMatchObject({ kind: "ecourse", completedAt: NOW.toISOString() });
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ expiresAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - DAY) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, w.access.id));
    const ended = await card();
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ kind: "ecourse", completedAt: NOW.toISOString() });
    expect(ended).not.toHaveProperty("progress");
  });
});

/** The EcourseView element in a page's tree (depth first): the one whose `data` carries the course's `completion`. */
function findView(node: ReactNode): Parameters<typeof EcourseView>[0] | null {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    for (const child of node) {
      const found = findView(child);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }
  if (!isValidElement(node)) return null;
  const props = node.props as { data?: { completion?: unknown }; children?: ReactNode };
  if (props.data && "completion" in props.data) return node.props as Parameters<typeof EcourseView>[0];
  return findView(props.children);
}

describe("Maria's read-only view of the course (Vaata tema vaadet)", () => {
  test("her copy carries the steps, and their links are inert, like 'Jätka'", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await lessonsDone(w);
    const tree = await ViewCoursePage({ params: Promise.resolve({ id: String(w.kati.id), slug: "veebikursus" }) });
    const props = findView(tree);
    expect(props, "the EcourseView with the course").not.toBeNull();
    expect(props!.readOnly).toBe(true);
    expect((props!.data as EcourseData).completion).toMatchObject({ test: { state: "open" } });
    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(EcourseView, props!));
    expect(html).toContain('data-completion=""');
    expect(html).not.toContain("<a ");
    expect(html).toMatch(/<span[^>]*aria-disabled="true"[^>]*data-step-link=""[^>]*>Открыть тест/); // her language: Kati reads Russian
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The e-course page's data: null without active access (none, revoked or expired: the access row is read in any state,
 * server/completion.ts accessFor, and must be active, isActive), with its modules, the visible lessons and their states, the counts, and
 * the path's steps ("Lõpetamine", e-course completion). The terms notice shows while `terms.accepted` is false;
 * the page then sends back `terms.version` with the acceptance. The version is read BEFORE the text: an admin save that lands
 * in between then pairs the old version with the new text (the next visit shows the notice again), never a new version with
 * text the student did not see. The client's acceptances are read alongside.
 */
export async function loadEcourse(db: Db, clientId: number, slug: string, now: Date): Promise<EcourseView | null> {
  const access = await accessFor(db, clientId, slug);
  if (!access || !isActive(access, now)) return null;
  const [terms, outline, steps, sent] = await Promise.all([
    termsState(db, clientId, access.course.id),
    courseOutline(db, access.course.id, clientId),
    loadSteps(db, access),
    // a notes-only protocol of this access that Maria has sent (only read for a course without points, but one small read either way)
    db.select({ id: protocols.id }).from(protocols).where(and(eq(protocols.accessId, access.id), isNotNull(protocols.sentAt))).limit(1),
  ]);
  return {
    course: { slug: access.course.slug, title: access.course.title, modules: outline.modules },
    access: { expiresAt: iso(access.expiresAt) },
    terms,
    progress: outline.progress,
    completion: { ...steps, protocolSent: steps.practical === null && sent.length > 0 },
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The block.**
  1. Create `src/components/account/CompletionSteps.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/site/Icon";
import ui from "@/components/site/ui.module.css";
import type { CourseSteps, StepState } from "@/domain/completion";
import { fill, formatDate } from "@/i18n/format";
import { href } from "@/i18n/href";
import type { Locale } from "@/i18n/locales";
import type { EcourseTexts } from "./texts";
import styles from "./CompletionSteps.module.css";

type CompletionTexts = EcourseTexts["completion"];
type StepKey = "lessons" | "test" | "practical" | "done";
/** One row: the step, its state, its name, its one line, and where it leads (nothing while it is locked, nor for the lessons and the end). */
type Row = { key: StepKey; state: StepState; name: string; line: string; link: { to: string; label: string; main: boolean } | null };

/** A step she has to act in now: its link opens it ("Ava …"); otherwise the link shows her results. */
const acts = (state: StepState): boolean => state === "open" || state === "fix";

/** The test's line: why it waits, the tries left, Maria's turn, a fix, passed, or no tries left (spec §4.2's words). */
function testLine(state: StepState, triesLeft: number | null, c: CompletionTexts): string {
  switch (state) {
    case "locked":
      return c.lockedLessons;
    case "open":
      return triesLeft === null ? c.open : fill(c.testOpen, { n: triesLeft });
    case "review":
      return c.testReview;
    case "fix":
      return c.testFix;
    case "done":
      return c.testDone;
    case "used":
      return c.testUsed;
  }
}

/** The practical work's line; locked, it waits for the test, or (a course without questions) for the lessons. */
function practicalLine(state: StepState, hasTest: boolean, c: CompletionTexts): string {
  switch (state) {
    case "locked":
      return hasTest ? c.lockedTest : c.lockedLessons;
    case "review":
      return c.practicalReview;
    case "fix":
      return c.practicalFix;
    case "done":
      return c.practicalDone;
    default:
      return c.practicalOpen;
  }
}

/**
 * "Lõpetamine" on the e-course page (e-course completion, spec §4.1), below the modules: Õppetunnid → Teadmiste test → Praktiline töö →
 * Lõpetatud. Each step: a round mark (its number while ahead, ✓ done, a lock while it waits), its name, its state in one line (a locked
 * step says why), and once open the way in — the test's page, the practical work's page. A step the course does not have (`steps.test` /
 * `steps.practical` null) is not shown. The link of the step she acts in is the page's one button once the lessons are done ("Jätka" is
 * gone by then); every other link is a text link. `protocolSent` (an e-course without points whose notes Maria sent, spec §4.3): "Vaata
 * protokolli", to the practical page that shows her notes. `readOnly` (the admin's view as client): the links are there and do nothing.
 */
export function CompletionSteps({ slug, steps, protocolSent, locale, t, readOnly }: { slug: string; steps: CourseSteps; protocolSent: boolean; locale: Locale; t: EcourseTexts; readOnly: boolean }) {
  const c = t.completion;
  const headingId = useId();
  const base = `/konto/kursus/${slug}`;
  const lessonsDone = steps.lessons.state === "done";
  const rows: Row[] = [
    {
      key: "lessons",
      state: steps.lessons.state,
      name: c.steps.lessons,
      line: lessonsDone ? c.lessonsDone : fill(c.lessonsOpen, { done: steps.lessons.done, total: steps.lessons.total }),
      link: null,
    },
  ];
  if (steps.test) {
    const { state, triesLeft } = steps.test;
    rows.push({
      key: "test",
      state,
      name: c.steps.test,
      line: testLine(state, triesLeft, c),
      link: state === "locked" ? null : { to: `${base}/test`, label: acts(state) ? c.openTest : c.viewResult, main: acts(state) && lessonsDone },
    });
  }
  if (steps.practical) {
    const { state } = steps.practical;
    rows.push({
      key: "practical",
      state,
      name: c.steps.practical,
      line: practicalLine(state, steps.test !== null, c),
      link: state === "locked" ? null : { to: `${base}/praktiline`, label: acts(state) ? c.openPractical : c.viewPractical, main: acts(state) && lessonsDone },
    });
  }
  rows.push({
    key: "done",
    state: steps.completedAt ? "done" : "locked",
    name: c.steps.done,
    line: steps.completedAt ? fill(c.completedOn, { date: formatDate(new Date(steps.completedAt), locale) }) : c.doneLocked,
    link: null,
  });

  /** A step's way in: a link, or (read-only) the same look doing nothing, as the page's "Jätka". */
  const way = (link: NonNullable<Row["link"]>) => {
    const cls = link.main ? `${ui.btn} ${styles.action} ${styles.main}` : `${ui.link} ${styles.action}`;
    const label = (
      <>
        {link.label}
        {link.main && <Icon name="arrow" />}
      </>
    );
    return readOnly ? (
      <span className={cls} aria-disabled="true" data-step-link="">
        {label}
      </span>
    ) : (
      <Link className={cls} href={href(locale, link.to)} data-step-link="">
        {label}
      </Link>
    );
  };

  return (
    <section className={styles.block} aria-labelledby={headingId} data-completion="">
      <h2 id={headingId} className={styles.title}>
        {c.title}
      </h2>
      <ol className={styles.steps}>
        {rows.map((row, i) => (
          <li key={row.key} className={styles.step} data-step={row.key} data-step-state={row.state}>
            <span className={styles.mark} aria-hidden="true">
              {row.state === "done" ? <Icon name="check" size={16} /> : row.state === "locked" ? <Icon name="lock" size={16} /> : i + 1}
            </span>
            <div className={styles.body}>
              <p className={styles.name} data-step-name="">
                {row.name}
              </p>
              <p className={styles.line} data-step-line="">
                {row.line}
              </p>
              {row.link && way(row.link)}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {protocolSent && (
        <p className={styles.protocol}>
          {readOnly ? (
            <span className={ui.btnOutline} aria-disabled="true" data-view-protocol="">
              {c.viewProtocol}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <Link className={ui.btnOutline} href={href(locale, `${base}/praktiline`)} data-view-protocol="">
              {c.viewProtocol}
            </Link>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

  2. Create `src/components/account/CompletionSteps.module.css`:

```css
/* "Lõpetamine" under the e-course's modules (e-course completion, spec §4.1): the path's steps as a numbered column between thin lines (the
   modules' rows): a round mark (the step's number while it is ahead, ✓ done, a lock while it waits), the step's name, its state in one line,
   and the way in — the page's one button for the step she acts in, a text link otherwise. Every row and link is at least 44 px. The page is
   EcoursePage.module.css's. Tokens only; nothing moves. */

.block {
  max-width: 750px;
  margin-top: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
}

.title {
  margin: 0;
  font: 400 clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px) / 1.15 var(--font-display);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.steps {
  margin: 16px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  list-style: none;
}

.step {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: 14px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font: 400 13px/1 var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.step[data-step-state="open"] .mark,
.step[data-step-state="review"] .mark,
.step[data-step-state="fix"] .mark {
  border-color: var(--ink);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.step[data-step-state="used"] .mark {
  border-color: var(--warn);
  color: var(--warn);
}

.step[data-step-state="done"] .mark {
  border-color: var(--ok);
  color: var(--ok);
}

.body {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.name {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 600 16px/1.4 var(--font-body);
}

.line {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font: 400 15px/1.5 var(--font-body);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.step[data-step-state="locked"] .name,
.step[data-step-state="locked"] .line {
  color: var(--muted);
}

.step[data-step-state="fix"] .line,
.step[data-step-state="used"] .line {
  color: var(--warn);
}

.step[data-step-state="done"] .line {
  color: var(--ok);
}

.action {
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.protocol {
  margin: 18px 0 0;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  /* a whole-width button: the easiest target on a phone */
  .main {
    width: 100%;
  }
}
```

### Task 10: Maria's assessment server — protocol owners, `protocolScreen({ accessId })`, the verdict taps, "Saada hinnang"

Spec sections 3.4 (the access's protocol, the practical status), 5.3 (the screen's data, the verdicts, "Saada hinnang", notes before the submission, the notes-only protocol), 8 (two devices of Maria, a correction of the same round, the locked verdicts after the approval, an ended or revoked access), 9 (DB) and D6. Rulings **R2** (the verdicts are a column of their own, saved per tap through `POST /api/admin/hinnang`, outside the notes' version check; `sent` carries `verdicts`) and **R3** (a resubmission resets the fix verdicts and raises `round`, never `version`: this task reads that state, Task 7 writes it). Nothing on screen yet: Task 11 uses these.

**Two owners, one engine.** A protocol belongs to a registration (the course day) or, new, to an e-course access. The save body names exactly one (`saveBody`'s refine); `current()` reads the owner's headings and row: an access's headings are its course's points, a revoked access is `notFound` (an ended one still saves: Maria can still assess). Every other line of `saveProtocol` (the version check, the row check, the retry) is shared. One addition, for the access only: the student's first photo makes the row (Task 7 `addPhoto`: the course's points, the default version 1, no text) — a screen opened before that has version 0 and no row, and its first save would be a conflict whose notice takes Maria's first words for nothing. Such a save builds on that empty row instead (`builtOn`): nobody's words are in it, so nothing is overwritten.

**The lock order.** `saveVerdict` and `sendAssessment` take `lockAccess` (Task 4) first, then the protocol row `FOR UPDATE`, as every writer about one access does (the student's photos and submit, Task 7; the test, Task 5). The notes' save stays what it is for a registration: single conditional statements with no lock of their own (an `UPDATE … where version = $v` waits for a send's row lock and then fails its version check, as today), so it cannot deadlock with the lockers.

**The mail kinds of "Saada hinnang"** (all after the commit, through `deps.later`, Task 4's `completionJob` + `mailCompletion`; never a note in a mail):

| The send | The status after it | Mail |
|---|---|---|
| a point "Paranda" | `fix` | `assessed` with `fixCount` |
| every point ok, `completeIfDone` set `completed_at` now | `passed` | `completed` |
| every point ok, not completed now (another step is not done: e.g. a lesson added later) | `passed` | `assessed` (no `fixCount`) |
| approved before (the verdicts are locked), the notes changed | `passed` | `protocolAgain` (or `completed` if this send completes it) |
| an e-course without points: notes only, first send | `open` | `protocol` |
| the same, sent before | `open` | `protocolAgain` |

```ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { clients, courseAccess, courseModules, courses, lessonProgress, lessons, practicalPhotos, protocols, type Course, type Lesson, type Protocol } from "@/db/schema";
import { stagesFrom } from "@/domain/protocols";

// An e-course with practical points and a student with access to it, for Maria's assessment (phase e-course completion, Tasks 10–14). The course
// has one text lesson, which the student has done, and no test (no course_tests row): the practical work is her only step left, so an approving
// send completes the course. `submitRound` writes what the student's "Saada hindamiseks" leaves (server/practical.ts submitPractical, Task 7)
// without the photo files: the protocol her first photo made (the course's points, version 1, no text), a photo row per point named, round + 1,
// submitted_at, and the "Paranda" verdicts back to null (R3; the notes' version is not touched).

export const POINTS = ["Ettevalmistus", "Kulmude kuju", "Värvimine"];
/** The student's first submission. */
export const DAY = new Date("2026-11-10T10:00:00Z");

export async function ecourse(db: Db, over: { slug?: string; points?: string[] } = {}): Promise<{ course: Course; lesson: Lesson }> {
  const [course] = await db
    .insert(courses)
    .values({
      slug: over.slug ?? "kulmud-e",
      type: "e_learning",
      level: "basic",
      title: { et: "Kulmude e-kursus", ru: "Брови онлайн" },
      summary: { et: "" },
      body: { et: "" },
      price: 9000,
      protocolStages: over.points ?? POINTS,
    })
    .returning();
  const [module] = await db.insert(courseModules).values({ courseId: course.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Moodul" } }).returning();
  const [lesson] = await db.insert(lessons).values({ moduleId: module.id, position: 1, title: { et: "Sissejuhatus" }, kind: "text" }).returning();
  return { course, lesson };
}

/** A student with access to `course` (six months from DAY unless `expiresAt`), its lesson done. */
export async function learner(
  db: Db,
  course: Course,
  lesson: Lesson,
  email: string,
  over: { name?: string; locale?: "et" | "ru"; expiresAt?: Date; revokedAt?: Date | null } = {},
) {
  const [client] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email, name: over.name ?? "Kati Kask", locale: over.locale ?? "et" }).returning();
  const [access] = await db
    .insert(courseAccess)
    .values({ clientId: client.id, courseId: course.id, grantedBy: "admin@example.test", expiresAt: over.expiresAt ?? new Date("2027-05-10T10:00:00Z"), revokedAt: over.revokedAt ?? null })
    .returning();
  await db.insert(lessonProgress).values({ clientId: client.id, lessonId: lesson.id, doneAt: DAY });
  return { client, access };
}

/** The course and Kati (kati@example.com: a real-looking address, so her mails are built and "sent" to the stubbed Resend). */
export async function ecourseAccess(db: Db, over: { slug?: string; points?: string[]; email?: string; expiresAt?: Date; revokedAt?: Date | null } = {}) {
  const { course, lesson } = await ecourse(db, over);
  const { client, access } = await learner(db, course, lesson, over.email ?? "kati@example.com", over);
  return { course, lesson, client, access };
}

/** One submission of the student: a photo on each point of `points` (0-based) in the new round. Returns the protocol after it. */
export async function submitRound(db: Db, accessId: number, points: readonly number[], at: Date): Promise<Protocol> {
  const [{ headings }] = await db
    .select({ headings: courses.protocolStages })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId));
  await db.insert(protocols).values({ accessId, stages: stagesFrom(headings) }).onConflictDoNothing({ target: protocols.accessId });
  const [p] = await db.select().from(protocols).where(eq(protocols.accessId, accessId));
  const round = p.round + 1;
  for (const stage of points)
    await db.insert(practicalPhotos).values({
      protocolId: p.id,
      stage,
      round,
      key: `practical/p${p.id}-${stage}-${round}.jpg`,
      thumbKey: `practical/p${p.id}-${stage}-${round}-t.jpg`,
      size: 150_000,
      width: 1600,
      height: 1200,
    });
  const verdicts = p.stages.map((_, i) => (p.verdicts[i] === "fix" ? null : (p.verdicts[i] ?? null)));
  const [after] = await db.update(protocols).set({ round, submittedAt: at, verdicts }).where(eq(protocols.id, p.id)).returning();
  return after;
}
```

```ts
/** The screen's students for the browser (the page's props, and GET /api/admin/protokoll's answer): every date as text; an access's with its practical work. */
export function screenStudents(screen: ScreenData): ScreenStudentView[] {
  const assessment = screen.assessment ? assessmentView(screen.assessment) : null;
  return screen.students.map((s) => ({
    registrationId: s.registrationId,
    protocolId: s.protocol.id,
    name: s.name,
    awaiting: s.status === "awaiting_prepayment",
    version: s.protocol.version,
    titles: s.protocol.stages.map((x) => x.title),
    notes: s.protocol.stages.map((x) => x.note),
    generalNote: s.protocol.generalNote,
    sentVersion: s.protocol.sentVersion,
    sentAt: s.protocol.sentAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    savedAt: s.protocol.updatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    ...(assessment ? { assessment } : {}),
  }));
}

/** An access's practical work for the browser: its dates as text. */
```
