  6. `protocolScreen` with its comment (lines 81–111) becomes the following, followed by the new `accessScreen` (the session and registration branches are unchanged):

```ts
/**
 * The screen of one session (`sessionId`: its students, a called-off session's too, for the record), of one registration, or of one e-course
 * access (`accessId`, Maria's assessment); null when there is no such session or registration of a contact course (protocols of the course day
 * are for contact courses only: spec assumption 1), or no such access to an e-course, or a revoked one (spec §8: not hers to assess any more).
 */
export async function protocolScreen(db: Db, target: { sessionId: number } | { registrationId: number } | { accessId: number }): Promise<ScreenData | null> {
  if ("accessId" in target) return accessScreen(db, target.accessId);
  if ("sessionId" in target) {
    const [s] = await db
      .select({ session: courseSessions, course: courseFields })
      .from(courseSessions)
      .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseSessions.courseId, courses.id))
      .where(eq(courseSessions.id, target.sessionId))
      .limit(1);
    if (!s || s.course.type !== "contact") return null;
    const rows = await db
      .select({ registration: registrations, protocol: protocols })
      .from(registrations)
      .leftJoin(protocols, eq(protocols.registrationId, registrations.id))
      .where(eq(registrations.courseSessionId, target.sessionId));
    return screenOf("session", s.course, sessionOf(s.session), rows);
  }
  const [r] = await db
    .select({ registration: registrations, protocol: protocols, course: courseFields, session: courseSessions })
    .from(registrations)
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(registrations.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(courseSessions, eq(registrations.courseSessionId, courseSessions.id))
    .leftJoin(protocols, eq(protocols.registrationId, registrations.id))
    .where(eq(registrations.id, target.registrationId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!r || r.course.type !== "contact") return null;
  return screenOf("registration", r.course, r.session ? sessionOf(r.session) : null, [{ registration: r.registration, protocol: r.protocol }]);
}

/**
 * One e-course access's screen (spec §5.3): its student by her name (her address while she has none), her protocol's draft (the course's points
 * with empty notes while there is no protocol yet; its own copy after), and the practical work. An ended access is shown (Maria can still
 * assess); a revoked one is not. Reads only: nothing is created by looking.
 */
async function accessScreen(db: Db, accessId: number): Promise<ScreenData | null> {
  const [a] = await db
    .select({ access: courseAccess, client: { name: clients.name, email: clients.email }, course: courseFields, protocol: protocols })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(courseAccess.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(protocols, eq(protocols.accessId, courseAccess.id))
    .where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!a || a.course.type !== "e_learning" || a.access.revokedAt !== null) return null;
  const p = a.protocol;
  const draft = draftOf(p, readStages(a.course.protocolStages));
  const photos: AssessmentPhoto[][] = draft.stages.map(() => []);
  if (p && p.round > 0) {
    const rows = await db
      .select({ id: practicalPhotos.id, stage: practicalPhotos.stage, round: practicalPhotos.round, width: practicalPhotos.width, height: practicalPhotos.height })
      .from(practicalPhotos)
      .where(and(eq(practicalPhotos.protocolId, p.id), lte(practicalPhotos.round, p.round))) // (the round being prepared is the student's, not sent yet)
      .orderBy(asc(practicalPhotos.stage), desc(practicalPhotos.round), asc(practicalPhotos.id));
    for (const r of rows) photos[r.stage]?.push({ id: r.id, round: r.round, width: r.width, height: r.height });
  }
  /** A stored list read along the points: one entry per point, null for none. */
  const along = (list: readonly (Verdict | null)[] | undefined) => draft.stages.map((_, i) => list?.[i] ?? null);
  const status = practicalStatus(p);
  return {
    kind: "access",
    course: { id: a.course.id, title: a.course.title },
    session: null,
    students: [{ registrationId: a.access.id, name: a.client.name.trim() || a.client.email, status: "confirmed", protocol: draft, state: protocolStatus(p) }],
    hidden: 0,
    assessment: {
      accessId: a.access.id,
      clientId: a.access.clientId,
      email: a.client.email,
      status,
      round: p?.round ?? 0,
      submittedAt: p?.submittedAt ?? null,
      verdicts: along(p?.verdicts),
      sentVerdicts: p?.sent ? along(p.sent.verdicts) : null,
      photos,
      locked: status === "passed",
      expiresAt: a.access.expiresAt,
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * What a save sends: its owner — the registration (`registrationId`) or the e-course access (`accessId`), exactly one of them — the protocol's
 * row the screen's text is of (`protocolId`; null: none yet; absent: a screen from before the row was sent, checked by the version only), the
 * version the screen has (0: none yet), the headings it shows and the notes under them, one note for each heading (a body with another count
 * is not a save, so a `SaveInput` always has as many notes as titles).
 */
export const saveBody = z
  .object({
    registrationId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647).optional(),
    accessId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647).optional(),
    protocolId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647).nullable().optional(),
    version: z.number().int().min(0).max(2_147_483_647),
    titles: z.array(z.string().max(PROTOCOL_LIMITS.title)).max(PROTOCOL_LIMITS.stages),
    notes: z.array(z.string()).max(PROTOCOL_LIMITS.stages),
    generalNote: z.string(),
  })
  .refine((body) => body.notes.length === body.titles.length, { message: "one note for each heading", path: ["notes"] })
  .refine((body) => (body.registrationId === undefined) !== (body.accessId === undefined), { message: "one owner", path: ["registrationId"] });
export type SaveInput = z.infer<typeof saveBody>;
```

  4. After the `SaveResult` type (line 47) add:

```ts
/** Whose protocol a save is: a contact course's registration, or an e-course access (phase e-course completion). */
export type Owner = { registrationId: number } | { accessId: number };

/** The owner a save names (saveBody lets exactly one through; a direct call names one too). */
export const ownerOf = (input: SaveInput): Owner => (input.accessId !== undefined ? { accessId: input.accessId } : { registrationId: input.registrationId! });
```

  5. `current` and its comment (lines 55–65) become:

```ts
/**
 * The owner's headings and protocol; null when there is no such registration of a contact course, or no such access to an e-course. A revoked
 * access is not Maria's to assess any more (spec §8, Review Focus 4): null; an ended one still is. An access's headings are its course's
 * practical points (`courses.protocol_stages`, D6), copied into the protocol when it is made.
 */
async function current(db: Db, owner: Owner): Promise<{ headings: string[]; stored: Protocol | null } | null> {
  if ("accessId" in owner) {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ type: courses.type, headings: courses.protocolStages, revokedAt: courseAccess.revokedAt, protocol: protocols })
      .from(courseAccess)
      .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
      .leftJoin(protocols, eq(protocols.accessId, courseAccess.id))
      .where(eq(courseAccess.id, owner.accessId))
      .limit(1);
    return row && row.type === "e_learning" && row.revokedAt === null ? { headings: readStages(row.headings), stored: row.protocol } : null;
  }
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ type: courses.type, headings: courses.protocolStages, protocol: protocols })
    .from(registrations)
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(registrations.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(protocols, eq(protocols.registrationId, registrations.id))
    .where(eq(registrations.id, owner.registrationId))
    .limit(1);
  return row && row.type === "contact" ? { headings: readStages(row.headings), stored: row.protocol } : null;
}

/**
 * The version a save builds on: the one it carries — except the first save of an access's screen that showed no protocol yet (version 0, no row)
 * when the stored row is the one the student's first photo made (server/practical.ts addPhoto: the course's points, version 1, no text). That
 * row holds nobody's words, so the save builds on it (nothing is overwritten) instead of a conflict whose notice would take Maria's first words.
 */
function builtOn(owner: Owner, stored: Protocol, input: SaveInput): number {
  const unseen = "accessId" in owner && input.version === 0 && typeof input.protocolId !== "number" && stored.version === 1 && !hasText(stored);
  return unseen ? 1 : input.version;
}
```

  6. `saveProtocol` with its comment (lines 67–115) becomes:

```ts
/**
 * One save of the screen. A registration that is cancelled meanwhile still saves (spec §9: hidden and never sent, but nothing typed is lost);
 * so does an access that has ended (Maria can still assess); a revoked access does not (notFound).
 * The insert and the update are each one conditional statement (the update only of the row read); one that meets another save at the same
 * moment, or a protocol deleted and made again meanwhile, reads again and decides on what is stored then (twice at most, then the answer is a
 * conflict with the protocol as it is). No lock is taken: a send's (or an access's verdict tap's) lock on the row makes the update wait, and
 * its version check then decides.
 * The contract with the screen: a save from an older version whose text differs from what is stored is answered with a conflict and the
 * stored protocol, even when the stored text is the screen's own earlier save whose answer was lost. Recognising a lost answer of its own is
 * the client's job: the screen keeps every unacknowledged text it sent and treats a conflict whose stored text equals one of them as its own save.
 */
export async function saveProtocol(db: Db, input: SaveInput, now: Date): Promise<SaveResult> {
  const owner = ownerOf(input);
  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    const found = await current(db, owner);
    if (!found) return { kind: "notFound" };
    const { headings, stored } = found;
    // a save built on a row (protocolId) is refused by any other one, and by none: a protocol deleted with the account and made again starts
    // again from version 1, so the version alone would let a screen of the old row overwrite the new one once it reached the same version
    const otherRow = typeof input.protocolId === "number" && input.protocolId !== stored?.id;
    if (stored === null) {
      if (otherRow || input.version !== 0 || !sameList(headings, input.titles)) return { kind: "conflict", protocol: draftOf(null, headings) };
      const [created] = await db
        .insert(protocols)
        .values({
          ...("accessId" in owner ? { accessId: owner.accessId } : { registrationId: owner.registrationId }),
          stages: input.titles.map((title, i) => ({ title, note: input.notes[i] })),
          generalNote: input.generalNote,
          version: 1,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        })
        .onConflictDoNothing({ target: "accessId" in owner ? protocols.accessId : protocols.registrationId })
        .returning();
      if (created) return { kind: "saved", protocolId: created.id, version: created.version, savedAt: now };
    } else {
      if (otherRow) return { kind: "conflict", protocol: draftOf(stored, headings) };
      if (holds(stored, input)) return { kind: "saved", protocolId: stored.id, version: stored.version, savedAt: stored.updatedAt };
      const from = builtOn(owner, stored, input);
      if (from !== stored.version || !sameList(titlesOf(stored.stages), input.titles)) return { kind: "conflict", protocol: draftOf(stored, headings) };
      const [updated] = await db
        .update(protocols)
        .set({ stages: stored.stages.map((s, i) => ({ title: s.title, note: input.notes[i] })), generalNote: input.generalNote, version: sql`${protocols.version} + 1`, updatedAt: now })
        .where(and(eq(protocols.id, stored.id), eq(protocols.version, from))) // (the row read: one made again meanwhile is not it)
        .returning();
      if (updated) return { kind: "saved", protocolId: updated.id, version: updated.version, savedAt: now };
    }
    if (attempt >= 1) {
      const last = await current(db, owner);
      return last ? { kind: "conflict", protocol: draftOf(last.stored, last.headings) } : { kind: "notFound" };
    }
  }
}
```

  8. `handleRead` with its comment (lines 172–192) becomes:

```ts
/**
 * GET /api/admin/protokoll?sessioon=<id> | ?registreering=<id> | ?ligipaas=<access id> — the protocol screen's data again (the route wraps this
 * in withAdmin): what the page handed the screen when it was rendered, read now (the first of the three in the address wins). A screen the
 * browser restored from its cache (the Back button) shows the render of the visit, older than what was saved since, so it asks for this and
 * takes the server's text (protocol-autosave.ts reconcile); an access's screen also takes the practical work from it (AssessmentScreen.tsx).
 * 200 `{ ok: true, students }` (domain/protocols.ts ScreenStudentView, the page's own); 400 `{ error: "body" }` without a valid id; 404
 * `{ error: "notFound" }` for no such session or registration of a contact course, or no such access to an e-course (or a revoked one); 500
 * `{ error: "server" }`, logged by the id. Never cached. Reads only: nothing is created by looking.
 */
export async function handleRead(db: Db, request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  const query = new URL(request.url).searchParams;
  const sessionId = parseRowId(query.get("sessioon") ?? "");
  const registrationId = sessionId === null ? parseRowId(query.get("registreering") ?? "") : null;
  const accessId = sessionId === null && registrationId === null ? parseRowId(query.get("ligipaas") ?? "") : null;
  const target = sessionId !== null ? { sessionId } : registrationId !== null ? { registrationId } : accessId !== null ? { accessId } : null;
  if (!target) return json({ ok: false, error: "body" }, 400);
  try {
    const screen = await protocolScreen(db, target);
    if (!screen) return json({ ok: false, error: "notFound" }, 404);
    return json({ ok: true, students: screenStudents(screen) });
  } catch (e) {
    const which = sessionId !== null ? `session ${sessionId}` : registrationId !== null ? `registration ${registrationId}` : `access ${accessId}`;
    logFailure(`[protocols] ${which}: the screen could not be read`, e);
    return json({ ok: false, error: "server" }, 500);
  }
}
```

```ts
// sent, stored at once outside the notes' version; "Saada hinnang" — its refusals, the frozen copy with the verdicts and sent_round, the mail after
// the commit (never a note in it), the completion once, the notes sent again after an approval, the notes-only protocol of an e-course without

const NEXT = new Date("2026-11-12T09:00:00Z");

const LAST = new Date("2026-11-14T09:00:00Z");

}

    expect(await sendAssessment(d, { accessId: gone.id, version: 1, protocolId: q.id })).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });

    expect(await stored(gone.id)).toMatchObject({ version: 1, verdicts: [null, null, null], sentAt: null });
    expect(queued()).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { courses, protocols, type SentProtocol, type Verdict } from "@/db/schema";
import { practicalStatus, type PracticalStatus } from "@/domain/completion";
import { hasText, PROTOCOL_LIMITS, readStages } from "@/domain/protocols";
import type { CompletionMailKind } from "./account-mail";
import { completeIfDone, completionJob, lockAccess, mailCompletion } from "./completion";
import { logFailure } from "./log";
import type { SendDeps } from "./protocols";

// Maria's assessment of an e-course's practical work (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3, §8; R2, R3), without Next.js: the verdict taps
// (saveVerdict, behind POST /api/admin/hinnang) and "Saada hinnang" (sendAssessment, behind actions/admin-assessment.ts). The admin session is
// checked by the callers (withAdmin, adminAction). The notes are the protocol's own autosave (server/protocols.ts saveProtocol with the access
// as the owner); the verdicts are a column of their own, saved per tap, which the notes' version check does not cover (R2), and the sent copy
// carries them. Every write here locks the access row first (server/completion.ts lockAccess), then the protocol row (FOR UPDATE): the order of
// every writer about one access (the student's photos and submit, server/practical.ts; the test, server/test-attempts.ts), so none of them can
// deadlock with another, and a tap or a send never meets the student's submit half done. Logs carry the access's id only: never a note, a name
// or an address.

/** One tap: the access, the protocol's row the screen shows, the point (0-based) and its verdict (null: cleared, the pressed button tapped again). */
export const verdictBody = z.object({
  accessId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647),
  protocolId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647),
  stage: z.number().int().min(0).max(PROTOCOL_LIMITS.stages - 1),
  verdict: z.enum(["ok", "fix"]).nullable(),
});
export type VerdictInput = z.infer<typeof verdictBody>;

/**
 * saved: the verdicts as stored now (one per point); closed: nothing was sent by the student yet (no protocol, or round 0), or every point is
 * approved and sent (the verdicts are locked: spec §8); stale: the screen's row is not the stored one, or the point is not the protocol's;
 * notFound: no such access, or a revoked one.
 */
export type VerdictResult = { kind: "saved"; verdicts: (Verdict | null)[] } | { kind: "closed" } | { kind: "stale" } | { kind: "notFound" };

/**
 * One tap (R2): last tap wins. An ended access is still assessed (spec §8); a revoked one is not. The tap writes `verdicts[stage]` (the list
 * read along the points, so one stored shorter is filled with nulls) and the protocol's `updated_at`; never the notes' version: a screen of the
 * same protocol on another device is not told to reload by it (its next read brings the verdicts).
 */
export async function saveVerdict(db: Db, input: VerdictInput, now: Date): Promise<VerdictResult> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<VerdictResult> => {
    const access = await lockAccess(tx as unknown as Db, input.accessId);
    if (!access || access.revokedAt !== null) return { kind: "notFound" };
    const [p] = await tx.select().from(protocols).where(eq(protocols.accessId, input.accessId)).for("update");
    if (!p) return { kind: "closed" }; // (her first photo makes the protocol: none, nothing sent)
    if (p.id !== input.protocolId || input.stage >= p.stages.length) return { kind: "stale" };
    if (p.round === 0 || practicalStatus(p) === "passed") return { kind: "closed" };
    const verdicts = p.stages.map((_, i) => (i === input.stage ? input.verdict : (p.verdicts[i] ?? null)));
    await tx.update(protocols).set({ verdicts, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(protocols.id, p.id));
    return { kind: "saved", verdicts };
  });
}

/** A tap's body is a few dozen characters: anything far longer is not one. */
export const MAX_VERDICT_CHARS = 1024;

const json = (body: unknown, status = 200): Response => Response.json(body, { status, headers: { "cache-control": "no-store" } });

/**
 * POST /api/admin/hinnang — one verdict tap (the route wraps this in withAdmin). 200 `{ ok: true, verdicts }`; 409 `{ ok: false, error: "closed" |
 * "stale" }`; 404 `{ ok: false, error: "notFound" }`; 400 `{ error: "body" }` (not a tap); 413 `{ error: "size" }`; 500 `{ error: "server" }`,
 * logged by the access's id. Never cached.
 */
export async function handleVerdict(db: Db, request: Request, now: Date): Promise<Response> {
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    const text = await request.text();
    if (text.length > MAX_VERDICT_CHARS) return json({ ok: false, error: "size" }, 413);
    value = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return json({ ok: false, error: "body" }, 400);
  }
  const parsed = verdictBody.safeParse(value);
  if (!parsed.success) return json({ ok: false, error: "body" }, 400);
  try {
    const result = await saveVerdict(db, parsed.data, now);
    if (result.kind === "saved") return json({ ok: true, verdicts: result.verdicts });
    if (result.kind === "notFound") return json({ ok: false, error: "notFound" }, 404);
    return json({ ok: false, error: result.kind }, 409);
  } catch (e) {
    logFailure(`[assessment] access ${parsed.data.accessId}: the verdict failed`, e);
    return json({ ok: false, error: "server" }, 500);
  }
}

/** What "Saada hinnang" names: the access, the notes' version the screen confirmed, and the protocol's row it shows (null: none yet). */
export type AssessmentInput = { accessId: number; version: number; protocolId: number | null };

/**
 * sent: frozen now (`status` after it; `completed`: this send completed the course); notSubmitted: the course has points and the student has
 * sent nothing yet; verdicts / comments: the points (0-based) without a verdict, or "Paranda" without a note; already: nothing new since the
 * last send; stale: the stored version or row is not the screen's (`version`: the stored one); empty: notes only and nothing written;
 * notFound: no such access to an e-course, or a revoked one.
 */
export type AssessmentResult =
  | { kind: "sent"; status: PracticalStatus; completed: boolean; version: number; sentAt: string }
  | { kind: "notSubmitted" }
  | { kind: "verdicts"; missing: number[] }
  | { kind: "comments"; missing: number[] }
  | { kind: "already"; version: number; sentAt: string }
  | { kind: "stale"; version: number }
  | { kind: "empty" }
  | { kind: "notFound" };

/** The mail of a send, made after the commit (Task 2's completionMail through Task 4's mailCompletion). */
type AssessmentMail = { kind: CompletionMailKind; fixCount?: number };

/** Two verdict lists alike point by point (a sent copy without verdicts is none). */
const sameVerdicts = (a: readonly (Verdict | null)[] | undefined, b: readonly (Verdict | null)[]): boolean =>
  a !== undefined && a.length === b.length && a.every((v, i) => (v ?? null) === b[i]);

/**
 * "Saada hinnang" (spec §5.3, §8; R2), in one transaction:
 * 1. the locks: the access (revoked: notFound; ended: still assessed), then the protocol row;
 * 2. the checks: no protocol (nothing submitted, nothing written); another version or row than the screen's: stale;
 * 3. an e-course without points (the protocol's own copy has none): the notes-only protocol, sent as a contact course's ("protocol", then
 *    "protocolAgain"); with points: nothing submitted yet (round 0), a point without a verdict, a "Paranda" without a note are refused; approved
 *    and sent before: the verdicts are locked, changed notes go again alone; the same round, version and verdicts as the last send: already;
 * 4. the freeze: `sent` = { stages, generalNote, verdicts }, sent_at, sent_version, sent_round = round; every point ok: completeIfDone
 *    (completed_at once, in this transaction).
 * The mail goes after the commit (`later`): see the table in the plan's Task 10; it never carries a note, and a sample address is never mailed
 * (mailCompletion). A mail that fails never undoes the send.
 */
export async function sendAssessment(deps: SendDeps, input: AssessmentInput): Promise<AssessmentResult> {
  const done = await deps.db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<{ result: AssessmentResult; mail: AssessmentMail | null }> => {
    const t = tx as unknown as Db;
    const none = (result: AssessmentResult) => ({ result, mail: null });
    const access = await lockAccess(t, input.accessId);
    if (!access || access.revokedAt !== null) return none({ kind: "notFound" });
    const [course] = await tx.select({ type: courses.type, points: courses.protocolStages }).from(courses).where(eq(courses.id, access.courseId)).limit(1);
    if (!course || course.type !== "e_learning") return none({ kind: "notFound" });
    const [p] = await tx.select().from(protocols).where(eq(protocols.accessId, input.accessId)).for("update");
    if (!p) return none(readStages(course.points).length > 0 ? { kind: "notSubmitted" } : { kind: "empty" });
    if (p.version !== input.version || (input.protocolId !== null && p.id !== input.protocolId)) return none({ kind: "stale", version: p.version });
    const verdicts = p.stages.map((_, i) => p.verdicts[i] ?? null);
    const freeze = async (frozen: (Verdict | null)[]): Promise<SentProtocol> => {
      const sent: SentProtocol = { stages: p.stages, generalNote: p.generalNote, verdicts: frozen };
      await tx.update(protocols).set({ sent, sentAt: deps.now, sentVersion: p.version, sentRound: p.round }).where(eq(protocols.id, p.id));
      return sent;
    };
    const sentAs = (status: PracticalStatus, completed: boolean): AssessmentResult => ({ kind: "sent", status, completed, version: p.version, sentAt: deps.now.toISOString() });
    const already = (sentAt: Date): AssessmentResult => ({ kind: "already", version: p.version, sentAt: sentAt.toISOString() });

    // an e-course without points: Maria's notes only (spec §4.3 last bullet, §5.3 last bullet)
    if (p.stages.length === 0) {
      if (!hasText(p)) return none({ kind: "empty" });
      if (p.sentAt !== null && p.sentVersion === p.version) return none(already(p.sentAt));
      const sent = await freeze([]);
      return { result: sentAs(practicalStatus({ round: p.round, sentRound: p.round, sent }), false), mail: { kind: p.sentAt === null ? "protocol" : "protocolAgain" } };
    }
    if (p.round === 0) return none({ kind: "notSubmitted" });
    if (practicalStatus(p) === "passed" && p.sentAt !== null) {
      // approved and sent: the verdicts are locked; changed notes go again, and only they (spec §8)
      if (p.sentVersion === p.version) return none(already(p.sentAt));
      await freeze(p.sent?.verdicts ?? verdicts);
      const completed = await completeIfDone(t, access.id, deps.now); // (a step added since the approval may have kept it open until now)
      return { result: sentAs("passed", completed), mail: { kind: completed ? "completed" : "protocolAgain" } };
    }
    const missing = verdicts.flatMap((v, i) => (v === null ? [i] : []));
    if (missing.length > 0) return none({ kind: "verdicts", missing });
    const bare = verdicts.flatMap((v, i) => (v === "fix" && p.stages[i].note.trim() === "" ? [i] : []));
    if (bare.length > 0) return none({ kind: "comments", missing: bare });
    if (p.sentAt !== null && p.sentRound === p.round && p.sentVersion === p.version && sameVerdicts(p.sent?.verdicts, verdicts)) return none(already(p.sentAt));
    await freeze(verdicts);
    const fixCount = verdicts.filter((v) => v === "fix").length;
    if (fixCount > 0) return { result: sentAs("fix", false), mail: { kind: "assessed", fixCount } };
    const completed = await completeIfDone(t, access.id, deps.now);
    return { result: sentAs("passed", completed), mail: { kind: completed ? "completed" : "assessed" } };
  });
  if (done.result.kind === "sent") console.info(`[assessment] access ${input.accessId}: sent (${done.result.status}${done.result.completed ? ", completed" : ""})`);
  const mail = done.mail;
  if (mail) deps.later(() => mailAssessment(deps, input.accessId, mail));
  return done.result;
}

/** The student's mail of a send, after the commit: to whom and in which language is Task 4's completionJob, the sending mailCompletion (logged by the access's id). */
async function mailAssessment(deps: SendDeps, accessId: number, mail: AssessmentMail): Promise<void> {
  const job = await completionJob(deps.db, accessId);
  if (job) await mailCompletion(deps.env, deps.siteUrl, job, mail.kind, mail.fixCount);
}
```

```ts
"use server";

import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { after } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { getDb } from "@/db/client";
import { sendAssessment, type AssessmentInput, type AssessmentResult } from "../assessment";
import { adminAction } from "../auth";
import { serverEnv } from "../env";
import { serverKv } from "../kv";
import { logFailure } from "../log";
import type { SendDeps } from "../protocols";
import { linkBase, requestOrigin } from "../site";

// Maria's assessment (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3): every export is wrapped in adminAction (a signed-in admin, or a redirect to
// /admin/login; tests/unit/admin-guards.test.ts fails otherwise), and Next.js refuses an action called from another origin. The work is in
// ../assessment.ts. The screen keeps its own state, so nothing is refreshed here. Task 12 adds the test review's actions to this file.

const item = z.object({
  accessId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647),
  // the notes' version the screen confirmed (0: no protocol yet, which the server answers as nothing to send)
  version: z.number().int().min(0).max(2_147_483_647),
  // the protocol's row the screen showed (null: none yet): a zod object drops a key it does not list, so it is listed
  protocolId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647).nullable(),
});

async function deps(): Promise<SendDeps> {
  const env = { ...serverEnv(), KV: serverKv() };
  return {
    db: getDb(),
    env,
    // the mail's links: the address Maria works on (mslab.ee), or SITE_URL
    siteUrl: linkBase(requestOrigin(await headers()), env.SITE_URL),
    now: new Date(),
    later: (task) => after(() => task().catch((e) => logFailure("[assessment] a mail failed", e))),
  };
}

/** "Saada hinnang" (and an e-course's notes-only "Saada"): one access, at the version the screen confirmed; a throw is "failed", logged by the access's id. */
export const sendAssessmentAction = adminAction(async (_admin, input: AssessmentInput): Promise<AssessmentResult | { kind: "failed" }> => {
  const parsed = item.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) return { kind: "notFound" };
  try {
    return await sendAssessment(await deps(), parsed.data);
  } catch (e) {
    logFailure(`[assessment] access ${parsed.data.accessId}: the send failed`, e);
    return { kind: "failed" };
  }
});
```

### Task 11: Maria's assessment screen — the autosave's `owner`, `?ligipaas=`, the photos, the verdicts, "Saada hinnang"

Spec sections 5.3 (the header, under each point the photos, "Varasemad fotod", the verdict buttons and the note box; "Saada hinnang" with one confirmation; notes before the submission; the notes-only protocol of an e-course without points; no "Lukusta ja saada kõik"), 8 (Maria corrects a sent assessment of the same round; the verdicts locked after the approval; an ended access) and D6. Rulings **R2** (each tap is stored at once through `POST /api/admin/hinnang`; a failed tap keeps its look with "Salvestamata"; "Saada hinnang" refuses until every tap is stored), **R3** (the student's new round reaches an open screen at its next read — the window's focus, the network back, the page from the browser's cache, a tab hidden over five minutes, or a refused send — and a re-submitted round opens the notes without "Muuda", since their version did not move) and **R5** (the photos are `/api/admin/foto/<id>` and `?v=pisi`).

**The autosave engine changes as little as possible.** `protocol-autosave.ts` (1400 lines, its 1674-line test) gets one option, `owner`, threaded into exactly three places: the three storage key builders (an access's copies are `mslab-practical…`, so registration 7 and access 7 never share a copy in one browser), `bodyOf` (the save names `accessId` instead of `registrationId`), and `getScreen`'s query (`?ligipaas=`). A registration's keys, bodies (the same fields in the same order) and reads are byte for byte as before: every existing test passes unchanged, and new ones pin both owners.

**The verdicts are not the engine's** (R2). `verdict-taps.ts` keeps them: one request at a time, each with the point's latest choice (the last tap wins on the server too); a tap with no answer stays with "Salvestamata" and goes again first with the next tap and before "Saada hinnang"; a refused one (the work changed meanwhile) is dropped and the screen reads the server again.

**`ProtocolScreen` gets three optional props** (Self-review, "Spec against the code" row 15): `stageExtra(index, state)` — rendered under each stage's heading, above its box (inside `NoteBox`, after its `<label>`, so the box keeps the heading as its label); `sendBar(entry, state)` — instead of `StudentSend`; `opened` — a sent protocol shows open without "Muuda" (an access's new round waits for Maria). `state` is `EditorState`: the engine, the entry, `locked` (sent and not opened), `frozen` (locked or a send on its way), `unlocked`, `onUnlock`. Without them the screen renders exactly as before.

**The screen reads the practical work with the notes.** `AssessmentScreen` wraps the read `ProtocolScreen` already makes (`keepReading`: its `read` prop): each 200 answer's student carries `assessment` (Task 10), which the wrapper takes for the photos, the status and the server's verdicts — no request of its own, nothing polls.

  3. The key builders (lines 126–131) become:

```ts
/**
 * Whose protocols a screen edits: a contact course's registrations (the course day), or an e-course access (Maria's assessment, phase e-course
 * completion). Their ids are of two tables, so one number can be both: their saves name the owner (bodyOf), and this browser keeps their copies
 * under keys of their own (ownerKeys).
 */
export type ScreenOwner = "registration" | "access";

/** The keys of one owner's protocols in this browser's storage (see localKey, sentKey and conflictKey below). */
export type OwnerKeys = {
  localKey: (id: number, tab?: string) => string;
  sentKey: (id: number, tab: string) => string;
  conflictKey: (id: number, tab?: string) => string;
};

/** A registration's keys are `mslab-protocol…`, as before the access owner came; an access's are `mslab-practical…`. */
export function ownerKeys(owner: ScreenOwner): OwnerKeys {
  const prefix = owner === "access" ? "mslab-practical" : "mslab-protocol";
  return {
    localKey: (id, tab) => `${prefix}:${id}${tab ? `:${tab}` : ""}`,
    sentKey: (id, tab) => `${prefix}-sent:${id}:${tab}`,
    conflictKey: (id, tab) => `${prefix}-conflict:${id}${tab ? `:${tab}` : ""}`,
  };
}

const REGISTRATION_KEYS = ownerKeys("registration");
/** A tab's copy of a registration's protocol (`tab`), or one of no tab (an older one, kept by an older screen): both are resumed. */
export const localKey = REGISTRATION_KEYS.localKey;
/** The texts a tab sent without an answer, apart from its copy: written when they change, not with every keystroke. */
export const sentKey = REGISTRATION_KEYS.sentKey;
/** A tab's notice text (or one of no tab), kept until "Selge". */
export const conflictKey = REGISTRATION_KEYS.conflictKey;
```

  6. `readLocal` and `readConflict` (lines 329–341) become:

```ts
/** A copy this browser kept of a protocol: `tab`'s, or without it the newest of all; null: none, storage blocked, or not a copy of this code. `keys`: the owner's (a registration's by default). */
export function readLocal(storage: Storage | null, registrationId: number, tab?: string, keys: OwnerKeys = REGISTRATION_KEYS): LocalCopy | null {
  const all = readCopies(storage, registrationId, tab, keys);
  const wanted = tab ? all.filter((c) => c.held[0].key === keys.localKey(registrationId, tab)) : all;
  return wanted.length > 0 ? wanted[wanted.length - 1].copy : null;
}

/** A notice this browser kept (its words, until "Selge"): `tab`'s, or without it every tab's as one; null: none, or not one of this code. */
export function readConflict(storage: Storage | null, registrationId: number, tab?: string, keys: OwnerKeys = REGISTRATION_KEYS): Conflict | null {
  const all = readNotices(storage, registrationId, tab, keys);
  const wanted = tab ? all.filter((n) => n.held.key === keys.conflictKey(registrationId, tab)) : all;
  return combine(capParts(wanted.flatMap((n) => n.parts)));
}
```

```ts
  /** `owner`: whose protocols these are (absent: registrations); `tab`: this page's name for its keys (a test gives one). */
  constructor(drafts: readonly ServerDraft[], send: Send = postSave, options: { tab?: string; owner?: ScreenOwner } = {}) {
    this.send = send;
    this.tab = options.tab ?? newTabName();
    this.owner = options.owner ?? "registration";
    this.keys = ownerKeys(this.owner);
    this.order = drafts.map((d) => d.registrationId);
    for (const d of drafts) this.entries.set(d.registrationId, entryOf(d));
  }
```

```ts
  /** A save of the screen's text, naming its owner: a registration's exactly as before (the same fields in the same order), an access's by `accessId`. */
  private bodyOf(e: Entry): SaveBody {
    const text = { protocolId: e.protocolId, version: e.version, titles: [...e.titles], notes: [...e.content.notes], generalNote: e.content.generalNote };
    return this.owner === "access" ? { accessId: e.registrationId, ...text } : { registrationId: e.registrationId, ...text };
  }
```

```ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest";
import { VerdictTaps, type VerdictAnswer, type VerdictBody } from "@/components/admin/verdict-taps";

// The verdict taps of Maria's assessment screen (spec §5.3, R2): one request at a time and the last tap wins; a tap with no answer is kept
// ("Salvestamata") with the ones behind it and goes again first; a refusal drops the tap; a read's verdicts are taken for the points without a
// tap waiting. The server is answered by hand: each request waits for the test.

function server() {
  const calls: { body: VerdictBody; answer: (a: VerdictAnswer) => void }[] = [];
  const post = (body: VerdictBody) => new Promise<VerdictAnswer>((resolve) => calls.push({ body, answer: resolve }));
  return { calls, post };
}
const stored = (verdicts: ("ok" | "fix" | null)[]): VerdictAnswer => ({ status: 200, body: { ok: true, verdicts } });
const settle = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));

test("one request at a time, each with the point's latest choice: the last tap wins on the server too", async () => {
  const s = server();
  const taps = new VerdictTaps(4, [null, null], s.post);
  const first = taps.tap(9, 0, "ok");
  const second = taps.tap(9, 0, "fix"); // tapped again while the first is on its way
  expect(s.calls.map((c) => c.body)).toEqual([{ accessId: 4, protocolId: 9, stage: 0, verdict: "ok" }]);
  expect(taps.shown(0)).toBe("fix");
  s.calls[0].answer(stored(["ok", null]));
  await settle();
  expect(s.calls.map((c) => c.body.verdict)).toEqual(["ok", "fix"]);
  expect(taps.shown(0)).toBe("fix"); // the latest choice, not the first answer's
  s.calls[1].answer(stored(["fix", null]));
  expect([await first, await second]).toEqual(["saved", "saved"]);
  expect([taps.shown(0), taps.unsaved(0), s.calls.length]).toEqual(["fix", false, 2]);
});

test("no answer keeps the tap and the ones behind it ('Salvestamata'); the next tap sends the kept one first; a refusal drops a tap and says so", async () => {
  const s = server();
  const taps = new VerdictTaps(4, [null, null, null], s.post);
  const a = taps.tap(9, 0, "ok");
  s.calls[0].answer(null);
  expect(await a).toBe("unsaved");
  expect([taps.shown(0), taps.unsaved(0)]).toEqual(["ok", true]);
  const b = taps.tap(9, 1, "fix");
  await settle();
  expect(s.calls[1].body).toEqual({ accessId: 4, protocolId: 9, stage: 0, verdict: "ok" });
  s.calls[1].answer(null); // still offline: both are kept
  expect(await b).toBe("unsaved");
  expect([0, 1].map((i) => [taps.shown(i), taps.unsaved(i)])).toEqual([["ok", true], ["fix", true]]);
  const c = taps.flush(9); // "Saada hinnang" tries them again
  await settle();
  s.calls[2].answer(stored(["ok", null, null]));
  await settle();
  expect(s.calls[3].body).toEqual({ accessId: 4, protocolId: 9, stage: 1, verdict: "fix" });
  s.calls[3].answer({ status: 409, body: { ok: false, error: "closed" } });
  expect(await c).toBe("refused");
  expect([0, 1].map((i) => [taps.shown(i), taps.unsaved(i)])).toEqual([["ok", false], [null, false]]);
});

test("take: a read's verdicts for every point; a tap still waiting stays on top of its point; a flush with nothing waiting sends nothing", async () => {
  const s = server();

  expect([0, 1, 2].map((i) => taps.shown(i))).toEqual(["fix", "ok", "ok"]);
  s.calls[0].answer(stored(["fix", "ok", "ok"]));
  await settle();
  expect(await taps.flush(9)).toBe("saved");
  expect(s.calls).toHaveLength(1);
});
```

```ts
import { SAVE_TIMEOUT_MS } from "./protocol-autosave";

// The verdict taps of Maria's assessment screen (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3, R2): "Kinnitatud" / "Paranda" are taps, each stored at
// once through POST /api/admin/hinnang into protocols.verdicts — outside the notes' autosave and its version check (a tap is discrete: nothing
// to wait for). One request at a time, each with the point's latest choice, so the last tap wins on the server too. A tap that gets no answer
// (offline, a server error, signed out) keeps its look and says "Salvestamata", with the taps behind it; they go again with the next tap and
// before "Saada hinnang" (AssessmentSend.tsx). A refusal (the work changed meanwhile: approved on another device, nothing submitted, the row made
// again) drops the tap: the screen reads the server again (AssessmentScreen.tsx). This file runs on old iPads: no lookbehind
// (tests/unit/old-safari.test.ts).

/** One tap as POST /api/admin/hinnang takes it (server/assessment.ts verdictBody): null clears the point's verdict. */
export type VerdictBody = { accessId: number; protocolId: number; stage: number; verdict: Verdict | null };
/** The route's answer; null when none came (no connection, the 10 s ran out). */
export type VerdictAnswer = { status: number; body: unknown } | null;
export type PostVerdict = (body: VerdictBody) => Promise<VerdictAnswer>;

/** POST /api/admin/hinnang with the admin's cookie, given up after 10 s. Never throws. */
export async function postVerdict(body: VerdictBody): Promise<VerdictAnswer> {
  const abort = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => abort.abort(), SAVE_TIMEOUT_MS);
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/api/admin/hinnang", {
      method: "POST",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      signal: abort.signal,
    });
    return { status: res.status, body: await res.json().catch(() => null) };
  } catch {
    return null;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

const isVerdicts = (v: unknown): v is (Verdict | null)[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every((x) => x === "ok" || x === "fix" || x === null);

/** How a flush ended: every tap stored; one got no answer (it and those behind it are kept); or one was refused (dropped: read the server again). */
export type TapsResult = "saved" | "unsaved" | "refused";

/** The verdict taps of one access's screen (see the top of the file); `subscribe` / `snapshot` for useSyncExternalStore. */
export class VerdictTaps {
  /** The server's last word on the verdicts: a tap's answer, or a read of the screen. */
  private stored: (Verdict | null)[];
  /** The taps not stored yet, by point: each point's latest choice (null: cleared). */
  private readonly chosen = new Map<number, Verdict | null>();
  /** The points whose tap got no answer: "Salvestamata". */
  private readonly failed = new Set<number>();
  private running: Promise<TapsResult> | null = null;
  private readonly listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private revision = 0;
  private readonly accessId: number;
  private readonly post: PostVerdict;

  constructor(accessId: number, stored: readonly (Verdict | null)[], post: PostVerdict = postVerdict) {
    this.accessId = accessId;
    this.stored = [...stored];
    this.post = post;
  }

  readonly subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => void this.listeners.delete(listener);
  };

  readonly snapshot = (): number => this.revision;

  /** The verdict a point shows: its tap still waiting, else the server's. */
  shown(stage: number): Verdict | null {
    return this.chosen.has(stage) ? (this.chosen.get(stage) ?? null) : (this.stored[stage] ?? null);
  }

  /** Did the point's tap get no answer (kept here: tried again with the next tap and before "Saada hinnang")? */
  unsaved(stage: number): boolean {
    return this.failed.has(stage);
  }

  /** The server's verdicts read again (a read of the screen, or what a send froze): a tap still waiting stays on top of its point. */
  take(stored: readonly (Verdict | null)[]): void {
    this.stored = [...stored];
    this.changed();
  }

  /** A tap: shown at once, then stored with the others waiting (flush). */
  tap(protocolId: number, stage: number, verdict: Verdict | null): Promise<TapsResult> {
    this.chosen.set(stage, verdict);
    this.changed();
    return this.flush(protocolId);
  }

  /** Sends the taps waiting, after the round of requests on its way (never beside it). */
  flush(protocolId: number): Promise<TapsResult> {
    const before = this.running;
    if (before) return before.then(() => this.flush(protocolId));
    const run = this.send(protocolId);
    this.running = run;
    void run.then(() => {
      if (this.running === run) this.running = null;
    });
    return run;
  }

  /**
   * One request at a time, each with its point's latest choice (a point tapped again while its request was on its way goes again). No answer, or
   * one that is not the route's (a server error, signed out), stops the round: the waiting taps stay, "Salvestamata". A refusal (400, 404, 409)
   * drops that tap, and the round goes on with the others.
   */
  private async send(protocolId: number): Promise<TapsResult> {
    let result: TapsResult = "saved";
    for (;;) {
      const next = this.chosen.keys().next();
      if (next.done) return result;
      const stage = next.value;
      const verdict = this.chosen.get(stage) ?? null;
      const answer = await this.post({ accessId: this.accessId, protocolId, stage, verdict });
      const reply = (answer?.body ?? null) as { ok?: unknown; verdicts?: unknown } | null;
      if (answer && answer.status === 200 && reply?.ok === true && isVerdicts(reply.verdicts)) {
        this.stored = reply.verdicts;
        this.failed.delete(stage);
        if (this.chosen.get(stage) === verdict) this.chosen.delete(stage); // (tapped again meanwhile: that choice goes next)
        this.changed();
        continue;
      }
      if (answer && (answer.status === 400 || answer.status === 404 || answer.status === 409)) {
        this.chosen.delete(stage);
        this.failed.delete(stage);
        result = "refused";
        this.changed();
        continue;
      }
      for (const waiting of this.chosen.keys()) this.failed.add(waiting);
      this.changed();
      return result === "refused" ? "refused" : "unsaved";
    }
  }

  private changed(): void {
    this.revision++;
    for (const listener of this.listeners) listener();
  }
}
```

```css
/* Maria's assessment of an e-course's practical work (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3): the status line above the protocol screen; under
   each point its photos (the newest round's, the earlier ones folded and smaller), the verdict buttons and the "Salvestamata" mark; and the
   full-screen photo viewer. Tokens only (tests/unit/colour-tokens.test.ts); every target at least 44 px; no animation, so
   prefers-reduced-motion has nothing to turn off. */

.screen {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.statusLine {
  margin: 0;
}

.stage {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 2px 0 4px;
}

.thumbs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.thumb {
  display: block;
  width: 88px;
  height: 88px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--canvas);
  cursor: zoom-in;
}

.thumb img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.thumb:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.earlier {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.earlier summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  font: 600 13px/1.3 var(--font-body);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.earlier .thumb {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
}

.earlierRound {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.verdicts {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.verdict:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* the chosen verdict: filled (two classes, so it wins over ui.secondary whichever stylesheet comes first) */
.verdict.okOn,
.verdict.okOn:hover {
  border-color: var(--ok);
  background: var(--ok);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.verdict.fixOn,
.verdict.fixOn:hover {
  border-color: var(--bad);
  background: var(--bad);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.unsaved {
  color: var(--bad);
  font: 600 12px/1.3 var(--font-body);
}

/* the viewer: a modal <dialog> over the whole screen. The photo fits it; the browser's own pinch zoom enlarges it (touch-action on its box),
   and a one-finger swipe is read from the pointer events (PhotoViewer.tsx). */
.viewer {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  height: 100%;
  max-height: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

.viewer[open] {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.viewer::backdrop {
  background: transparent;
}

.viewerTop {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
}

.counter {
  font: 400 13px/1 var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.frame {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0 16px 16px;
  touch-action: pinch-zoom;
}

.image {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  user-select: none;
}

.roundBtn {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 35%, transparent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 55%, transparent);
  color: var(--paper);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.roundBtn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--paper);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.prev,
.next {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.prev {
  left: 12px;
}

.next {
  right: 12px;
}

/* the arrow icon points right: the previous one is its mirror */
.prev svg {
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .frame {
    padding: 0 0 88px;
  }

  /* on a phone the buttons sit under the photo, out of the way of the swipe */
  .prev,
  .next {
    top: auto;
    bottom: 20px;
    transform: none;
  }

  .prev {
    left: calc(50% - 60px);
  }

  .next {
    right: calc(50% - 60px);
  }
}
```

  4. Create `src/components/admin/PhotoViewer.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, type KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent } from "react";
import type { AssessmentView } from "@/domain/protocols";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { lockPageScroll, trapTab } from "@/lib/modal";
import { AdminIcon } from "./AdminIcon";
import styles from "./Assessment.module.css";

/** One submitted photo of a point: the full one is /api/admin/foto/<id>, its thumbnail ?v=pisi (Task 7's route). */
export type Photo = AssessmentView["photos"][number][number];

/** A one-finger (or mouse) move across the photo of at least this many px goes to the next or the previous one. */
export const SWIPE_PX = 50;

/**
 * One point's photos full-screen (spec §5.3: "a tap opens a full-screen viewer with swipe between photos and pinch zoom"). A modal <dialog>: the
 * page behind is inert and still, Tab stays inside, Esc and ✕ close it, ←/→, the buttons and a swipe move round, and the focus goes back to
 * `returnTo` (the thumbnail: a tap on an iPad does not focus a button) or to what had it. The photo fits the screen; zooming is the browser's
 * own pinch (touch-action: pinch-zoom on its box), so a second finger down is never read as a swipe. No animation. Render it only while open.
 */
export function PhotoViewer({
  photos,
  index,
  onIndex,
  onClose,
  label,
  returnTo = null,
}: {
  photos: readonly Photo[];
  index: number;
  onIndex(index: number): void;
  onClose(): void;
  /** The dialog's name: the point's number and title. */
  label: string;
  returnTo?: HTMLElement | null;
}) {
  const s = adminEt.assessment.screen;
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const back = useRef(returnTo);
  /** The pointers down on the photo, by id, with where each went down. */
  const down = useRef(new Map<number, number>());
  /** A second pointer went down since none was: no swipe until every one is up (the browser's pinch). */
  const pinch = useRef(false);
  const n = photos.length;
  const go = (i: number) => onIndex((i + n) % n);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = ref.current;
    if (!dialog) return;
    const opener = back.current ?? (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null);
    const unlock = lockPageScroll();
    if (!dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
    closeRef.current?.focus();
    return () => {
      if (dialog.open) dialog.close();
      unlock();
      opener?.focus();
    };
  }, []);

  const onKeyDown = (e: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLDialogElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onClose();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (n > 1) go(index + (e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1));
    } else {
      trapTab(e, ref.current); // Tab stays inside the dialog
    }
  };
  const onPointerDown = (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    down.current.set(e.pointerId, e.clientX);
    if (down.current.size > 1) pinch.current = true;
  };
  const onPointerEnd = (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>, cancelled: boolean) => {
    const start = down.current.get(e.pointerId);
    down.current.delete(e.pointerId);
    const pinched = pinch.current;
    if (down.current.size === 0) pinch.current = false;
    if (cancelled || start === undefined || pinched || n < 2) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - start;
    if (Math.abs(dx) >= SWIPE_PX) go(index + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
  };

  const photo = photos[index];
  if (!photo) return null;
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      className={styles.viewer}
      aria-label={label}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      // Esc fires "cancel" first: closing goes through onClose, so the screen's state stays the source of truth
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
      data-photo-viewer=""
    >
      <div className={styles.viewerTop}>
        <span className={styles.counter} aria-live="polite" data-viewer-count="">
          {fill(s.viewerCount, { n: index + 1, of: n })}
        </span>
        <button ref={closeRef} type="button" className={styles.roundBtn} onClick={onClose} aria-label={s.close} data-viewer-close="">
          <AdminIcon name="close" size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div
        className={styles.frame}
        onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
        onPointerUp={(e) => onPointerEnd(e, false)}
        onPointerCancel={(e) => onPointerEnd(e, true)}
        data-viewer-frame=""
      >
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- a private photo behind the admin's session (a 302 to a signed address): next/image cannot fetch it */}
        <img key={photo.id} className={styles.image} src={`/api/admin/foto/${photo.id}`} alt={fill(s.viewerAlt, { label, n: index + 1 })} draggable={false} />
      </div>
      {n > 1 && (
        <>
          <button type="button" className={`${styles.roundBtn} ${styles.prev}`} onClick={() => go(index - 1)} aria-label={s.previous} data-viewer-prev="">
            <AdminIcon name="arrow" size={20} />
          </button>
          <button type="button" className={`${styles.roundBtn} ${styles.next}`} onClick={() => go(index + 1)} aria-label={s.next} data-viewer-next="">
            <AdminIcon name="arrow" size={20} />
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { getScreen, keepReading, postSave, ProtocolAutosave, serverDraft, statusOf, type Conflict, type Entry, type ReadScreen, type SaveStatus, type ScreenOwner, type ScreenSource } from "./protocol-autosave";
```

  2. `ScreenView` and its comment (lines 16–20) become:

```ts
/**
 * The screen's students. `single`: one registration's or one access's screen: its send is the primary button (Task 6). `source`: the address the
 * page was made from, which the screen reads its data from again (GET /api/admin/protokoll). `owner`: whose protocols they are — absent, a contact
 * course's registrations (the course day); "access", one e-course access (Maria's assessment, phase e-course completion: its saves name the
 * access, and this browser keeps its copies under keys of its own).
 */
export type ScreenView = { single: boolean; source: ScreenSource; students: ScreenStudentView[]; owner?: ScreenOwner };

/**
 * What a screen's own parts (the assessment's: AssessmentScreen.tsx) get of the protocol they sit in: the engine and its entry, whether the boxes
 * are read-only — `locked` (sent, until "Muuda" or `opened`), `frozen` (locked, or a send on its way) — and the "Muuda" state.
 */
export type EditorState = { engine: ProtocolAutosave; entry: Entry; locked: boolean; frozen: boolean; unlocked: boolean; onUnlock(on: boolean): void };
```

  3. `ProtocolScreen`'s comment gains, at its end: ` For an e-course access (AssessmentScreen.tsx) three optional props: \`stageExtra\` under each stage's heading (the photos and the verdicts), \`sendBar\` instead of the protocol's own sends ("Saada hinnang"), and \`opened\` (a sent protocol shows open without "Muuda": the access's new round waits for Maria).` Its signature and engine (lines 75–81) become:

```tsx
export function ProtocolScreen({
  view,
  read = getScreen,
  stageExtra,
  sendBar,
  opened = false,
}: {
  view: ScreenView;
  read?: ReadScreen;
  stageExtra?: (index: number, state: EditorState) => ReactNode;
  sendBar?: (entry: Entry, state: EditorState) => ReactNode;
  opened?: boolean;
}) {
  const t = adminEt.protocols;
  const [engine] = useState(() => {
    const made = new ProtocolAutosave(view.students.map(serverDraft), postSave, { owner: view.owner ?? "registration" });
    made.awaitFresh();
    return made;
  });
```

  5. `StudentEditor` (lines 185–262) becomes:

```tsx
/** One student's protocol: her name and the save's status, a conflict's notice, the practice part's boxes, the general notes, the sends. */
function StudentEditor({
  engine,
  entry,
  name,
  primary,
  unlocked,
  onUnlock,
  opened,
  stageExtra,
  sendBar,
}: {
  engine: ProtocolAutosave;
  entry: Entry;
  name: string;
  primary: boolean;
  unlocked: boolean;
  onUnlock(on: boolean): void;
  opened: boolean;
  stageExtra?: (index: number, state: EditorState) => ReactNode;
  sendBar?: (entry: Entry, state: EditorState) => ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = adminEt.protocols;
  const uid = useId();
  const id = entry.registrationId;
  // a sent protocol is read-only until "Muuda" (or `opened`: an access's new round)
  const locked = statusOf(entry) === "sent" && !unlocked && !opened;
  // read-only while it is sent, and while a send is on its way (its text must stay the one sent)
  const frozen = locked || entry.sending;
  const state: EditorState = { engine, entry, locked, frozen, unlocked, onUnlock };
  const line = statusLine(entry.status, t);
  const sentAt = entry.sentAt ? new Date(entry.sentAt) : null;
  // "Muuda" pressed: its button is gone (the hint takes its place), so the focus goes to the first box, or to the general notes when the
  // course has no headings; a screen opened again with the protocol already open takes no focus
  const section = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const wasUnlocked = useRef(unlocked);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (unlocked && !wasUnlocked.current) section.current?.querySelector("textarea")?.focus();
    wasUnlocked.current = unlocked;
  }, [unlocked]);

  return (
    <section ref={section} className={styles.editor} aria-labelledby={`${uid}-name`} data-editor={id}>
      <div className={styles.editorHead}>
        <h2 id={`${uid}-name`} className={ui.h2}>
          {name}
        </h2>
        <p role="status" className={line.failing ? ui.error : ui.hint} data-save-status={entry.status.kind}>
          {line.text}
        </p>
      </div>
      {entry.conflict && <ConflictNotice conflict={entry.conflict} onDismiss={() => engine.dismissConflict(id)} />}
      {!entry.kept && (
        <p className={ui.error} role="alert" data-not-kept="">
          {t.notKept}
        </p>
      )}
      {locked && sentAt && (
        <p className={ui.notice} data-locked="">
          {fill(t.locked, { date: `${formatDate(sentAt, "et")} ${formatTime(sentAt, "et")}` })}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className={styles.part}>
        <h3 className={ui.h3}>{t.practice}</h3>
        {entry.titles.length === 0 && <p className={ui.hint}>{t.noStages}</p>}
        {entry.titles.map((title, i) => (
          <NoteBox
            key={i}
            id={`${uid}-note-${i}`}
            label={title}
            value={entry.content.notes[i] ?? ""}
            readOnly={frozen}
            note={i}
            onChange={(v) => engine.editNote(id, i, v)}
            onBlur={() => void engine.save(id)}
            extra={stageExtra?.(i, state)}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.part}>
        <NoteBox id={`${uid}-general`} label={t.general} heading value={entry.content.generalNote} readOnly={frozen} onChange={(v) => engine.editGeneral(id, v)} onBlur={() => void engine.save(id)} />
      </div>
      {sendBar ? sendBar(entry, state) : <StudentSend engine={engine} id={id} primary={primary} unlocked={unlocked} onUnlock={onUnlock} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import type { MouseEvent } from "react";
import type { Verdict } from "@/db/schema";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import type { Photo } from "./PhotoViewer";
import ui from "./ui.module.css";
import styles from "./Assessment.module.css";

/** A point's photos by round, the newest first. */
function byRound(photos: readonly Photo[]): { round: number; photos: Photo[] }[] {
  const out: { round: number; photos: Photo[] }[] = [];
  for (const p of [...photos].sort((a, b) => b.round - a.round || a.id - b.id)) {
    const last = out[out.length - 1];
    if (last && last.round === p.round) last.photos.push(p);
    else out.push({ round: p.round, photos: [p] });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * One point of Maria's assessment, under its heading and above its note box (spec §5.3): the photos of its newest round as thumbnails (a tap
 * opens the full-screen viewer), the earlier rounds under "Varasemad fotod", folded and smaller, and the verdict buttons "Kinnitatud" and
 * "Paranda" (44 px, aria-pressed; the pressed one tapped again clears it), with "Salvestamata" while the tap is not stored (verdict-taps.ts).
 * `disabled`: nothing submitted yet, the verdicts locked after the approval, or the protocol read-only (sent, before "Muuda").
 */
export function AssessmentStage({
  index,
  photos,
  verdict,
  unsaved,
  disabled,
  onVerdict,
  onOpen,
}: {
  index: number;
  photos: readonly Photo[];
  verdict: Verdict | null;
  unsaved: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  onVerdict(verdict: Verdict | null): void;
  /** A thumbnail tapped: the photos of its round, which one, and the button (the focus goes back to it). */
  onOpen(group: readonly Photo[], at: number, from: HTMLElement): void;
}) {
  const s = adminEt.assessment.screen;
  const point = index + 1;
  const [latest, ...earlier] = byRound(photos);
  const thumbs = (group: { round: number; photos: Photo[] }, label?: string) => (
    <ul className={styles.thumbs} aria-label={label}>
      {group.photos.map((p, i) => (
        <li key={p.id}>
          <button type="button" className={styles.thumb} onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => onOpen(group.photos, i, e.currentTarget)} data-assess-photo={p.id}>
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- a private photo behind the admin's session (a 302 to a signed address): next/image cannot fetch it */}
            <img src={`/api/admin/foto/${p.id}?v=pisi`} alt={fill(s.photoAlt, { point, round: group.round, n: i + 1 })} loading="lazy" draggable={false} />
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
  const choose = (v: Verdict) => {
    if (!disabled) onVerdict(verdict === v ? null : v);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.stage} data-assess-point={index}>
      {latest ? (
        <div data-latest-photos="">{thumbs(latest, fill(s.photosOf, { point }))}</div>
      ) : (
        <p className={ui.hint} data-no-photos="">
          {s.noPhotos}
        </p>
      )}
      {earlier.length > 0 && (
        <details className={styles.earlier} data-earlier-photos="">
          <summary>{s.earlier}</summary>
          {earlier.map((g) => (
            <div key={g.round} className={styles.earlierRound}>
              <p className={ui.hint}>{fill(s.roundOf, { n: g.round })}</p>
              {thumbs(g)}
            </div>
          ))}
        </details>
      )}
      <div className={styles.verdicts} role="group" aria-label={fill(s.verdictOf, { point })}>
        {(["ok", "fix"] as const).map((v) => (
          <button
            key={v}
            type="button"
            className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn} ${styles.verdict}${verdict === v ? ` ${v === "ok" ? styles.okOn : styles.fixOn}` : ""}`}
            aria-pressed={verdict === v}
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => choose(v)}
            data-verdict={v}
          >
            {v === "ok" ? s.ok : s.fix}
          </button>
        ))}
        {unsaved && (
          <span className={styles.unsaved} data-verdict-unsaved="">
            {adminEt.protocols.unsavedMark}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

  2. Create `src/components/admin/AssessmentSend.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Verdict } from "@/db/schema";
import type { PracticalStatus } from "@/domain/completion";
import type { AssessmentView } from "@/domain/protocols";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { sendAssessmentAction } from "@/server/actions/admin-assessment";
import type { AssessmentResult } from "@/server/assessment";
import type { EditorState } from "./ProtocolScreen";
import { SEND_TIMEOUT_MS, unsavedMessage } from "./ProtocolSend";
import { sameContent, statusOf, written, type Content } from "./protocol-autosave";
import type { VerdictTaps } from "./verdict-taps";
import ui from "./ui.module.css";
import screen from "./ProtocolScreen.module.css";

// The send of Maria's assessment screen (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3, §8; R2, R3): "Saada hinnang" with one confirmation, or, for an
// e-course without points, the notes-only protocol's "Saada" as a contact course's (no confirmation). Like ProtocolSend.tsx's StudentSend, the
// send saves the notes first and sends the version the server confirmed, read-only meanwhile; and before it every verdict tap must be stored
// (verdict-taps.ts flush), so the student gets exactly what Maria sees. This file runs on old iPads: no lookbehind here or in what it imports.

type S = typeof adminEt.assessment.screen;
type T = typeof adminEt.protocols;
type Outcome = AssessmentResult | { kind: "failed" };

/** Points (0-based) in Maria's words: "2, 4". */
const list = (points: readonly number[]): string => points.map((i) => i + 1).join(", ");

/** The line a send leaves under its button: null when it went through (sent now, or already). */
export function assessMessage(result: Outcome, s: S, t: T): string | null {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case "sent":
    case "already":
      return null;
    case "notSubmitted":
      return s.errors.notSubmitted;
    case "verdicts":
      return fill(s.errors.verdicts, { points: list(result.missing) });
    case "comments":
      return fill(s.errors.comments, { points: list(result.missing) });
    case "stale":
      return t.sendErrors.stale;
    case "empty":
      return t.sendErrors.empty;
    case "notFound":
      return s.errors.notFound;
    case "failed":
      return t.sendErrors.failed;
  }
}

/** The answer of `work`, or "timeout" when none came within SEND_TIMEOUT_MS (a hung action must not keep the protocol read-only). */
function bounded<R>(work: Promise<R>): Promise<R | "timeout"> {
  return new Promise<R | "timeout">((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve("timeout"), SEND_TIMEOUT_MS);
    work.then(
      (value) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(value);
      },
      (error: unknown) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(error);
      },
    );
  });
}

/**
 * Under the access's protocol. Sent and not opened: "Muuda" (a correction of the same round; after the approval only the notes can change).
 * Otherwise "Saada hinnang" (the screen's one primary button): a tap first checks what the screen shows — the student has sent her work, every
 * point has a verdict, every "Paranda" has a note — and says what is missing; then one confirmation with the counts; its "Saada" saves the
 * notes, stores every tap, and sends (sendAssessmentAction). After an approval the button sends the changed notes again ("Saada uuesti").
 * R3: coming back to the window reads the server again (engine.recheck), so the student's new round reaches a screen left open.
 */
export function AssessmentSend({
  state,
  assessment,
  taps,
  onSent,
}: {
  state: EditorState;
  assessment: AssessmentView;
  taps: VerdictTaps;
  /** A send went through: the status it made (null: only the notes went, or it was sent already) and the verdicts it sent. */
  onSent(status: PracticalStatus | null, verdicts: (Verdict | null)[]): void;
}) {
  const s = adminEt.assessment.screen;
  const t = adminEt.protocols;
  const uid = useId();
  const { engine, entry, locked, onUnlock } = state;
  const id = entry.registrationId;
  const notesOnly = entry.titles.length === 0;
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const question = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (asking) question.current?.focus();
  }, [asking]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (notesOnly) return;
    // R3: the student's new round (its photos, the "Paranda" verdicts cleared) reaches a screen left open with its next read; coming back to the
    // window asks for one (the screen's own reads come when it is shown from the browser's cache, or after five minutes hidden)
    const back = () => engine.recheck(id);
    window.addEventListener("focus", back);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("focus", back);
  }, [engine, id, notesOnly]);
  const busy = entry.sending;
  const shown = entry.titles.map((_, i) => taps.shown(i));
  const ok = shown.filter((v) => v === "ok").length;
  const fix = shown.filter((v) => v === "fix").length;

  /** Why "Saada hinnang" cannot go, from what the screen shows (the server checks it all again): null when it can. */
  function why(): string | null {
    if (assessment.status === "open") return s.errors.notSubmitted;
    if (assessment.locked) return null; // approved: only the notes go again
    const missing = shown.flatMap((v, i) => (v === null ? [i] : []));
    if (missing.length > 0) return fill(s.errors.verdicts, { points: list(missing) });
    const bare = shown.flatMap((v, i) => (v === "fix" && !(entry.content.notes[i] ?? "").trim() ? [i] : []));
    if (bare.length > 0) return fill(s.errors.comments, { points: list(bare) });
    return null;
  }

  function ask() {
    if (busy) return;
    setDone(null);
    if (notesOnly) {
      void send(); // as a contact course's "Saada": no confirmation
      return;
    }
    const line = why();
    engine.setSendError(id, line);
    if (!line) setAsking(true);
  }

  /** Closes the confirmation; its focused button goes with it, so the focus returns to "Saada hinnang" (unless Maria has gone elsewhere). */
  function close() {
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (!active || active === document.body || box.current?.contains(active)) opener.current?.focus();
    setAsking(false);
  }

  /** The line after a send that went through. */
  function doneLine(result: Extract<Outcome, { kind: "sent" | "already" }>, sent: readonly (Verdict | null)[]): string {
    if (result.kind === "already") return s.already;
    if (notesOnly || assessment.locked) return s.sentNotes;
    if (result.status === "fix") return fill(s.sentFix, { points: list(sent.flatMap((v, i) => (v === "fix" ? [i] : []))) });
    return result.completed ? s.sentCompleted : s.sentPassed;
  }

  async function send() {
    let now = engine.get(id);
    if (!now || now.sending) return;
    engine.setSendError(id, null);
    engine.setSending(id, true);
    try {
      // a screen shown from an older page (the browser's Back) waits for the server's text first, and a text other than the one shown is not sent
      // unseen (as StudentSend)
      if (engine.checking(id)) {
        const before: Content = { notes: [...now.content.notes], generalNote: now.content.generalNote };
        const read = await engine.whenFresh([id]);
        now = engine.get(id)!;
        if (!read) {
          engine.setSendError(id, t.sendErrors.unsaved);
          return;
        }
        if (!sameContent(now.content, before)) {
          engine.setSendError(id, t.sendErrors.refreshed);
          return;
        }
      }
      if (now.status.kind === "signedOut" || now.conflict) {
        engine.setSendError(id, unsavedMessage(now, t));
        return;
      }
      if (notesOnly && !written(now)) {
        engine.setSendError(id, t.sendErrors.empty);
        return;
      }
      // the notes first: the version the server confirmed is the one sent, whatever is typed meanwhile (read-only)
      const saved = await engine.save(id);
      const after = engine.get(id)!;
      if (!saved || after.conflict || engine.unconfirmed(id)) {
        engine.setSendError(id, unsavedMessage(after, t));
        return;
      }
      // then every tap: the verdicts sent are the ones on the screen (R2)
      if (!notesOnly && after.protocolId !== null) {
        const stored = await taps.flush(after.protocolId);
        if (stored === "refused") {
          engine.recheck(id);
          engine.setSendError(id, s.errors.verdictRefused);
          return;
        }
        if (stored === "unsaved") {
          engine.setSendError(id, s.errors.unsavedVerdicts);
          return;
        }
      }
      const sent = after.titles.map((_, i) => taps.shown(i));
      const result = await bounded(sendAssessmentAction({ accessId: id, version: after.version, protocolId: after.protocolId })).catch((): Outcome => ({ kind: "failed" }));
      if (result === "timeout") {
        engine.setSendError(id, t.sendErrors.timeout);
        engine.recheck(id); // (it may have gone through: the read shows the sent marks; a send again is "already")
        return;
      }
      if (result.kind === "sent" || result.kind === "already") {
        engine.markSent(id, result.version, result.sentAt);
        onUnlock(false);
        onSent(result.kind === "sent" && !notesOnly ? result.status : null, sent);
        setDone(doneLine(result, sent));
        return;
      }
      let fresh = false;
      if (result.kind === "stale" || result.kind === "verdicts" || result.kind === "notSubmitted") {
        // the server holds newer work than this screen shows (another device saved, the student sent again): it is read and shown first
        engine.recheck(id);
        fresh = await engine.whenFresh([id]);
      }
      engine.setSendError(id, result.kind === "stale" && fresh ? t.sendErrors.refreshed : assessMessage(result, s, t));
    } finally {
      engine.setSending(id, false);
      close();
    }
  }

  const waiting = !notesOnly && assessment.status === "open";
  const label = notesOnly ? (statusOf(entry) === "changed" ? t.resend : t.send) : assessment.locked ? t.resend : s.send;
  return (
    <div className={screen.sendBar} data-send-bar="">
      {locked ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`}
          onClick={() => {
            engine.setSendError(id, null);
            setDone(null);
            onUnlock(true);
          }}
          data-edit=""
        >
          {t.edit}
        </button>
      ) : notesOnly && statusOf(entry) === "sent" ? (
        <p className={ui.hint} data-editing="">
          {t.editing}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <button
          ref={opener}
          type="button"
          className={ui.btn}
          aria-disabled={busy || waiting || undefined}
          aria-expanded={notesOnly ? undefined : asking}
          onClick={ask}
          data-assess-send=""
        >
          {busy ? t.sending : label}
        </button>
      )}
      {waiting && (
        <p className={ui.hint} data-assess-waiting="">
          {s.waiting}
        </p>
      )}
      {!notesOnly && assessment.locked && (
        <p className={ui.hint} data-assess-locked="">
          {s.lockedPassed}
        </p>
      )}
      {asking && (
        <div ref={box} className={`${ui.notice} ${screen.confirm}`} role="group" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-ask`} data-assess-confirm-box="">
          <p id={`${uid}-ask`} ref={question} tabIndex={-1}>
            <strong>{s.confirmTitle}</strong>
          </p>
          {assessment.locked ? <p>{s.confirmNotes}</p> : <p>{fill(s.confirmCounts, { ok, fix })}</p>}
          {!assessment.locked && fix === 0 && <p>{s.confirmPassed}</p>}
          <div className={screen.answers}>
            <button type="button" className={ui.btn} aria-disabled={busy || undefined} onClick={() => {
                if (!busy) void send();
              }}
              data-assess-confirm=""
            >
              {busy ? t.sending : s.confirmYes}
            </button>
            <button type="button" className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`} aria-disabled={busy || undefined} onClick={() => {
                if (!busy) close();
              }}
              data-assess-confirm-no=""
            >
              {s.confirmNo}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {entry.sendError && (
        <p role="alert" className={ui.error} data-assess-error="">
          {entry.sendError}
        </p>
      )}
      <div role="status">
        {done && (
          <p className={ui.success} data-assess-sent="">
            {done}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
