  3. Create `src/components/admin/AssessmentScreen.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { Verdict } from "@/db/schema";
import type { PracticalStatus } from "@/domain/completion";
import type { AssessmentView } from "@/domain/protocols";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { AssessmentSend } from "./AssessmentSend";
import { AssessmentStage } from "./AssessmentStage";
import { PhotoViewer, type Photo } from "./PhotoViewer";
import { ProtocolScreen, type EditorState, type ScreenView } from "./ProtocolScreen";
import { getScreen, readStudents, type Entry, type ReadScreen } from "./protocol-autosave";
import { postVerdict, VerdictTaps, type PostVerdict } from "./verdict-taps";
import ui from "./ui.module.css";
import styles from "./Assessment.module.css";

const VERDICT = (v: unknown): boolean => v === null || v === "ok" || v === "fix";
const verdictList = (v: unknown): boolean => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(VERDICT);
const photoOf = (p: unknown): boolean => typeof p === "object" && p !== null && ["id", "round", "width", "height"].every((k) => typeof (p as Record<string, unknown>)[k] === "number");

/** A read's practical work (server/protocols.ts handleRead: domain/protocols.ts AssessmentView), checked field by field; null for anything else. */
export function readAssessment(value: unknown): AssessmentView | null {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return null;
  const a = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const good =
    typeof a.accessId === "number" &&
    typeof a.clientId === "number" &&
    typeof a.email === "string" &&
    (a.status === "open" || a.status === "review" || a.status === "fix" || a.status === "passed") &&
    typeof a.round === "number" &&
    (a.submittedAt === null || typeof a.submittedAt === "string") &&
    verdictList(a.verdicts) &&
    (a.sentVerdicts === null || verdictList(a.sentVerdicts)) &&
    Array.isArray(a.photos) &&
    a.photos.every((point) => Array.isArray(point) && point.every(photoOf)) &&
    typeof a.locked === "boolean" &&
    typeof a.expiresAt === "string";
  return good ? (value as AssessmentView) : null;
}

const TONE: Record<PracticalStatus, string> = { open: "", review: ui.warn, fix: ui.bad, passed: ui.ok };

/**
 * Maria's assessment of one e-course access's practical work (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3): the protocol screen (ProtocolScreen,
 * single, its autosave's owner the access) with, under each point's heading, its photos and verdict buttons (AssessmentStage), "Saada
 * hinnang" instead of the course day's sends (AssessmentSend), the status above, and the full-screen viewer (PhotoViewer). The verdicts are
 * this screen's (verdict-taps.ts: each tap stored at once, R2), not the autosave's. The screen's reads (`read`, the same GET as the notes')
 * bring the practical work too: the photos and the verdicts of a new round (R3) are taken from each. An e-course without points is the plain
 * notes protocol with its "Saada". `read` and `post` are replaceable for the tests.
 */
export function AssessmentScreen({ view, read = getScreen, post = postVerdict }: { view: ScreenView; read?: ReadScreen; post?: PostVerdict }) {
  const s = adminEt.assessment.screen;
  const first = view.students[0];
  const [assessment, setAssessment] = useState<AssessmentView | null>(first?.assessment ?? null);
  const [taps] = useState(() => new VerdictTaps(first?.registrationId ?? 0, first?.assessment?.verdicts ?? [], post));
  useSyncExternalStore(taps.subscribe, taps.snapshot, taps.snapshot);
  const [viewer, setViewer] = useState<{ photos: readonly Photo[]; index: number; label: string; from: HTMLElement } | null>(null);
  // the screen's own read, its answer's practical work taken on the way (one stable function: the screen restarts its reading for a new one)
  const [reader] = useState<ReadScreen>(() => async (source) => {
    const answer = await read(source);
    const next = answer && answer.status === 200 ? readAssessment(readStudents(answer.body)?.[0]?.assessment) : null;
    if (next) {
      taps.take(next.verdicts);
      setAssessment(next);
    }
    return answer;
  });

  if (!assessment) return <ProtocolScreen view={view} read={reader} />; // (an access's page always hands it over)
  const notesOnly = (first?.titles.length ?? 0) === 0;

  const onSent = (status: PracticalStatus | null, verdicts: (Verdict | null)[]) => {
    if (status === null) return;
    taps.take(verdicts);
    setAssessment((a) => (a ? { ...a, status, locked: status === "passed", verdicts, sentVerdicts: verdicts } : a));
  };

  const stageExtra = (i: number, state: EditorState) => {
    const id = state.entry.registrationId;
    const protocolId = state.entry.protocolId;
    return (
      <AssessmentStage
        index={i}
        photos={assessment.photos[i] ?? []}
        verdict={taps.shown(i)}
        unsaved={taps.unsaved(i)}
        disabled={assessment.status === "open" || assessment.locked || state.frozen || protocolId === null}
        onVerdict={(verdict) => {
          if (protocolId === null) return;
          state.engine.setSendError(id, null);
          void taps.tap(protocolId, i, verdict).then((result) => {
            if (result !== "refused") return;
            // the work changed meanwhile (sent again by the student, approved on another device): read again and shown
            state.engine.recheck(id);
            state.engine.setSendError(id, s.errors.verdictRefused);
          });
        }}
        onOpen={(photos, index, from) => setViewer({ photos, index, from, label: fill(s.viewer, { point: i + 1, title: state.entry.titles[i] ?? "" }) })}
      />
    );
  };
  const sendBar = (_entry: Entry, state: EditorState) => <AssessmentSend state={state} assessment={assessment} taps={taps} onSent={onSent} />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.screen} data-assessment-screen="">
      {!notesOnly && (
        <p className={styles.statusLine}>
          <span className={`${ui.tag} ${TONE[assessment.status]}`} data-assess-status={assessment.status}>
            {s.status[assessment.status]}
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
      <ProtocolScreen view={view} read={reader} stageExtra={notesOnly ? undefined : stageExtra} sendBar={sendBar} opened={!notesOnly && assessment.status === "review"} />
      {viewer && (
        <PhotoViewer
          photos={viewer.photos}
          index={viewer.index}
          label={viewer.label}
          returnTo={viewer.from}
          onIndex={(index) => setViewer((v) => (v ? { ...v, index } : v))}
          onClose={() => setViewer(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

  Then `src/app/admin/(panel)/protokollid/page.tsx` becomes (the course day's part as it was):

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AssessmentScreen } from "@/components/admin/AssessmentScreen";
import { ProtocolScreen, type ScreenView } from "@/components/admin/ProtocolScreen";
import styles from "@/components/admin/ProtocolScreen.module.css";
import { adminTitle, type Section } from "@/components/admin/sections";
import { Shell } from "@/components/admin/Shell";
import ui from "@/components/admin/ui.module.css";
import { getDb } from "@/db/client";
import { protocolScreen, screenStudents, type ScreenData } from "@/db/queries/protocols";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { pick } from "@/i18n/field";
import { fill, formatDate, formatTime, formatWeekday } from "@/i18n/format";
import { parseRowId } from "@/lib/row-id";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/server/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
/**
 * "Lukusta ja saada kõik" is a server action of this page (sendProtocolsAction), so its mails run under this page's limit: they go out after the
 * answer as ONE task, one after another about 0.8 s apart (server/protocols.ts mailProtocols), up to 100 of them (about 80 s). 300 s is the longest
 * a function may run on Vercel Hobby; a task cut short would lose the mails of the students not reached, and a mail cannot be sent again.
 * (tests/unit/protocol-page.test.ts pins it.)
 */
export const maxDuration = 300;
export const metadata: Metadata = { title: adminTitle(adminEt.protocols.title) };

type Props = { searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>> };

const one = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (typeof v === "string" ? v : undefined);

/** The screen's data for the browser: every date as text; `source` is where it asks for it again (GET /api/admin/protokoll); an access's screen says whose it is. */
function viewOf(screen: ScreenData, source: ScreenView["source"]): ScreenView {
  return { single: screen.kind !== "session", source, students: screenStudents(screen), ...(screen.kind === "access" ? { owner: "access" as const } : {}) };
}

/**
 * Protokollid (phase protocols, spec §4): the course day's screen. ?sessioon=<id>: every listed registration of one session (from Kalender
 * and the overview's "Täna"); ?registreering=<id>: one registration (from Registreerimised: an individual course, or one group student). The
 * header names the course, the day and the place, with the way back; the screen is ProtocolScreen (its autosave runs in the browser).
 * ?ligipaas=<id> (phase e-course completion, spec §5.3): one e-course access — Maria's assessment of the student's practical work (from
 * Hindamine, the student's drawer and Maria's notice): the header names the course, the student and the round, the way back is Hindamine, an
 * ended access says Maria can still assess, and the screen is AssessmentScreen. The first of the three in the address wins. Behind requireAdmin
 * like every admin page; nothing is written by opening it (a protocol is created by its first save, or by the student's first photo).
 */
export default async function ProtocolsPage({ searchParams }: Props) {
  const email = await requireAdmin();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const sessionId = parseRowId(one(sp.sessioon) ?? "");
  const registrationId = sessionId === null ? parseRowId(one(sp.registreering) ?? "") : null;
  const accessId = sessionId === null && registrationId === null ? parseRowId(one(sp.ligipaas) ?? "") : null;
  const t = adminEt.protocols;
  const a = adminEt.assessment.screen;
  const db = getDb();
  const screen =
    sessionId !== null
      ? await protocolScreen(db, { sessionId })
      : registrationId !== null
        ? await protocolScreen(db, { registrationId })
        : accessId !== null
          ? await protocolScreen(db, { accessId })
          : null;
  const active: Section = accessId !== null ? "assessment" : registrationId !== null ? "registrations" : "calendar";

  if (!screen) {
    return (
      <Shell email={email} active={active}>
        <div className={ui.page}>
          <div className={ui.heading}>
            <div>
              <p className={ui.eyebrow}>{accessId !== null ? adminEt.nav.assessment : t.eyebrow}</p>
              <h1 className={ui.h1}>{t.title}</h1>
            </div>
          </div>
          <section className={ui.card}>
            <p className={ui.empty}>{accessId !== null ? a.notFound : t.notFound}</p>
            <Link className={ui.link} href={accessId !== null ? "/admin/hindamine" : "/admin/kalender"}>
              {accessId !== null ? a.back : t.toCalendar}
            </Link>
          </section>
        </div>
      </Shell>
    );
  }

  if (screen.kind === "access" && screen.assessment && accessId !== null) {
    const student = screen.students[0];
    const work = screen.assessment;
    const lead = student.protocol.stages.length === 0 ? a.notesOnly : work.round === 0 ? a.notSubmitted : fill(a.round, { n: work.round });
    const now = new Date();
    return (
      <Shell email={email} active={active}>
        <div className={ui.page}>
          <div className={ui.heading}>
            <div className={styles.head}>
              <p className={ui.eyebrow}>{adminEt.nav.assessment}</p>
              <h1 className={ui.h1} data-protocol-course="">
                {`${pick(screen.course.title, "et")} · ${student.name}`}
              </h1>
              <p className={ui.lead} data-assess-round="">
                {lead}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Link className={ui.link} href="/admin/hindamine">
              {a.back}
            </Link>
          </div>
          {work.expiresAt <= now && (
            <p className={ui.notice} data-access-expired="">
              {fill(a.expired, { date: formatDate(work.expiresAt, "et") })}
            </p>
          )}
          <AssessmentScreen view={viewOf(screen, { ligipaas: accessId })} />
        </div>
      </Shell>
    );
  }

  const s = screen.session;
  const back = screen.kind === "session" && s ? { href: `/admin/kalender?id=${s.id}`, label: t.toCalendar } : { href: `/admin/registreerimised?id=${registrationId}`, label: t.toRegistration };
  const when = s ? `${formatWeekday(s.startsAt, "et")}, ${formatDate(s.startsAt, "et")} · ${formatTime(s.startsAt, "et")}` : t.individual;
  const place = s ? [s.city, s.venue].filter(Boolean).join(", ") : "";

  return (
    <Shell email={email} active={active}>
      <div className={ui.page}>
        <div className={ui.heading}>
          <div className={styles.head}>
            <p className={ui.eyebrow}>{t.eyebrow}</p>
            <h1 className={ui.h1} data-protocol-course="">
              {pick(screen.course.title, "et")}
            </h1>
            <p className={ui.lead} data-protocol-when="">
              {place ? `${when} · ${place}` : when}
            </p>
            {s?.cancelled && <span className={`${ui.tag} ${ui.bad}`}>{t.sessionCancelled}</span>}
          </div>
          <Link className={ui.link} href={back.href}>
            {back.label}
          </Link>
        </div>
        {screen.hidden > 0 && (
          <p className={`${ui.muted} ${ui.small}`} data-hidden-cancelled="">
            {fill(t.hidden, { n: screen.hidden })}
          </p>
        )}
        {screen.students.length === 0 ? (
          <section className={ui.card}>
            <p className={ui.empty}>{screen.kind === "registration" ? t.cancelledOne : t.empty}</p>
          </section>
        ) : (
          <ProtocolScreen view={viewOf(screen, sessionId !== null ? { sessioon: sessionId } : { registreering: registrationId! })} />
        )}
      </div>
    </Shell>
  );
}
```

---

### Task 12: "Hindamine" — the queue, the test review, "Ava test uuesti", the menu badge and the overview card

Spec §5.2 (the page, its three groups, the badge, the card), §5.4 (the test review and the attempts list), §8 (revoked and expired accesses) and §9 (DB). Rulings: **R4** (the "Ootab hindamist" card goes on the overview `/admin`, "Ülevaade", not on `/admin/avaleht`, the public home-page editor). Review Focus 3 (the review shows the attempt's own copy) and 4 (revoked items leave the list, expired ones stay).

**What waits, exactly** (one SQL rule each, shared by the list and the badge's count):
- **Praktilised tööd:** an access protocol with `round > 0 and (sent_round is null or sent_round < round)` (spec §3.4 "review"), oldest `submitted_at` first.
- **Testi vastused:** an attempt with `status = 'review'`, oldest `submitted_at` first.
- **Katsed otsas:** an access whose every attempt failed and whose attempts number at least `tries + extra_tries` (`domain/completion.ts testState` "used"; `tries` is 3 when the course has no `course_tests` row), oldest last attempt first; its best score is the best attempt's `percentOf` (rounded down, 100 when the attempt had no choice questions).
- Everywhere: an access an admin ended (`revoked_at`) is left out (her pages answer 404, spec §8), and a completed one (`completed_at`) has nothing left to assess. An expired one stays (Maria can still assess it).
- `attemptForReview` and `attemptsOf` also answer null for a revoked access: the review page then says "Seda katset ei leitud." (the spec leaves this open; it keeps "her items leave Hindamine" true for the page the notice links to as well).

**The review is a plain form** (spec §5.4 "Draft"): the open answers' verdicts and comments are kept in `localStorage` under `mslab-review:<attemptId>` (`{ marks, at }`) on every change and dropped once the server accepted the review. The draft is read after hydration (an effect: the server's render cannot see the browser's storage). The form checks what it can before it sends (every open answer marked, a comment for "Paranda", at most `TEST_LIMITS.comment` characters, nothing cut), and the server checks it again (`checkReview`).

- [ ] **Step 1: The test fixtures** — create `tests/db/assessment-fixtures.ts`:

```ts
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { clients, courseAccess, courses, courseTests, protocols, testAttempts, type AttemptStatus, type OpenReview, type TestAnswers, type TestQuestion } from "@/db/schema";

// The Hindamine tests' common parts (e-course completion, Task 12): an e-course with Maria's test and points, students with access to it, their
// attempts and their practical work, written straight to the (PGlite) database. The addresses are @example.test: nothing here is mailed.

/** The test: a single-answer and a multiple-answer choice question, then an open one (ids as domain/completion.ts newItemId makes them). */
export const QUESTIONS: TestQuestion[] = [
  { id: "qvalik01", kind: "choice", text: "Mitu korda pesta pintslit?", options: [{ id: "o1oige01", text: "Pärast igat kasutust", correct: true }, { id: "o1vale01", text: "Kord nädalas", correct: false }] },
  {
    id: "qvalik02",
    kind: "choice",
    text: "Mis kuulub ettevalmistusse?",
    options: [
      { id: "o2oige01", text: "Naha puhastus", correct: true },
      { id: "o2oige02", text: "Kuju mõõtmine", correct: true },
      { id: "o2vale01", text: "Värvi segamine silma järgi", correct: false },
    ],
  },
  { id: "qavatud1", kind: "open", text: "Kirjelda oma tööde järjekorda." },
];
/** Her answers: the first right, the second wrong (one correct option missed, a wrong one picked), the open one written: 1 of 2, 50 %. */
export const ANSWERS: TestAnswers = { qvalik01: ["o1oige01"], qvalik02: ["o2oige01", "o2vale01"], qavatud1: "Puhastan pintsli." };
export const POINTS = ["Ettevalmistus", "Värvimine"];
export const COURSE_TITLE = { et: "Kulmumeistri e-koolitus", ru: "Онлайн-курс бровиста" };
/** An access that runs until April 2027. */
export const LATER = new Date("2027-04-20T20:59:59.999Z");
/** `hour` o'clock (UTC) on 19.10.2026. */
export const at = (hour: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 19, hour));

const base = { level: "basic" as const, summary: { et: "" }, body: { et: "" } };

/** The e-course "Kulmumeistri e-koolitus" with POINTS and, unless `test` is null, its test (QUESTIONS, pass mark 80, `tries` 2). */
export async function ecourse(db: Db, opts: { slug?: string; title?: { et: string; ru?: string }; test?: { tries: number } | null } = {}): Promise<{ id: number }> {
  const [course] = await db
    .insert(courses)
    .values({ ...base, slug: opts.slug ?? "e-kulm", type: "e_learning", title: opts.title ?? COURSE_TITLE, protocolStages: POINTS })
    .returning();
  if (opts.test !== null) await db.insert(courseTests).values({ courseId: course.id, questions: QUESTIONS, passPercent: 80, tries: opts.test?.tries ?? 2 });
  return course;
}

export type Student = { client: { id: number; email: string }; access: { id: number } };

/** A student (`name`, her address made of it) with access to `courseId` until LATER; `over` replaces fields of the access. */
export async function student(db: Db, courseId: number, name: string, over: Partial<typeof courseAccess.$inferInsert> = {}): Promise<Student> {
  const [client] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: `${name.toLowerCase()}@example.test`, name }).returning();
  const [access] = await db.insert(courseAccess).values({ clientId: client.id, courseId, grantedBy: "maria@example.test", expiresAt: LATER, ...over }).returning();
  return { client, access };
}

/** One of her attempts at `courseId`'s test, with QUESTIONS as its copy and ANSWERS (1 of 2 right) unless `over` says otherwise. */
export async function attempt(
  db: Db,
  s: Student,
  courseId: number,
  number: number,
  status: AttemptStatus,
  submittedAt: Date,
  over: { correct?: number; total?: number; questions?: TestQuestion[]; answers?: TestAnswers; review?: OpenReview | null } = {},
) {
  const [row] = await db
    .insert(testAttempts)
    .values({
      clientId: s.client.id,
      courseId,
      number,
      questions: over.questions ?? QUESTIONS,
      answers: over.answers ?? ANSWERS,
      correct: over.correct ?? 1,
      total: over.total ?? 2,
      status,
      review: over.review ?? null,
      submittedAt,
    })
    .returning();
  return row;
}

/** Her practical work's protocol: POINTS without notes, `round` submissions so far, the last at `submittedAt`, `sentRound` assessed. */
export async function practical(db: Db, s: Student, round: number, sentRound: number | null, submittedAt: Date | null) {
  const [row] = await db
    .insert(protocols)
    .values({ accessId: s.access.id, stages: POINTS.map((title) => ({ title, note: "" })), verdicts: POINTS.map(() => null), round, sentRound, submittedAt })
    .returning();
  return row;
}
```

```ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import type { Db } from "@/db/client";
import { assessmentCount, assessmentQueue, attemptForReview, attemptsOf } from "@/db/queries/assessment";
import { clients, courseAccess, courseTests, protocols, registrations } from "@/db/schema";
import { ANSWERS, at, attempt, COURSE_TITLE, ecourse, LATER, practical, QUESTIONS, student } from "./assessment-fixtures";
import { makeTestDb } from "./helpers";

// "Hindamine" (e-course completion, spec §5.2, §8) on a real (PGlite) database: what waits for Maria — the practical work sent and not
// assessed, the open answers waiting for her review, the students out of tries — oldest first, and the count the menu badge shows. An access
// an admin ended leaves the list, one that ran out stays (she can still assess it), a completed one has nothing left (Review Focus 4). And
// one attempt as her review reads it: the attempt's own copy of the questions, whatever the course's test says now.

let db: Db;
let course: { id: number };

beforeEach(async () => {
  db = await makeTestDb();
  course = await ecourse(db);
});

describe("assessmentQueue", () => {
  test("three groups, oldest first, each row with what Hindamine shows; the badge's count is their sum", async () => {
    const anu = await student(db, course.id, "Anu");
    await practical(db, anu, 1, null, at(8));
    const berit = await student(db, course.id, "Berit");
    await practical(db, berit, 2, 1, at(6)); // her second round, after a "Paranda"
    const carmen = await student(db, course.id, "Carmen");
    await practical(db, carmen, 1, 1, at(5)); // assessed: nothing waits
    const dora = await student(db, course.id, "Dora");
    await practical(db, dora, 0, null, null); // photos of a round she has not sent
    const eve = await student(db, course.id, "Eve");
    const waiting = await attempt(db, eve, course.id, 1, "review", at(7));
    const fia = await student(db, course.id, "Fia");
    await attempt(db, fia, course.id, 1, "fix", at(4)); // hers to rewrite
    const gea = await student(db, course.id, "Gea");
    await attempt(db, gea, course.id, 1, "failed", at(2), { correct: 1, total: 2 });
    await attempt(db, gea, course.id, 2, "failed", at(3), { correct: 0, total: 2 });
    const hele = await student(db, course.id, "Hele");
    await attempt(db, hele, course.id, 1, "failed", at(1), { correct: 0 }); // one of her two tries left
    const ida = await student(db, course.id, "Ida", { extraTries: 2 });
    for (const n of [1, 2]) await attempt(db, ida, course.id, n, "failed", at(n), { correct: 0 }); // reopened: two more
    const juta = await student(db, course.id, "Juta");
    await attempt(db, juta, course.id, 1, "failed", at(1), { correct: 0 });
    await attempt(db, juta, course.id, 2, "passed", at(2), { correct: 2 });

    const q = await assessmentQueue(db);
    expect(q.practicals).toEqual([
      { accessId: berit.access.id, name: "Berit", course: COURSE_TITLE, round: 2, submittedAt: at(6) },
      { accessId: anu.access.id, name: "Anu", course: COURSE_TITLE, round: 1, submittedAt: at(8) },
    ]);
    expect(q.tests).toEqual([{ attemptId: waiting.id, accessId: eve.access.id, name: "Eve", course: COURSE_TITLE, number: 1, allowed: 2, submittedAt: at(7) }]);
    expect(q.triesUsed).toEqual([{ accessId: gea.access.id, name: "Gea", course: COURSE_TITLE, best: 50, attempts: 2 }]);
    expect(await assessmentCount(db)).toBe(4);
  });

  test("Review Focus 4: an access an admin ended leaves Hindamine; one that ran out stays (Maria can still assess it); a completed one is never listed", async () => {
    const anu = await student(db, course.id, "Anu");
    await practical(db, anu, 1, null, at(8));
    const eve = await student(db, course.id, "Eve", { expiresAt: new Date("2026-10-01T20:59:59.999Z") });
    await attempt(db, eve, course.id, 1, "review", at(7));
    const gea = await student(db, course.id, "Gea");
    for (const n of [1, 2]) await attempt(db, gea, course.id, n, "failed", at(n), { correct: 0 });
    expect(await assessmentCount(db)).toBe(3);

    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: at(9) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, anu.access.id));
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ completedAt: at(9) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, gea.access.id));
    const q = await assessmentQueue(db);
    expect(q.practicals).toEqual([]);
    expect(q.tests.map((t) => t.accessId)).toEqual([eve.access.id]);
    expect(q.triesUsed).toEqual([]);
    expect(await assessmentCount(db)).toBe(1);
  });

  test("the name: her own, else her latest registration's, else her address", async () => {
    const [liis] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: "liis@example.test" }).returning();
    await db.insert(registrations).values({ courseId: course.id, kind: "individual", name: "Liis Tamm", email: "liis@example.test", paymentChoice: "full", clientId: liis.id });
    const [mari] = await db.insert(clients).values({ email: "mari@example.test" }).returning();
    for (const [i, c] of [liis, mari].entries()) {
      const [a] = await db.insert(courseAccess).values({ clientId: c.id, courseId: course.id, grantedBy: "e2e", expiresAt: LATER }).returning();
      await db.insert(protocols).values({ accessId: a.id, stages: [], round: 1, submittedAt: at(i + 1) });
    }
    expect((await assessmentQueue(db)).practicals.map((p) => p.name)).toEqual(["Liis Tamm", "mari@example.test"]);
  });

  test("the tries allowed: the course's (3 when it has no test row) and her extra tries; the best score is rounded down", async () => {
    const other = await ecourse(db, { slug: "e-ripsmed", title: { et: "Ripsmete e-koolitus" }, test: null });
    const kati = await student(db, other.id, "Kati");
    for (const n of [1, 2]) await attempt(db, kati, other.id, n, "failed", at(n), { correct: 0 });
    expect((await assessmentQueue(db)).triesUsed).toEqual([]);
    await attempt(db, kati, other.id, 3, "failed", at(3), { correct: 2, total: 3 }); // 66.6… % → 66
    expect((await assessmentQueue(db)).triesUsed).toEqual([{ accessId: kati.access.id, name: "Kati", course: { et: "Ripsmete e-koolitus" }, best: 66, attempts: 3 }]);
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ extraTries: 3 }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, kati.access.id));
    expect((await assessmentQueue(db)).triesUsed).toEqual([]);
    expect(await assessmentCount(db)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe("one attempt for Maria's review", () => {
  test("its own copy of the questions with the key, her answers, the score, the tries allowed and the course's pass mark (Review Focus 3)", async () => {
    const eve = await student(db, course.id, "Eve", { extraTries: 2 });
    const a = await attempt(db, eve, course.id, 1, "review", at(7));
    // Maria changes the test afterwards: the attempt keeps the questions it answered
    await db.update(courseTests).set({ questions: [{ id: "uus00001", kind: "open", text: "Uus küsimus" }], passPercent: 90 }).where(eq(courseTests.courseId, course.id));
    expect(await attemptForReview(db, a.id)).toEqual({
      id: a.id,
      accessId: eve.access.id,
      name: "Eve",
      course: COURSE_TITLE,
      number: 1,
      allowed: 4,
      status: "review",
      percent: 50,
      passPercent: 90,
      questions: QUESTIONS,
      answers: ANSWERS,
      review: null,
      submittedAt: at(7),
    });
    expect(await attemptForReview(db, 999_999)).toBeNull();
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: at(9) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, eve.access.id));
    expect(await attemptForReview(db, a.id)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("every attempt of an access, newest first; none yet is an empty list; an access an admin ended, or none, is null", async () => {
    const gea = await student(db, course.id, "Gea");
    const first = await attempt(db, gea, course.id, 1, "failed", at(2), { correct: 0 });
    const second = await attempt(db, gea, course.id, 2, "fix", at(3), { correct: 2, review: { qavatud1: { verdict: "fix", comment: "Lisa samm." } } });
    const list = (await attemptsOf(db, gea.access.id))!;
    expect([list.name, list.course]).toEqual(["Gea", COURSE_TITLE]);
    expect(list.attempts.map((x) => [x.id, x.number, x.status, x.percent, x.allowed])).toEqual([

      [first.id, 1, "failed", 0, 2],
    ]);
    expect(list.attempts[0].review).toEqual({ qavatud1: { verdict: "fix", comment: "Lisa samm." } });
    const anu = await student(db, course.id, "Anu");
    expect(await attemptsOf(db, anu.access.id)).toEqual({ name: "Anu", course: COURSE_TITLE, attempts: [] });
    expect(await attemptsOf(db, 999_999)).toBeNull();
    await db.update(courseAccess).set({ revokedAt: at(9) }).where(eq(courseAccess.id, gea.access.id));
    expect(await attemptsOf(db, gea.access.id)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The queries** — create `src/db/queries/assessment.ts`:

```ts
import { and, asc, count, desc, eq, gt, isNotNull, isNull, lt, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "../client";
import { clients, courseAccess, courses, courseTests, protocols, testAttempts, type AttemptStatus, type OpenReview, type TestAnswers, type TestAttempt, type TestQuestion } from "../schema";
import { percentOf, readQuestions, TEST_DEFAULTS, triesAllowed } from "@/domain/completion";
import type { I18n } from "@/i18n/field";

// "Hindamine" (e-course completion, spec §5.2, §5.4): what waits for Maria — the practical work sent and not yet assessed, the open answers
// waiting for her review, the students out of tries — and an attempt as her review shows it. Callers have checked the admin session; nothing
// here does authorization. An access an admin ended (revoked) is left out everywhere: her pages answer 404 and her items leave the list (spec
// §8); a completed one has nothing left to assess. One that ran out stays: Maria can still assess it (spec §8).

/**
 * The student as the admin sees her (server/admin-clients.ts NAME): her own name, else her latest registration's, else her address. Written
 * with the table's name: every query below joins `clients` unaliased, and the subquery's own table is `r`.
 */
const NAME = sql<string>`coalesce(nullif(clients.name, ''), (select r.name from registrations r where r.client_id = clients.id order by r.created_at desc, r.id desc limit 1), clients.email)`;

/** Not ended by an admin and not completed. */
const LIVE = and(isNull(courseAccess.revokedAt), isNull(courseAccess.completedAt));
/** spec §3.4 "review": a submission (round > 0) the last send has not assessed (a submitted round always has its time). */
const PRACTICAL_WAITING = and(gt(protocols.round, 0), or(isNull(protocols.sentRound), lt(protocols.sentRound, protocols.round)), isNotNull(protocols.submittedAt));
/** An attempt's access: the same student and course (course_access_client_course: one row per pair). */
const ATTEMPT_ACCESS = and(eq(courseAccess.clientId, testAttempts.clientId), eq(courseAccess.courseId, testAttempts.courseId));
/** domain/completion.ts testState "used": every attempt failed, and as many as the tries allowed (the course's, 3 without a test row, + hers). */
const USED = sql`bool_and(${testAttempts.status} = 'failed') and count(${testAttempts.id}) >= coalesce(${courseTests.tries}, ${TEST_DEFAULTS.tries}) + ${courseAccess.extraTries}`;

export type WaitingPractical = { accessId: number; name: string; course: I18n; round: number; submittedAt: Date };
export type WaitingTest = { attemptId: number; accessId: number; name: string; course: I18n; number: number; allowed: number; submittedAt: Date };
export type TriesUsed = { accessId: number; name: string; course: I18n; best: number /* percent */; attempts: number };
export type AssessmentQueue = { practicals: WaitingPractical[]; tests: WaitingTest[]; triesUsed: TriesUsed[] };

async function waitingPracticals(db: Db): Promise<WaitingPractical[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ accessId: courseAccess.id, name: NAME, course: courses.title, round: protocols.round, submittedAt: protocols.submittedAt })
    .from(protocols)
    .innerJoin(courseAccess, eq(protocols.accessId, courseAccess.id))
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(courseAccess.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .where(and(PRACTICAL_WAITING, LIVE))
    .orderBy(asc(protocols.submittedAt), asc(protocols.id));
  return rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, submittedAt: r.submittedAt! })); // (PRACTICAL_WAITING: never null here)
}

async function waitingTests(db: Db): Promise<WaitingTest[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      attemptId: testAttempts.id,
      accessId: courseAccess.id,
      name: NAME,
      course: courses.title,
      number: testAttempts.number,
      tries: courseTests.tries,
      extraTries: courseAccess.extraTries,
      submittedAt: testAttempts.submittedAt,
    })
    .from(testAttempts)
    .innerJoin(courseAccess, ATTEMPT_ACCESS)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(testAttempts.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(testAttempts.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(courseTests, eq(courseTests.courseId, testAttempts.courseId))
    .where(and(eq(testAttempts.status, "review"), LIVE))
    .orderBy(asc(testAttempts.submittedAt), asc(testAttempts.id));
  return rows.map(({ tries, extraTries, ...r }) => ({ ...r, allowed: triesAllowed(tries ?? TEST_DEFAULTS.tries, extraTries) }));
}

/** The accesses out of tries, oldest last attempt first; `best` as percentOf rounds it (100 for an attempt without choice questions). */
async function triesUsedRows(db: Db): Promise<TriesUsed[]> {
  return db
    .select({
      accessId: courseAccess.id,
      name: NAME,
      course: courses.title,
      best: sql<number>`max(case when ${testAttempts.total} = 0 then 100 else (${testAttempts.correct} * 100) / ${testAttempts.total} end)`.mapWith(Number),
      attempts: sql<number>`count(${testAttempts.id})`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(testAttempts, ATTEMPT_ACCESS)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(courseAccess.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(courseTests, eq(courseTests.courseId, courseAccess.courseId))
    .where(LIVE)
    // (each table's primary key: the name's, the title's and the tries' columns depend on it)
    .groupBy(courseAccess.id, clients.id, courses.id, courseTests.courseId)
    .having(USED)
    .orderBy(sql`max(${testAttempts.submittedAt})`, asc(courseAccess.id));
}

/** What waits for Maria (spec §5.2), each group oldest first. */
export async function assessmentQueue(db: Db): Promise<AssessmentQueue> {
  const [practicals, tests, triesUsed] = await Promise.all([waitingPracticals(db), waitingTests(db), triesUsedRows(db)]);
  return { practicals, tests, triesUsed };
}

/** The menu badge's and the overview's number: the three groups together (the same rules, counted). */
export async function assessmentCount(db: Db): Promise<number> {
  const [[practicals], [tests], used] = await Promise.all([
    db.select({ n: count() }).from(protocols).innerJoin(courseAccess, eq(protocols.accessId, courseAccess.id)).where(and(PRACTICAL_WAITING, LIVE)),
    db.select({ n: count() }).from(testAttempts).innerJoin(courseAccess, ATTEMPT_ACCESS).where(and(eq(testAttempts.status, "review"), LIVE)),
    triesUsedRows(db),
  ]);
  return Number(practicals.n) + Number(tests.n) + used.length;
}

/**
 * One attempt as the review shows it (spec §5.4): the attempt's own copy of the questions with the key (Maria may have changed the test since:
 * Review Focus 3), the student's answers, the score rounded down, the tries she has, and the course's pass mark now.
 */
export type ReviewAttempt = {
  id: number;
  accessId: number;
  name: string;
  course: I18n;
  number: number;
  allowed: number;
  status: AttemptStatus;
  percent: number;
  passPercent: number;
  questions: TestQuestion[];
  answers: TestAnswers;
  review: OpenReview | null;
  submittedAt: Date;
};

type ReviewRow = { attempt: TestAttempt; accessId: number; extraTries: number; name: string; course: I18n; tries: number | null; passPercent: number | null };

const reviewFields = {
  attempt: testAttempts,
  accessId: courseAccess.id,
  extraTries: courseAccess.extraTries,
  name: NAME,
  course: courses.title,
  tries: courseTests.tries,
  passPercent: courseTests.passPercent,
};

function reviewOf(r: ReviewRow): ReviewAttempt {
  const a = r.attempt;
  return {
    id: a.id,
    accessId: r.accessId,
    name: r.name,
    course: r.course,
    number: a.number,
    allowed: triesAllowed(r.tries ?? TEST_DEFAULTS.tries, r.extraTries),
    status: a.status,
    percent: percentOf(a.correct, a.total),
    passPercent: r.passPercent ?? TEST_DEFAULTS.passPercent,
    questions: readQuestions(a.questions), // (jsonb read defensively: a malformed item is dropped, never thrown)
    answers: a.answers ?? {},
    review: a.review ?? null,
    submittedAt: a.submittedAt,
  };
}

/** The attempt `attemptId` for Maria's review; null without one, or when its access was ended by an admin. */
export async function attemptForReview(db: Db, attemptId: number): Promise<ReviewAttempt | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select(reviewFields)
    .from(testAttempts)
    .innerJoin(courseAccess, ATTEMPT_ACCESS)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(testAttempts.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(testAttempts.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(courseTests, eq(courseTests.courseId, testAttempts.courseId))
    .where(and(eq(testAttempts.id, attemptId), isNull(courseAccess.revokedAt)))
    .limit(1);
  return row ? reviewOf(row) : null;
}

/** Every attempt of the access `accessId`, newest first (spec §5.4, "Testi katsed"); null without the access, or when an admin ended it. */
export async function attemptsOf(db: Db, accessId: number): Promise<{ name: string; course: I18n; attempts: ReviewAttempt[] } | null> {
  const [who] = await db
    .select({ name: NAME, course: courses.title })
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(courseAccess.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .where(and(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId), isNull(courseAccess.revokedAt)))
    .limit(1);
  if (!who) return null;
  const rows = await db
    .select(reviewFields)
    .from(courseAccess)
    .innerJoin(testAttempts, ATTEMPT_ACCESS)
    .innerJoin(clients, eq(courseAccess.clientId, clients.id))
    .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
    .leftJoin(courseTests, eq(courseTests.courseId, courseAccess.courseId))
    .where(eq(courseAccess.id, accessId))
    .orderBy(desc(testAttempts.number));
  return { name: who.name, course: who.course, attempts: rows.map(reviewOf) };
}
```

```ts
const attemptInput = z.object({ attemptId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647), review: z.unknown() });
const accessInput = z.object({ accessId: z.number().int().positive().max(2_147_483_647) });

/**
 * The test review's "Saada" (spec §5.4): Maria's verdicts and comments on the open answers of one attempt waiting for her (the checks are
 * server/test-attempts.ts reviewAttempt's); the student is mailed after the answer. The open page is refreshed: the attempt is read-only now,
 * and Hindamine's badge has one less.
 */
export const reviewAttemptAction = adminAction(async ({ email }, input: { attemptId: number; review: unknown }): Promise<ReviewResult | { kind: "failed" }> => {
  const parsed = attemptInput.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) return { kind: "notFound" };
  try {
    const result = await reviewAttempt(await deps(), email, parsed.data.attemptId, parsed.data.review);
    if (result.kind === "reviewed") refresh();
    return result;
  } catch (e) {
    logFailure(`[test] attempt ${parsed.data.attemptId}: the review failed`, e);
    return { kind: "failed" };
  }
});

type ReopenOutcome = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof reopenTest>> | { kind: "failed" };

/** "Ava test uuesti" (spec §5.2, §5.5), after its confirmation: the course's tries once more for an access whose tries are used up; she is mailed. */
export const reopenTestAction = adminAction(async ({ email }, input: { accessId: number }): Promise<ReopenOutcome> => {
  const parsed = accessInput.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) return { kind: "notFound" };
  try {
    const result = await reopenTest(await deps(), email, parsed.data.accessId);
    if (result.kind === "reopened") refresh();
    return result;
  } catch (e) {
    logFailure(`[test] access ${parsed.data.accessId}: the reopen failed`, e);
    return { kind: "failed" };
  }
});
```

  (`deps()` is the file's own, Task 10's; if Task 10 named it otherwise, use that name. A file of `"use server"` may hold a non-exported `type`.)

```ts
  await show(over);
};
const click = async (el: Element | null) => {
  expect(el, "the element to click").not.toBeNull();
  await act(async () => (el as HTMLElement).click());
  await settle();
};
const type = async (el: HTMLTextAreaElement | null, value: string) => {
  expect(el, "the box to type in").not.toBeNull();
  await act(async () => {
    Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, "value")!.set!.call(el, value);
    el!.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  await settle();
};
const answer = (id: string) => $(`[data-review-answer="${id}"]`)!;
const verdict = (id: string, v: "ok" | "fix") => $(`[data-review-answer="${id}"] [data-review-verdict="${v}"]`);
const comment = (id: string) => $<HTMLTextAreaElement>(`[data-review-answer="${id}"] [data-review-comment]`);
const problem = (id: string) => answer(id).querySelector("[data-review-problem]");
const send = async () => {
  await act(async () => $<HTMLFormElement>("[data-review-form]")!.requestSubmit());
  await settle();
};

beforeEach(() => {
  actions.review.mockReset();
  actions.reopen.mockReset();

  document.body.append(container);
  root = createRoot(container);
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await act(async () => root.unmount());
  container.remove();
});
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import type { AttemptStatus, OpenReview, TestAnswers, TestQuestion, Verdict } from "@/db/schema";
import { TEST_LIMITS } from "@/domain/completion";
import type { AdminDict } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { reviewAttemptAction } from "@/server/actions/admin-assessment";
import ui from "./ui.module.css";
import styles from "./TestReview.module.css";

// Maria's review of one test attempt (e-course completion, spec §5.4): every question of the attempt's own copy in order, numbered as the
// student saw them. The choice part is read-only: each option she picked is marked right (✓) or wrong (✗) against the key, and a correct one she
// left out is named. Each open answer takes "Kinnitatud" or "Paranda" and a comment (required for "Paranda"); "Saada" sends them all
// (reviewAttemptAction). A plain form: what Maria marks and writes is kept in this browser (localStorage `mslab-review:<attemptId>`) until it is
// sent, so a reload or a closed tab loses nothing. An attempt not waiting for her ("fix", "passed", "failed") shows her last review, read-only.

export type ReviewTexts = AdminDict["assessment"]["review"];
/** What the review shows of an attempt (db/queries/assessment.ts ReviewAttempt): its copy of the questions, with the key. */
export type ReviewedAttempt = { id: number; status: AttemptStatus; questions: TestQuestion[]; answers: TestAnswers; review: OpenReview | null };

type Mark = { verdict: Verdict | null; comment: string };
type Marks = Record<string, Mark>;
type Problem = "verdict" | "comment" | "tooLong";
type ChoiceQuestion = Extract<TestQuestion, { kind: "choice" }>;

const draftKey = (attemptId: number) => `mslab-review:${attemptId}`;

/** Where the form starts: an answer Maria accepted before (a rewrite brings the attempt back) stays accepted; every other one is unmarked. */
function startMarks(a: ReviewedAttempt): Marks {
  const marks: Marks = {};
  for (const q of a.questions) {
    if (q.kind !== "open") continue;
    const last = a.review?.[q.id];
    marks[q.id] = last?.verdict === "ok" ? { verdict: "ok", comment: last.comment } : { verdict: null, comment: "" };
  }
  return marks;
}

/** The draft this browser kept, read defensively (the storage may hold anything, or be blocked): this attempt's open answers only. */
function readDraft(a: ReviewedAttempt): Marks | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(draftKey(a.id));
    if (!raw) return null;
    const kept = (JSON.parse(raw) as { marks?: Record<string, { verdict?: unknown; comment?: unknown } | undefined> }).marks ?? {};
    const marks = startMarks(a);
    for (const id of Object.keys(marks)) {
      const m = kept[id];
      if (m) marks[id] = { verdict: m.verdict === "ok" || m.verdict === "fix" ? m.verdict : null, comment: typeof m.comment === "string" ? m.comment : "" };
    }
    return marks;
  } catch {
    return null; // blocked storage, or not JSON: the form starts afresh
  }
}

function writeDraft(attemptId: number, marks: Marks): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(draftKey(attemptId), JSON.stringify({ marks, at: Date.now() }));
  } catch {
    // the storage is full or blocked: the form still works, its text is just not kept
  }
}

function dropDraft(attemptId: number): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(draftKey(attemptId));
  } catch {
    // blocked storage kept nothing
  }
}

/** What stops the send, per open answer: no verdict; "Paranda" without a comment; a comment over its limit (nothing is cut silently). */
function problemsOf(questions: readonly TestQuestion[], marks: Marks): Record<string, Problem> {
  const out: Record<string, Problem> = {};
  for (const q of questions) {
    if (q.kind !== "open") continue;
    const m = marks[q.id];
    if (!m?.verdict) out[q.id] = "verdict";
    else if (m.verdict === "fix" && !m.comment.trim()) out[q.id] = "comment";
    else if (m.comment.length > TEST_LIMITS.comment) out[q.id] = "tooLong";
  }
  return out;
}

/** A choice question is right when the picked options are exactly its correct ones (domain/completion.ts grade's rule). */
function exactlyRight(q: ChoiceQuestion, picks: readonly string[]): boolean {
  const correct = q.options.filter((o) => o.correct).map((o) => o.id);
  return picks.length === correct.length && correct.every((id) => picks.includes(id));
}

export function TestReview({ attempt, t }: { attempt: ReviewedAttempt; t: ReviewTexts }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const editable = attempt.status === "review";
  const [marks, setMarks] = useState<Marks>(() => startMarks(attempt));
  const [problems, setProblems] = useState<Record<string, Problem>>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [sent, setSent] = useState("");
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  const errorLine = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const sentLine = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editable) return;
    const kept = readDraft(attempt);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- the draft this browser kept is only known after hydration
    if (kept) setMarks(kept);
  }, [attempt, editable]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (error) errorLine.current?.focus();
  }, [error]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sent) sentLine.current?.focus();
  }, [sent]);

  const change = (id: string, part: Partial<Mark>) => {
    const next = { ...marks, [id]: { ...marks[id], ...part } };
    setMarks(next);
    writeDraft(attempt.id, next);
    if (problems[id]) setProblems(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(problems).filter(([key]) => key !== id)));
    setError("");
  };

  const send = () => {
    if (pending) return;
    const found = problemsOf(attempt.questions, marks);
    if (Object.keys(found).length > 0) {
      setProblems(found);
      setError(t.errors.incomplete);
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    const review: OpenReview = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(marks).map(([id, m]) => [id, { verdict: m.verdict as Verdict, comment: m.comment }]));
    start(async () => {
      const result = await reviewAttemptAction({ attemptId: attempt.id, review });
      if (result.kind === "reviewed") {
        dropDraft(attempt.id);
        setSent(result.completed ? t.sent.completed : result.status === "passed" ? t.sent.passed : t.sent.fix);
      } else {
        setError(result.kind === "invalid" ? t.errors[result.error] : t.errors[result.kind]);
      }
    });
  };

  // after a send the form shows what was sent (the page's refresh then shows what the server holds)
  const locked = !editable || sent !== "";
  const list = (
    <ol className={styles.questions}>
      {attempt.questions.map((q, i) => {
        const raw = attempt.answers[q.id];
        if (q.kind === "choice") {
          const picks = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [];
          const right = exactlyRight(q, picks);
          return (
            <li key={q.id} className={styles.question} data-review-question={q.id} data-review-right={right}>
              <div className={styles.head}>
                <p className={styles.text}>
                  <span className={styles.num}>{i + 1}.</span>
                  {q.text}
                </p>
                <span className={`${ui.tag} ${right ? ui.ok : ui.bad}`}>{right ? t.right : t.wrong}</span>
              </div>
              <ul className={styles.options}>
                {q.options.map((o) => {
                  const picked = picks.includes(o.id);
                  return (
                    <li key={o.id} className={styles.option} data-review-option={o.id} data-picked={picked || undefined} data-correct={o.correct || undefined}>
                      <span className={`${styles.mark} ${picked ? (o.correct ? styles.good : styles.bad) : ""}`} aria-hidden="true">
                        {picked ? (o.correct ? "✓" : "✗") : "·"}
                      </span>
                      <span>{o.text}</span>
                      {(picked || o.correct) && <span className={styles.note}>{picked ? (o.correct ? t.pickedRight : t.pickedWrong) : t.missed}</span>}
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            </li>
          );
        }
        const answer = typeof raw === "string" ? raw : "";
        const last = attempt.review?.[q.id];
        const mark = marks[q.id] ?? { verdict: null, comment: "" };
        const shown = editable ? mark : (last ?? null);
        const problem = problems[q.id];
        const box = `${uid}-${q.id}`;
        return (
          <li key={q.id} className={styles.question} data-review-answer={q.id}>
            <p className={styles.text}>
              <span className={styles.num}>{i + 1}.</span>
              {q.text}
            </p>
            <p className={styles.answer}>{answer || t.noAnswer}</p>
            {!locked ? (
              <>
                <div className={styles.verdicts} role="group" aria-label={fill(t.verdictLabel, { n: i + 1 })}>
                  {(["ok", "fix"] as const).map((v) => (
                    <button key={v} type="button" className={styles.verdict} aria-pressed={mark.verdict === v} onClick={() => change(q.id, { verdict: v })} data-review-verdict={v}>
                      {v === "ok" ? t.ok : t.fix}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className={ui.field}>
                  <label htmlFor={box}>{t.comment}</label>
                  <textarea
                    id={box}
                    className={ui.textarea}
                    value={mark.comment}
                    onChange={(e) => change(q.id, { comment: e.target.value })}
                    aria-invalid={problem === "comment" || problem === "tooLong" ? true : undefined}
                    aria-describedby={`${box}-hint`}
                    data-review-comment=""
                  />
                  <p id={`${box}-hint`} className={ui.hint}>
                    {last?.verdict === "fix" ? fill(t.previous, { text: last.comment }) : t.commentHint}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {problem && (
                  <p className={ui.error} data-review-problem={problem}>
                    {problem === "tooLong" ? fill(t.problems.tooLong, { n: mark.comment.length, max: TEST_LIMITS.comment }) : t.problems[problem]}
                  </p>
                )}
              </>
            ) : shown?.verdict ? (
              <div className={styles.shown}>
                <span className={`${ui.tag} ${shown.verdict === "ok" ? ui.ok : ui.warn}`} data-review-shown={shown.verdict}>
                  {shown.verdict === "ok" ? t.ok : t.fix}
                </span>
                {shown.comment && <p className={styles.comment}>{shown.comment}</p>}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className={ui.muted}>{t.notReviewed}</p>
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );

  if (!editable)
    return (
      <div className={styles.review} data-review-readonly={attempt.id}>
        {list}
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <form
      className={styles.review}
      noValidate
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        send();
      }}
      data-review-form={attempt.id}
    >
      {list}
      <div className={styles.send}>
        {!sent && (
          <button type="submit" className={ui.btn} aria-disabled={pending || undefined} data-review-send="">
            {pending ? t.sending : t.send}
          </button>
        )}
        <p ref={errorLine} tabIndex={-1} role="alert" className={`${ui.error} ${styles.line}`} data-review-error="">
          {error}
        </p>
        <p ref={sentLine} tabIndex={-1} role="status" className={`${ui.success} ${styles.line}`} data-review-sent="">
          {sent}
        </p>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```css
/* The test review (e-course completion, spec §5.4): every question in order, the choice part read-only with the student's picks marked against
   the key, each open answer with "Kinnitatud" / "Paranda" (44 px) and a comment box. Tokens only. */

.review {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}

.questions {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.question {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--paper);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px 12px;
}

.text {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: pre-line;
}

.num {
  margin-right: 6px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.options {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.option {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px 10px;
}

.mark {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1.2em;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

.good {
  color: var(--ok);
}

.bad {
  color: var(--bad);
}

.note {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* her answer as she wrote it: the admin notice's left rule, her line breaks kept */
.answer {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--rose);
  border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
  background: var(--canvas);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.verdicts {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.verdict {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fog);
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--font-body);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.verdict[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.verdict:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.shown {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 6px;
}

.comment {
  margin: 0;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.send {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 10px;
}

/* the error and the "sent" lines are live regions from the start: empty, they take no room */
.line:empty {
  margin-top: -10px;
}

.line:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rose);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import type { AdminDict } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { fill } from "@/i18n/format";
import { reopenTestAction } from "@/server/actions/admin-assessment";
import ui from "./ui.module.css";
import forms from "./RegistrationForms.module.css";
import styles from "./ClientDrawer.module.css";

export type ReopenTexts = AdminDict["assessment"]["reopen"] & { saving: string; error: string };

/**
 * "Ava test uuesti" (e-course completion, spec §5.2, §5.5) of one access whose tries are used up: one confirming step in place ("Jah, ava" /
 * "Ei"), as "Ava järgmine õppetund" has; the server adds the course's tries and mails her (server/test-attempts.ts reopenTest). Rendered for
 * every access that has a test, the button only while `used`: the line that says what was done stays when the page comes back with the test
 * open. It is a status region from the start (an empty one is announced when it fills) and takes the focus when it fills.
 */
export function ReopenTest({ accessId, course, used, t }: { accessId: number; course: string; used: boolean; t: ReopenTexts }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState("");
  const [pending, start] = useTransition();
  const question = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const doneLine = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  // the page came back with the test open (reopened elsewhere): a step left open ends with it, and does not come back asking by itself
  if (!used && confirming) setConfirming(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (confirming) question.current?.focus();
  }, [confirming]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (done) doneLine.current?.focus();
  }, [done]);

  const yes = () => {
    if (pending) return;
    setFailed(false);
    start(async () => {
      const result = await reopenTestAction({ accessId });
      if (result.kind === "reopened" || result.kind === "notNeeded") {
        setDone(result.kind === "reopened" ? fill(t.done, { n: result.triesLeft }) : t.notNeeded);
        setConfirming(false);
      } else {
        setFailed(true);
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      {used && !confirming && (
        <button
          ref={opener}
          type="button"
          className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`}
          onClick={() => {
            setDone("");
            setFailed(false);
            setConfirming(true);
          }}
          data-reopen=""
        >
          {t.button}
        </button>
      )}
      {used && confirming && (
        <div className={styles.confirm} role="group" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-q`} data-reopen-confirm="">
          <p id={`${uid}-q`} ref={question} tabIndex={-1} className={`${ui.notice} ${styles.question}`}>
            {fill(t.confirm, { course })}
          </p>
          <div className={forms.actions}>
            <button type="button" className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.smallBtn}`} aria-disabled={pending || undefined} onClick={yes}>
              {pending ? t.saving : t.yes}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setConfirming(false);
                requestAnimationFrame(() => opener.current?.focus());
              }}
            >
              {t.no}
            </button>
          </div>
          {failed && (
            <p role="alert" className={ui.error}>
              {t.error}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      <p ref={doneLine} tabIndex={-1} role="status" className={`${ui.success} ${styles.done}`} data-reopen-done="">
        {done}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { getAdminCounts } from "@/components/admin/data";
import { ReopenTest } from "@/components/admin/ReopenTest";
import { adminTitle } from "@/components/admin/sections";
import { Shell } from "@/components/admin/Shell";
import ui from "@/components/admin/ui.module.css";
import { getDb } from "@/db/client";
import { assessmentQueue } from "@/db/queries/assessment";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { pick } from "@/i18n/field";
import { fill, formatDate, formatTime } from "@/i18n/format";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/server/auth";
import styles from "./assessment.module.css";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const metadata: Metadata = { title: adminTitle(adminEt.nav.assessment) };

/** "19.10.2026 11:00" in Tallinn. */
const stamp = (d: Date) => `${formatDate(d, "et")} ${formatTime(d, "et")}`;

/**
 * Hindamine (e-course completion, spec §5.2): what waits for Maria, in three groups, each oldest first — the practical work sent ("Hinda" opens
 * the access's protocol screen, ?ligipaas=), the open answers waiting for her review ("Vaata vastuseid": /admin/hindamine/test?id=), and the
 * students out of tries ("Ava test uuesti" with its confirmation, and their attempts). A group with nothing in it is left out; when nothing waits
 * at all: "Kõik on hinnatud." Each group has an anchor the overview's card links to.
 */
export default async function AssessmentPage() {
  const email = await requireAdmin();
  // the shell's counts are read here too (memoised), so the page does not wait for the list before asking for them
  const [queue] = await Promise.all([assessmentQueue(getDb()), getAdminCounts()]);
  const t = adminEt.assessment;
  const reopen = { ...t.reopen, saving: adminEt.common.saving, error: adminEt.common.saveError };
  const nothing = queue.practicals.length + queue.tests.length + queue.triesUsed.length === 0;

  return (
    <Shell email={email} active="assessment">
      <div className={ui.page} data-assessment-page="">
        <div className={ui.heading}>
          <div>
            <p className={ui.eyebrow}>{t.eyebrow}</p>
            <h1 className={ui.h1}>{t.title}</h1>
            <p className={ui.lead}>{t.lead}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {nothing ? (
          <section className={ui.card} aria-label={t.title}>
            <p className={ui.empty} data-queue-empty="">
              {t.empty}
            </p>
          </section>
        ) : (
          <div className={styles.groups}>
            {queue.practicals.length > 0 && (
              <section id="praktilised" className={ui.card} aria-labelledby="queue-practicals" data-queue="practicals">
                <h2 id="queue-practicals" className={ui.h2}>
                  {t.groups.practicals}
                </h2>
                <ul className={styles.items}>
                  {queue.practicals.map((p) => (
                    <li key={p.accessId} className={styles.item} data-queue-item={p.accessId}>
                      <span className={styles.what}>
                        <strong>{p.name}</strong>
                        <span className={ui.muted}>{[pick(p.course, "et"), fill(t.round, { n: p.round }), fill(t.sentAt, { date: stamp(p.submittedAt) })].join(" · ")}</span>
                      </span>
                      <Link className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`} href={`/admin/protokollid?ligipaas=${p.accessId}`}>
                        {t.assess}
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </section>
            )}

            {queue.tests.length > 0 && (
              <section id="testid" className={ui.card} aria-labelledby="queue-tests" data-queue="tests">
                <h2 id="queue-tests" className={ui.h2}>
                  {t.groups.tests}
                </h2>
                <ul className={styles.items}>
                  {queue.tests.map((w) => (
                    <li key={w.attemptId} className={styles.item} data-queue-item={w.accessId}>
                      <span className={styles.what}>
                        <strong>{w.name}</strong>
                        <span className={ui.muted}>
                          {[pick(w.course, "et"), fill(t.tryOf, { n: w.number, max: w.allowed }), fill(t.sentAt, { date: stamp(w.submittedAt) })].join(" · ")}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                      <Link className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`} href={`/admin/hindamine/test?id=${w.attemptId}`}>
                        {t.viewAnswers}
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </section>
            )}

            {queue.triesUsed.length > 0 && (
              <section id="katsed" className={ui.card} aria-labelledby="queue-tries" data-queue="tries">
                <h2 id="queue-tries" className={ui.h2}>
                  {t.groups.triesUsed}
                </h2>
                <ul className={styles.items}>
                  {queue.triesUsed.map((u) => (
                    <li key={u.accessId} className={styles.item} data-queue-item={u.accessId}>
                      <span className={styles.what}>
                        <strong>{u.name}</strong>
                        <span className={ui.muted}>{[pick(u.course, "et"), fill(t.best, { n: u.best }), fill(t.attemptsMade, { n: u.attempts })].join(" · ")}</span>
                      </span>
                      <div className={styles.actions}>
                        <Link className={ui.link} href={`/admin/hindamine/test?ligipaas=${u.accessId}`}>
                          {t.attempts}
                        </Link>
                        <ReopenTest accessId={u.accessId} course={pick(u.course, "et")} used t={reopen} />
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </section>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Shell>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 16: The test review page** — create `src/app/admin/(panel)/hindamine/test/page.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { getAdminCounts } from "@/components/admin/data";
import { adminTitle } from "@/components/admin/sections";
import { Shell } from "@/components/admin/Shell";
import { TestReview } from "@/components/admin/TestReview";
import ui from "@/components/admin/ui.module.css";
import { getDb } from "@/db/client";
import { attemptForReview, attemptsOf, type ReviewAttempt } from "@/db/queries/assessment";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";
import { pick, type I18n } from "@/i18n/field";
import { fill, formatDate, formatTime } from "@/i18n/format";
import { parseRowId } from "@/lib/row-id";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/server/auth";
import styles from "../assessment.module.css";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const metadata: Metadata = { title: adminTitle(adminEt.nav.assessment) };

type Props = { searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>> };

const one = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (typeof v === "string" ? v : "");
/** "19.10.2026 11:00" in Tallinn. */
const stamp = (d: Date) => `${formatDate(d, "et")} ${formatTime(d, "et")}`;

/**
 * The test review (e-course completion, spec §5.4). ?id=<attempt>: one attempt — its copy of the questions, the choice part read-only and the
 * open answers' form while it waits for Maria (TestReview; its notice links here). ?ligipaas=<access>: every attempt of that student, newest
 * first, each with its result (the drawer's "Testi katsed"). Nothing found (or an access an admin ended): one sentence and the way back.
 */
export default async function TestReviewPage({ searchParams }: Props) {
  const email = await requireAdmin();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const attemptId = parseRowId(one(sp.id));
  const accessId = attemptId === null ? parseRowId(one(sp.ligipaas)) : null;
  const db = getDb();
  const [attempt, list] = await Promise.all([attemptId === null ? null : attemptForReview(db, attemptId), accessId === null ? null : attemptsOf(db, accessId), getAdminCounts()]);
  const t = adminEt.assessment.review;

  return (
    <Shell email={email} active="assessment">
      <div className={ui.page} data-test-review-page="">
        <p className={styles.back}>
          <Link className={ui.link} href="/admin/hindamine">
            <span aria-hidden="true">←</span> {t.back}
          </Link>
        </p>
        {attempt ? (
          <OneAttempt a={attempt} />
        ) : list && accessId !== null ? (
          <AttemptList accessId={accessId} name={list.name} course={list.course} attempts={list.attempts} />
        ) : (
          <p className={ui.empty}>{accessId === null ? t.notFound : t.notFoundAccess}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </Shell>
  );
}

/** One attempt: who, which try, when, its state and the choice part's score; then the review itself. */
function OneAttempt({ a }: { a: ReviewAttempt }) {
  const t = adminEt.assessment;
  const hasChoice = a.questions.some((q) => q.kind === "choice");
  return (
    <>
      <div className={ui.heading}>
        <div>
          <p className={ui.eyebrow}>{pick(a.course, "et")}</p>
          <h1 className={ui.h1}>{a.name}</h1>
          <p className={ui.lead}>
            {[fill(t.tryOf, { n: a.number, max: a.allowed }), fill(t.sentAt, { date: stamp(a.submittedAt) })].join(" · ")} ·{" "}
            <span data-attempt-status={a.status}>{t.review.status[a.status]}</span>
          </p>
          {hasChoice && (
            <p className={styles.score} data-review-score="">
              {fill(t.review.score, { percent: a.percent, pass: a.passPercent })}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <TestReview attempt={{ id: a.id, status: a.status, questions: a.questions, answers: a.answers, review: a.review }} t={t.review} />
      <p className={styles.more}>
        <Link className={ui.link} href={`/admin/hindamine/test?ligipaas=${a.accessId}`}>
          {t.attempts}
        </Link>
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

/** Every attempt of one student, newest first: the try, when, the score and the state, and the way to it. */
function AttemptList({ accessId, name, course, attempts }: { accessId: number; name: string; course: I18n; attempts: ReviewAttempt[] }) {
  const t = adminEt.assessment;
  return (
    <>
      <div className={ui.heading}>
        <div>
          <p className={ui.eyebrow}>{pick(course, "et")}</p>
          <h1 className={ui.h1}>{name}</h1>
          <p className={ui.lead}>{t.review.list}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <section className={ui.card} aria-label={t.review.list} data-attempts={accessId}>
        {attempts.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={ui.empty}>{t.review.noAttempts}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className={styles.items}>
            {attempts.map((a) => (
              <li key={a.id} className={styles.item} data-attempt={a.id}>
                <span className={styles.what}>
                  <strong>{fill(t.tryOf, { n: a.number, max: a.allowed })}</strong>
                  <span className={ui.muted}>{[stamp(a.submittedAt), fill(t.review.percent, { n: a.percent }), t.review.status[a.status]].join(" · ")}</span>
                </span>
                <Link className={`${ui.btn} ${ui.secondary} ${ui.smallBtn}`} href={`/admin/hindamine/test?id=${a.id}`}>
                  {t.review.view}
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Task 13: The Õpilased drawer — each access's step line, "Lisa protokoll" / "Ava protokoll", "Testi katsed", "Ava test uuesti"; "Lisa protokoll" on each contact registration

Spec §5.5 (the student's profile: "the entry point Maria asked for") and §1 (one universal protocol, opened from the student's profile). No ruling of R1–R6 applies; the protocol screen of an access is Task 11's `?ligipaas=`, that of a registration the protocols phase's `?registreering=`.

**What the drawer shows, per e-course access:**
- **The step line** (`[data-access-steps]`): "Õppetunnid 8/8 · Test: läbitud (85 %) · Praktiline töö: ootab hindamist", or "Lõpetatud 14.11.2026" once `completed_at` is set. It is built from the access's `CourseSteps` (server/completion.ts `loadSteps`, Task 4, the same rules her own page uses) by one pure helper, `stepLine` (`src/components/admin/step-line.ts`). A step the course does not have is left out, as on her page; a course without lessons names none. The score in brackets is her newest attempt's (`percentOf`, rounded down), shown once she has an attempt: `CourseSteps` carries no score, so `ClientAccessRow` gains `testPercent` (an addition).
- **"Lisa protokoll"** while the access has no protocol row (`protocolId` null), **"Ava protokoll"** once it has one; both open `/admin/protokollid?ligipaas=<accessId>` (the screen creates the row on its first save, Task 10).
- **"Testi katsed"** (`/admin/hindamine/test?ligipaas=<accessId>`) once she has an attempt; **`ReopenTest`** (Task 12) for every access with a test, its button only while the test's state is "used".
- An access an admin ended keeps its line (her history) but gets none of the buttons: its screens answer "not found" (Task 10 `current`, Task 12 `attemptsOf`).

**Per registration:** a contact course's registration that is not cancelled gets "Lisa protokoll" / "Ava protokoll" → `/admin/protokollid?registreering=<id>` (the condition the Registreerimised drawer uses for its "Ava protokoll"). An e-course's registration (a purchase made as one) gets none.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { stepLine } from "@/components/admin/step-line";
import type { CourseSteps } from "@/domain/completion";
import { adminEt } from "@/i18n/dict/admin";

// The Õpilased drawer's line about one e-course access (e-course completion, spec §5.5): her lessons, the test with her newest score and the
// practical work in Maria's words, a step the course does not have left out, and "Lõpetatud" with its day once the course is completed.

const t = adminEt.clients.steps;
const steps = (over: Partial<CourseSteps> = {}): CourseSteps => ({
  lessons: { done: 8, total: 8, state: "done" },
  test: { state: "done", triesLeft: null },
  practical: { state: "review", round: 1 },
  completedAt: null,
  ...over,
});

describe("stepLine", () => {
  test("the spec's line: the lessons, the test with her score, the practical work", () => {
    expect(stepLine(steps(), t, 85)).toBe("Õppetunnid 8/8 · Test: läbitud (85 %) · Praktiline töö: ootab hindamist");
  });

  test("every state in words; no score before her first attempt", () => {
    expect(stepLine(steps({ lessons: { done: 3, total: 8, state: "open" }, test: { state: "locked", triesLeft: 3 }, practical: { state: "locked", round: 0 } }), t)).toBe(
      "Õppetunnid 3/8 · Test: lukus · Praktiline töö: lukus",
    );
    expect(stepLine(steps({ test: { state: "open", triesLeft: 2 }, practical: { state: "locked", round: 0 } }), t, 60)).toBe("Õppetunnid 8/8 · Test: avatud (60 %) · Praktiline töö: lukus");
    for (const [state, word] of [
      ["review", "ootab hindamist"],
      ["fix", "parandamisel"],
      ["used", "katsed otsas"],
    ] as const)
      expect(stepLine(steps({ test: { state, triesLeft: 0 } }), t, 70)).toContain(`Test: ${word} (70 %)`);
    for (const [state, word] of [
      ["open", "avatud"],
      ["fix", "parandamisel"],
      ["done", "kinnitatud"],
    ] as const)
      expect(stepLine(steps({ practical: { state, round: 2 } }), t)).toContain(`Praktiline töö: ${word}`);
  });

  test("a step the course does not have is left out; a course without lessons names none; nothing at all is an empty line", () => {
    expect(stepLine(steps({ test: null }), t)).toBe("Õppetunnid 8/8 · Praktiline töö: ootab hindamist");
    expect(stepLine(steps({ practical: null }), t, 85)).toBe("Õppetunnid 8/8 · Test: läbitud (85 %)");
    expect(stepLine(steps({ lessons: { done: 0, total: 0, state: "done" } }), t, 85)).toBe("Test: läbitud (85 %) · Praktiline töö: ootab hindamist");
    expect(stepLine(steps({ lessons: { done: 0, total: 0, state: "done" }, test: null, practical: null }), t)).toBe("");
  });

  test("completed: only 'Lõpetatud' with its day in Tallinn", () => {
    expect(stepLine(steps({ completedAt: "2026-11-13T22:30:00.000Z" }), t, 85)).toBe("Lõpetatud 14.11.2026"); // 00:30 in Tallinn
  });
});
```
