- [ ] **Step 4: The helper** — create `src/components/admin/step-line.ts`:

```ts
import type { CourseSteps, StepState } from "@/domain/completion";
import { fill, formatDate } from "@/i18n/format";

// The Õpilased drawer's line about one e-course access (e-course completion, spec §5.5): "Õppetunnid 8/8 · Test: läbitud (85 %) · Praktiline
// töö: ootab hindamist", or "Lõpetatud 14.11.2026" once the course is completed. Built from the steps her own page shows (server/completion.ts
// loadSteps), so the two never disagree. Pure: the words come in (adminEt.clients.steps).

export type StepLineTexts = {
  /** "Õppetunnid {done}/{total}" */
  lessons: string;
  /** "Test: {state}", before her first attempt */
  test: string;
  /** "Test: {state} ({percent} %)" */
  testScore: string;
  /** "Praktiline töö: {state}" */
  practical: string;
  /** "Lõpetatud {date}" */
  completed: string;
  testStates: Record<StepState, string>;
  /** (the practical work is never "used": that is the test's tries) */
  practicalStates: Record<Exclude<StepState, "used">, string>;
};

/**
 * The line: "Lõpetatud <day in Tallinn>" for a completed course; else the lessons (when the course has any), the test (when it has questions)
 * with `percent` — her newest attempt's score, null before her first — and the practical work (when it has points), joined by " · ".
 */
export function stepLine(steps: CourseSteps, t: StepLineTexts, percent: number | null = null): string {
  if (steps.completedAt) return fill(t.completed, { date: formatDate(new Date(steps.completedAt), "et") });
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (steps.lessons.total > 0) parts.push(fill(t.lessons, { done: steps.lessons.done, total: steps.lessons.total }));
  if (steps.test) {
    const state = t.testStates[steps.test.state];
    parts.push(percent === null ? fill(t.test, { state }) : fill(t.testScore, { state, percent }));
  }
  if (steps.practical) parts.push(fill(t.practical, { state: t.practicalStates[steps.practical.state === "used" ? "locked" : steps.practical.state] }));
  return parts.join(" · ");
}
```

```ts
/** Everything the student's drawer shows, or null when there is no such student. Newest first in every list. */
export async function clientDetail(db: Db, id: number, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<ClientDetail | null> {
  const [[client], regs, reqs, access, terms, payments, feedback] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ id: clients.id, email: clients.email, name: NAME, ownName: clients.name, phone: clients.phone, locale: clients.locale, createdAt: clients.createdAt })
      .from(clients)
      .where(eq(clients.id, id))
      .limit(1),
    listRegistrations(db, { clientId: id }),
    db.select().from(requests).where(eq(requests.clientId, id)).orderBy(desc(requests.createdAt), desc(requests.id)),
    db
      .select({
        id: courseAccess.id,
        courseId: courseAccess.courseId,
        title: courses.title,
        slug: courses.slug,
        grantedBy: courseAccess.grantedBy,
        grantedAt: courseAccess.grantedAt,
        expiresAt: courseAccess.expiresAt,
        revokedAt: courseAccess.revokedAt,
        extraTries: courseAccess.extraTries,
        completedAt: courseAccess.completedAt,
      })
      .from(courseAccess)
      .innerJoin(courses, eq(courseAccess.courseId, courses.id))
      .where(eq(courseAccess.clientId, id))
      .orderBy(desc(courseAccess.grantedAt), desc(courseAccess.id)),
    db
      .select({ courseTitle: courses.title, version: termsAcceptances.termsVersion, acceptedAt: termsAcceptances.acceptedAt })
      .from(termsAcceptances)
      .innerJoin(courses, eq(termsAcceptances.courseId, courses.id))
      .where(eq(termsAcceptances.clientId, id))
      .orderBy(desc(termsAcceptances.acceptedAt)),
    listPaymentsOf(db, { clientId: id }),
    feedbackOf(db, { clientId: id }),
  ]);
  if (!client) return null;
  const newsletter = await newsletterState(db, client.email);
  // each e-course's lessons for her: done of total, and the first lesson she cannot open yet ("Ava järgmine õppetund"); and (e-course
  // completion, spec §5.5) each access's steps as her own page reads them, the protocols of her accesses and registrations, her attempts
  const [outlines, steps, accessProtocols, registrationProtocols, attempts] = await Promise.all([
    Promise.all(access.map((a) => courseOutline(db, a.courseId, id))),
    Promise.all(
      access.map((a) =>
        loadSteps(db, { id: a.id, clientId: id, courseId: a.courseId, expiresAt: a.expiresAt, revokedAt: a.revokedAt, extraTries: a.extraTries, completedAt: a.completedAt }),
      ),
    ),
    access.length ? db.select({ id: protocols.id, accessId: protocols.accessId }).from(protocols).where(inArray(protocols.accessId, access.map((a) => a.id))) : [],
    regs.length ? db.select({ id: protocols.id, registrationId: protocols.registrationId }).from(protocols).where(inArray(protocols.registrationId, regs.map((r) => r.id))) : [],
    db.select({ courseId: testAttempts.courseId, number: testAttempts.number, correct: testAttempts.correct, total: testAttempts.total }).from(testAttempts).where(eq(testAttempts.clientId, id)),
  ]);
  const accessProtocol = new Map(accessProtocols.map((p) => [p.accessId, p.id]));
  const registrationProtocol = new Map(registrationProtocols.map((p) => [p.registrationId, p.id]));
  // her newest attempt at each course's test: its score is the step line's
  const newest = new Map<number, { number: number; percent: number }>();
  for (const t of attempts) if ((newest.get(t.courseId)?.number ?? 0) < t.number) newest.set(t.courseId, { number: t.number, percent: percentOf(t.correct, t.total) });
  return {
    client,
    registrations: regs.map((r) => ({ ...r, protocolId: registrationProtocol.get(r.id) ?? null, contact: r.course.type === "contact" })),
    requests: await requestRows(db, reqs),
    access: access.map((a, i) => {
      const locked = outlines[i].lessons.find((l) => l.state === "locked");
      return {
        ...a,
        state: accessState(a, now),
        progress: { done: outlines[i].progress.done, total: outlines[i].progress.total },
        nextLocked: locked ? { id: locked.id, title: locked.title } : null,
        steps: steps[i],
        protocolId: accessProtocol.get(a.id) ?? null,
        testPercent: newest.get(a.courseId)?.percent ?? null,
      };
    }),
    terms,
    newsletter,
    payments,
    feedback,
  };
}
```

```ts
const lessonDone = (clientId: number, lessonId: number) => db.insert(lessonProgress).values({ clientId, lessonId, watchedSec: 100, doneAt: NOW });
const failedAttempt = (clientId: number, number: number) =>
  db.insert(testAttempts).values({ clientId, courseId: veeb.id, number, questions: [QUESTION], answers: { qvalik01: ["o1vale01"] }, correct: 0, total: 1, status: "failed", submittedAt: NOW });
const drawer = async (clientId: number) => renderToStaticMarkup(ClientDetailView({ detail: (await clientDetail(db, clientId, NOW))!, ecourses: [], now: NOW }));
/** The HTML from `attribute="value"` to the next element carrying the same attribute (or the end). */
const part = (html: string, attribute: string, value: string | number) => {
  const from = html.indexOf(`${attribute}="${value}"`);
  expect(from, `${attribute}=${value}`).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
  const next = html.indexOf(`${attribute}="`, from + 1);
  return html.slice(from, next === -1 ? undefined : next);
};
```

### Task 14: End to end — the whole path in a real browser; two submits and two uploads at once on real Postgres

Spec §9 "End to end" 1–8, "Real Postgres" and "Gate"; Review Focus 1 (the phone photo: 6000×4000 with GPS, sideways, a lost upload, a HEIC) and 2 (two devices or a double tap). Every flow runs under `next dev` and the production build (`E2E_PROD_BUILD=1`, with `MEDIA_LOCAL=1`: the photos go to `app/.media-local`); the gate's own run checks the new account routes stay gated.

**The fixtures** (`tests/e2e/completion.ts`) write straight to the local database, as `lessons.ts` and `protocols.ts` do. Each test makes its own e-course (`e2e-konto-compl-<label>-<project>`, not published) with one text lesson, its `course_tests` row (when it has questions), Maria's points, a six-month access and the course terms of version "1" accepted (`takeTerms` sets that version and holds it for the test, as `account-lessons.spec.ts` does: the e-course page checks the terms). Every student is a sample address `e2e-client-compl-<label>-<project>@example.test` (never mailed); `removeClientRows` removes the account, the course and, by cascade, the access, the attempts, the protocol and the photo rows, and now also the photo files of the local store.

**The photo fixtures are made at run time, not committed.** The repository has no image library and is public, so no binary is added: `canvasJpeg` draws a synthetic picture (gradients, an arrow pointing up, a grain tile) on a canvas in the test's own browser and encodes it as JPEG; `withExif` (Node, byte by byte) puts a made-up EXIF block after its JFIF segment: a GPS position at sea (1°2′3″ N, 4°5′6″ E), and an orientation tag for the sideways one. `hasExif` walks a JPEG's segments up to the picture data. (An earlier outline named committed files `tests/e2e/fixtures/photo-*.jpg`; the controller's note chose run-time fixtures instead.)

**The race tests need no browser** (`completion-race.spec.ts`, as `protocols-race.spec.ts`): the app's own `submitPractical`, `addPhoto` and `submitAttempt` run in the test process on a pool of the local Postgres, with a store in a temporary folder. Two submits at once give one round and one notice; the 3rd and a 4th photo of one point at once give three photos; another connection holding the access row makes a submit wait, with the protocol row still free (the lock order: access, then protocol); two identical test submits at once give one attempt (the second is a repeat: Task 5). The desktop project runs them once.

**Selectors this task depends on** (the plan's, as Tasks 6–9 drafted them, plus this plan's): Task 6 `[data-test-page]`, `[data-test-state=<kind>]`, `[data-question=<id>]`, `[data-answer-option=<optionId>]`, `[data-answer-open]`, `[data-test-submit]`, the inline confirm's `[data-confirm=yes|no]`, `[data-test-result]`, `[data-test-wrong]`, `[data-test-retry]`, `[data-test-review-comment=<id>]`; Task 8 `[data-practical-page]`, `[data-practical-status=<status>]`, `[data-point=<i>]`, `[data-photo-add]` (the file input inside it), `[data-point-verdict=ok|fix]`, `[data-point-note]`, `[data-photo=<id>]`, `[data-photo-pending=<state>]`, `[data-photo-retry]`, `[data-earlier]`, `[data-practical-submit]`, `[data-practical-confirm]` (on the confirm's "Jah, saada"), `[data-practical-completed]`; Task 9 `[data-completion]`, `[data-step]`, `[data-step-state]`, `[data-step-link]`, `[data-card=course-<slug>] [data-card-completed]`; Task 11 `[data-assess-point=<i>]`, `[data-assess-photo]`, `[data-verdict=ok|fix]`, `[data-verdict-unsaved]`, `[data-assess-send]`, `[data-assess-confirm]` (Task 11 puts it on the confirmation's yes button), `[data-assess-sent]`, and the protocol screen's `[data-protocol-screen]`, `[data-editor=<accessId>]`, `[data-note=<i>]`, `[data-general]`, `[data-save-status]`; Task 12 `[data-assessment-page]`, `[data-queue]`, `[data-queue-item=<accessId>]`, `[data-reopen]`, `[data-reopen-confirm]`, `[data-review-answer]`, `[data-review-verdict]`, `[data-review-comment]`, `[data-review-send]`, `[data-review-sent]`, `[data-test-review-page]`; Task 13 `[data-access=<courseId>]`, `[data-access-steps]`, `[data-access-protocol]`, `[data-client-registration=<id>] [data-registration-protocol]`. - [ ] **Step 1: The helpers** — create `tests/e2e/completion.ts`:

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import type { AttemptStatus, TestQuestion } from "../../src/db/schema";
import { localStore } from "../../src/server/media-local";
import { accountCourseSlug, onLocalDb } from "./fixtures";

// The e-course completion's e2e rows (completion.spec.ts, completion-race.spec.ts): an e-course of the test's own, not published, with one text
// lesson, Maria's test and points, a six-month access and the course terms of version "1" accepted; attempts, a practical work with its photos
// (in the local store of the e2e run's server: app/.media-local) and a contact registration, as a test needs them. Every address is
// `e2e-client-compl-<label>-<project>@example.test`: a sample address (never mailed) that fixtures.ts removeClientRows removes with everything it
// made, the photo files included; the course's slug is the address's (accountCourseSlug), so it goes too. Nothing here is on a public page.
// And the photo fixtures: a picture drawn on a canvas in the test's own browser, with a made-up EXIF block written in here (no binary in the
// repository, no real person or place).

/** The local database for rows no public page shows. */
const localDb = <T>(work: Parameters<typeof onLocalDb<T>>[0]): Promise<T> => onLocalDb(work, { marksPages: false });

/** The e2e run's server keeps the photos here (server/media-local.ts: `next dev`, and the local production build with MEDIA_LOCAL=1). */
const files = () => localStore(join(process.cwd(), ".media-local"));
const arrayBuffer = (b: Buffer) => b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.byteLength) as ArrayBuffer;

export const E2E_POINTS = ["Ettevalmistus", "Värvimine"];
/** Two choice questions, one correct option each (`a`); ids as the course editor makes them ([0-9a-z]). */
export const E2E_QUESTIONS: TestQuestion[] = [
  { id: "q1", kind: "choice", text: "Mitu korda pesta pintslit?", options: [{ id: "a", text: "Pärast igat kasutust", correct: true }, { id: "b", text: "Kord nädalas", correct: false }] },
  { id: "q2", kind: "choice", text: "Millest algab kulmude kuju?", options: [{ id: "a", text: "Näo proportsioonidest", correct: true }, { id: "b", text: "Moest", correct: false }] },
];
/** Two open questions, for Maria's review. */
export const E2E_OPEN: TestQuestion[] = [
  { id: "q3", kind: "open", text: "Kirjelda oma tööde järjekorda." },
  { id: "q4", kind: "open", text: "Mida teed, kui kliendil tekib allergia?" },
];

export type CompletionCourse = { clientId: number; accessId: number; slug: string; courseId: number; lessonId: number };

/**
 * A client ("Kati Kask" unless `name`) with six months of access to an e-course of her own ("E2E lõpetamine", not published) of one text lesson
 * (done when `lessonsDone`), `questions` (none by default: a course without a test) with the pass mark 80 and 3 tries unless given, and `points`
 * (E2E_POINTS by default; [] for a course without practical work); the course terms of version "1" accepted.
 */
export async function insertCompletionCourse(
  email: string,
  opts: { locale?: "et" | "ru"; questions?: TestQuestion[]; points?: string[]; lessonsDone?: boolean; name?: string; passPercent?: number; tries?: number } = {},
): Promise<CompletionCourse> {
  const slug = accountCourseSlug(email);
  const questions = opts.questions ?? [];
  return localDb(async (sql) => {
    const [client] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`insert into clients (email, name, locale) values (${email}, ${opts.name ?? "Kati Kask"}, ${opts.locale ?? "et"}) returning id`;
    const [course] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into courses (slug, type, level, title, summary, body, price, access_months, published, protocol_stages)
      values (${slug}, 'e_learning', 'basic', ${sql.json({ et: "E2E lõpetamine", ru: "E2E завершение" })}, ${sql.json({ et: "" })}, ${sql.json({ et: "" })}, 9500, 6, false,
              ${sql.json(opts.points ?? E2E_POINTS)})
      returning id`;
    if (questions.length > 0)
      await sql`insert into course_tests (course_id, questions, pass_percent, tries) values (${course.id}, ${sql.json(questions)}, ${opts.passPercent ?? 80}, ${opts.tries ?? 3})`;
    const [m] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`insert into course_modules (course_id, position, title) values (${course.id}, 1, ${sql.json({ et: "Alustame", ru: "Начинаем" })}) returning id`;
    const [lesson] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into lessons (module_id, position, title, body, kind)
      values (${m.id}, 1, ${sql.json({ et: "Ainus tund", ru: "Единственный урок" })}, ${sql.json({ et: "Loe läbi ja märgi tehtuks." })}, 'text') returning id`;
    const [access] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into course_access (client_id, course_id, granted_by, expires_at) values (${client.id}, ${course.id}, 'e2e', now() + interval '6 months') returning id`;
    await sql`insert into terms_acceptances (client_id, course_id, terms_version) values (${client.id}, ${course.id}, '1')`;
    if (opts.lessonsDone) await sql`insert into lesson_progress (client_id, lesson_id, watched_sec, done_at) values (${client.id}, ${lesson.id}, 0, now())`;
    return { clientId: client.id, accessId: access.id, slug, courseId: course.id, lessonId: lesson.id };
  });
}

/** Her attempts, numbered 1… in `list`'s order an hour apart (the last an hour ago), each with `questions` as its copy; their ids. */
export async function insertAttempts(clientId: number, courseId: number, questions: TestQuestion[], list: { status: AttemptStatus; correct: number; total: number }[]): Promise<number[]> {
  const answers = Object.fromEntries(questions.map((q) => [q.id, q.kind === "choice" ? [q.options[0].id] : "Minu vastus."]));
  return localDb(async (sql) => {
    const ids: number[] = [];
    for (const [i, a] of list.entries()) {
      const [row] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
        insert into test_attempts (client_id, course_id, number, questions, answers, correct, total, status, submitted_at)
        values (${clientId}, ${courseId}, ${i + 1}, ${sql.json(questions)}, ${sql.json(answers)}, ${a.correct}, ${a.total}, ${a.status}, now() - make_interval(hours => ${list.length - i}::int))
        returning id`;
      ids.push(row.id);
    }
    return ids;
  });
}

/** A JPEG and its picture's size. */
export type Jpeg = { bytes: Buffer; width: number; height: number };

/**
 * Her practical work: `round` submissions so far (0: a round being prepared), the last two hours ago; `photos` each a copy of `jpeg` (full and
 * thumbnail) in the local store; with `sent`, Maria's assessment of `round` sent an hour ago (her notes under the points, the verdicts frozen
 * into the sent copy and kept in the draft, as server/assessment.ts sendAssessment leaves them).
 */
export async function insertPractical(
  accessId: number,
  points: string[],
  jpeg: Jpeg,
  seed: { round: number; photos: { stage: number; round: number }[]; sent?: { verdicts: ("ok" | "fix")[]; notes: string[] } },
): Promise<{ protocolId: number; photoIds: number[] }> {
  const stages = points.map((title, i) => ({ title, note: seed.sent?.notes[i] ?? "" }));
  const verdicts = points.map((_, i) => seed.sent?.verdicts[i] ?? null);
  const stored: { stage: number; round: number; key: string; thumbKey: string }[] = [];
  for (const p of seed.photos) {
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    const key = `practical/${id}.jpg`;
    const thumbKey = `practical/${id}-t.jpg`;
    for (const k of [key, thumbKey]) await files().put(k, arrayBuffer(jpeg.bytes), "image/jpeg");
    stored.push({ ...p, key, thumbKey });
  }
  const submittedAt = seed.round > 0 ? new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 3_600_000) : null;
  const sentAt = seed.sent ? new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000) : null;
  return localDb(async (sql) => {
    const [protocol] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into protocols (access_id, stages, general_note, version, verdicts, round, submitted_at, sent, sent_at, sent_version, sent_round)
      values (${accessId}, ${sql.json(stages)}, '', 1, ${sql.json(verdicts)}, ${seed.round}, ${submittedAt},
              ${seed.sent ? sql.json({ stages, generalNote: "", verdicts }) : null}, ${sentAt}, ${seed.sent ? 1 : null}, ${seed.sent ? seed.round : null})
      returning id`;
    const photoIds: number[] = [];
    for (const p of stored) {
      const [row] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
        insert into practical_photos (protocol_id, stage, round, key, thumb_key, size, width, height)
        values (${protocol.id}, ${p.stage}, ${p.round}, ${p.key}, ${p.thumbKey}, ${jpeg.bytes.length}, ${jpeg.width}, ${jpeg.height})
        returning id`;
      photoIds.push(row.id);
    }
    return { protocolId: protocol.id, photoIds };
  });
}

/**
 * A contact course of the test's own (not published; its slug is `courseEmail`'s, so removeClientRows(courseEmail) removes it with its session)
 * with E2E_POINTS and one session in two weeks, and her confirmed group registration on it, linked to her account; the registration's id.
 */
export async function insertContactRegistration(email: string, clientId: number, courseEmail: string): Promise<number> {
  return localDb(async (sql) => {
    const [course] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into courses (slug, type, level, title, summary, body, price_group, published, protocol_stages)
      values (${accountCourseSlug(courseEmail)}, 'contact', 'basic', ${sql.json({ et: "E2E kontaktkoolitus" })}, ${sql.json({ et: "" })}, ${sql.json({ et: "" })}, 35000, false,
              ${sql.json(E2E_POINTS)})
      returning id`;
    const [session] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into course_sessions (course_id, starts_at, city, venue, capacity) values (${course.id}, now() + interval '14 days', 'Pärnu', 'MS LAB stuudio', 6) returning id`;
    const [r] = await sql<{ id: number }[]>`
      insert into registrations (course_id, course_session_id, kind, name, email, phone, payment_choice, status, paid_cents, client_id)
      values (${course.id}, ${session.id}, 'group', 'Kati Kask', ${email}, '+372 5555 0101', 'full', 'confirmed', 35000, ${clientId})
      returning id`;
    return r.id;
  });
}

/** A stored photo's file, as the e2e run's server wrote it (app/.media-local/<key>). */
export const localFile = (key: string): Buffer => readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), ".media-local", ...key.split("/")));

// ---------- the photo fixtures ----------

/**
 * A JPEG drawn in `page`'s browser (any page, about:blank too): soft gradients, an arrow that points up (a turned picture shows it), and with
 * `grain` a fine noise all over, as a phone's sensor gives (it keeps a 6000×4000 picture megabytes large). Encoded by the canvas: no metadata.
 */
export async function canvasJpeg(page: Page, width: number, height: number, opts: { grain?: boolean } = {}): Promise<Jpeg> {
  const dataUrl = await page.evaluate(
    async ({ width, height, grain }) => {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = width;
      canvas.height = height;
      const g = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
      const sky = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, height);
      sky.addColorStop(0, "#d9c7cf");
      sky.addColorStop(0.5, "#8fa6b8");
      sky.addColorStop(1, "#4f5d46");
      g.fillStyle = sky;
      g.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      g.fillStyle = "#222222";
      const u = Math.min(width, height) / 10;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(width / 2, u);
      g.lineTo(width / 2 + 2 * u, 4 * u);
      g.lineTo(width / 2 - 2 * u, 4 * u);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();
      g.fillRect(width / 2 - u / 2, 4 * u, u, 4 * u);
      if (grain) {
        const tile = document.createElement("canvas");
        tile.width = 256;
        tile.height = 256;
        const t = tile.getContext("2d")!;
        const noise = t.createImageData(256, 256);
        let seed = 7;
        for (let i = 0; i < noise.data.length; i += 4) {
          seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0;
          const v = seed >>> 24;
          noise.data[i] = noise.data[i + 1] = noise.data[i + 2] = v;
          noise.data[i + 3] = 24;
        }
        t.putImageData(noise, 0, 0);
        g.fillStyle = g.createPattern(tile, "repeat")!;
        g.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      }
      const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => canvas.toBlob((b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error("the canvas gave no JPEG"))), "image/jpeg", 0.92));
      return new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result));
        reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error);
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
    },
    { width, height, grain: opts.grain ?? false },
  );
  return { bytes: Buffer.from(dataUrl.slice(dataUrl.indexOf(",") + 1), "base64"), width, height };
}

const EXIF_ID = Buffer.from("Exif\0\0", "latin1");

/**
 * A phone's EXIF block (an APP1 segment), made up: the GPS position 1°2'3" N, 4°5'6" E (at sea) and, when given, the orientation tag (6: the
 * phone was held sideways). A big-endian TIFF: IFD0 (the orientation, the pointer to the GPS IFD), the GPS IFD (version, latitude, longitude),
 * then the six rationals; every offset counts from the TIFF header.
 */
function exifSegment(opts: { orientation?: number }): Buffer {
  const u16 = (n: number) => {
    const b = Buffer.alloc(2);
    b.writeUInt16BE(n);
    return b;
  };
  const u32 = (n: number) => {
    const b = Buffer.alloc(4);
    b.writeUInt32BE(n);
    return b;
  };
  /** One 12-byte entry; `value` is the value itself when it fits in 4 bytes (left-aligned), else the offset of the value. */
  const entry = (tag: number, type: number, count: number, value: Buffer) => Buffer.concat([u16(tag), u16(type), u32(count), Buffer.concat([value, Buffer.alloc(4)]).subarray(0, 4)]);
  const ifd = (entries: Buffer[]) => Buffer.concat([u16(entries.length), ...entries, u32(0)]); // (no next IFD)
  const [BYTE, ASCII, SHORT, LONG, RATIONAL] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
  const ifd0Entries = opts.orientation ? 2 : 1;
  const gpsAt = 8 + 2 + ifd0Entries * 12 + 4;
  const latitudeAt = gpsAt + 2 + 5 * 12 + 4;
  const longitudeAt = latitudeAt + 24;
  const rationals = (values: number[]) => Buffer.concat(values.flatMap((v) => [u32(v), u32(1)]));
  const tiff = Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from([0x4d, 0x4d, 0x00, 0x2a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x08]), // "MM", 42, IFD0 at 8
    ifd([...(opts.orientation ? [entry(0x0112, SHORT, 1, u16(opts.orientation))] : []), entry(0x8825, LONG, 1, u32(gpsAt))]),
    ifd([
      entry(0x0000, BYTE, 4, Buffer.from([2, 2, 0, 0])),
      entry(0x0001, ASCII, 2, Buffer.from("N\0", "latin1")),
      entry(0x0002, RATIONAL, 3, u32(latitudeAt)),
      entry(0x0003, ASCII, 2, Buffer.from("E\0", "latin1")),
      entry(0x0004, RATIONAL, 3, u32(longitudeAt)),
    ]),
    rationals([1, 2, 3]),
    rationals([4, 5, 6]),
  ]);
  const payload = Buffer.concat([EXIF_ID, tiff]);
  return Buffer.concat([u16(0xffe1), u16(payload.length + 2), payload]);
}

/** `jpeg` with a made-up EXIF block (GPS, and `orientation` when given) after its JFIF segment, as a camera's "JFIF + Exif" file has it. */
export function withExif(jpeg: Buffer, opts: { orientation?: number } = {}): Buffer {
  if (jpeg[0] !== 0xff || jpeg[1] !== 0xd8) throw new Error("not a JPEG");
  const at = jpeg[2] === 0xff && jpeg[3] === 0xe0 ? 4 + jpeg.readUInt16BE(4) : 2;
  return Buffer.concat([jpeg.subarray(0, at), exifSegment(opts), jpeg.subarray(at)]);
}

/** Does the JPEG carry an EXIF block? Its segments are walked up to the picture's data (SOS), where no metadata comes any more. */
export function hasExif(jpeg: Buffer): boolean {
  let i = 2;
  while (i + 4 <= jpeg.length && jpeg[i] === 0xff) {
    const marker = jpeg[i + 1];
    if (marker === 0xda || marker === 0xd9) return false;
    if (marker === 0xe1 && jpeg.subarray(i + 4, i + 10).equals(EXIF_ID)) return true;
    i += 2 + jpeg.readUInt16BE(i + 2);
  }
  return false;
}

/** The picture's size as `page`'s browser decodes it. */
export async function jpegSize(page: Page, jpeg: Buffer): Promise<{ width: number; height: number }> {
  return page.evaluate(async (base64) => {
    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(base64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(new Blob([bytes], { type: "image/jpeg" }));
    const size = { width: bitmap.width, height: bitmap.height };
    bitmap.close();
    return size;
  }, jpeg.toString("base64"));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The flows** — create `tests/e2e/completion.spec.ts`:

```ts
import type { Locator, Page, TestInfo } from "@playwright/test";
import { PHOTO_LIMITS } from "../../src/domain/completion";
import { clientEmail, signInAsClient, takeTerms } from "./account";
import { adminReady, signInAsAdmin, type CreatedRows } from "./admin-login";
import {
  canvasJpeg, E2E_OPEN, E2E_POINTS, E2E_QUESTIONS, hasExif, insertAttempts, insertCompletionCourse, insertContactRegistration, insertPractical, jpegSize, localFile,
  storedAccessRow, storedAttempts, storedPhotos, storedProtocolOf, withExif, type CompletionCourse,
} from "./completion";
import { LOCK_WAIT_MS, removeAdminRows, removeClientRows } from "./fixtures";
import { general, note, runName, saved, storedProtocol, studentPage } from "./protocols";
import { smallTargets } from "./targets";
import { expect, submitsForms, test } from "./test";

// E-course completion (spec §9 "End to end"): the lessons done and the test (a fail, "Proovi uuesti", a pass); the practical work's photos from a
// phone (Review Focus 1: 6000×4000 with GPS, sideways, a lost upload, a HEIC) and "Saada hindamiseks"; Maria's "Hindamine", her verdicts and
// "Saada hinnang"; the "Paranda" point redone and approved, "Lõpetatud" on the page, the course page and the card; the open answers reviewed,
// rewritten and accepted; "Ava test uuesti"; "Lisa protokoll" from the student's drawer; and the pages at 390, 834, 1194 and 1440 px. Every
// student is a sample address (`e2e-client-compl-…@example.test`, never mailed) on an e-course of the test's own; all of it is removed after each
// test. Under `next dev` and the production build (E2E_PROD_BUILD=1); Maria signs in as Dim (admin-login.ts). The locks on real Postgres are
// completion-race.spec.ts.

const made = new Set<string>();
const created: CreatedRows = { tokens: new Set(), sessions: new Set() };
let restoreTerms: (() => Promise<void>) | null = null;

test.beforeEach(async ({}, info) => {
  submitsForms();
  // the first view of each page under `next dev` compiles it; the wait for the shared course terms (another test may hold them) is this test's too
  info.setTimeout(180_000 + LOCK_WAIT_MS);
  restoreTerms = await takeTerms();
});

test.afterEach(async () => {
  try {
    for (const email of made) await removeClientRows(email);
    made.clear();
    await removeAdminRows(created).catch(() => {});
    created.tokens.clear();
    created.sessions.clear();
  } finally {
    await restoreTerms?.();
    restoreTerms = null;
  }
});

type Student = CompletionCourse & { email: string };

/** A student of an e-course of her own (completion.ts insertCompletionCourse); her rows go after the test. */
async function student(label: string, info: TestInfo, opts: Parameters<typeof insertCompletionCourse>[1] = {}): Promise<Student> {
  const email = clientEmail(`compl-${label}`, runName(info));
  made.add(email);
  await removeClientRows(email);
  return { email, ...(await insertCompletionCourse(email, opts)) };
}

const coursePage = (s: Student) => `/konto/kursus/${s.slug}`;
const testPage = (s: Student) => `/konto/kursus/${s.slug}/test`;
const practicalPage = (s: Student) => `/konto/kursus/${s.slug}/praktiline`;
/** A step of the e-course page's "Lõpetamine" in `state` (the state on the step's own element, or on one inside it). */
const step = (page: Page, name: string, state: string) =>
  page.locator(`[data-completion] [data-step="${name}"][data-step-state="${state}"], [data-completion] [data-step="${name}"] [data-step-state="${state}"]`).first();
const testState = (page: Page) => page.locator("[data-test-state]").first();
const practicalStatus = (page: Page) => page.locator("[data-practical-status]").first();
const point = (page: Page, i: number) => page.locator(`[data-point="${i}"]`);
const fileInput = (page: Page, i: number) => point(page, i).locator('[data-photo-add] input[type="file"]').first();
/** A point's stored photos (not one on its way). */
const storedOn = (page: Page, i: number) => point(page, i).locator("[data-photo]:not([data-photo-pending])");
const assessPoint = (page: Page, i: number) => page.locator(`[data-assess-point="${i}"]`);
const noOverflow = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth);

/** A confirming step's "yes": the marked element itself when it is a button, else the step's first button (the "yes" comes first on every step). */
async function confirmStep(marked: Locator): Promise<void> {
  const target = marked.first();
  await expect(target).toBeVisible();
  const own = await target.evaluate((el) => el instanceof HTMLButtonElement);
  await (own ? target : target.locator("button").first()).click();
}

/** On the test page: the options picked (question id → option ids) and the open answers written (question id → text). */
async function answer(page: Page, picks: Record<string, string[]>, texts: Record<string, string> = {}): Promise<void> {
  for (const [question, options] of Object.entries(picks)) for (const option of options) await page.locator(`[data-question="${question}"] [data-answer-option="${option}"]`).check();
  for (const [question, text] of Object.entries(texts)) await page.locator(`[data-question="${question}"] [data-answer-open]`).fill(text);
}

/** "Esita test" / "Saada uuesti", and its inline confirmation's yes when the page asks for one (the first submit always does: spec §4.2). */
async function submitTest(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.locator("[data-test-submit]").click();
  const yes = page.locator('[data-test-page] [data-confirm="yes"]').first();
  if (await yes.waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout: 3_000 }).then(() => true, () => false)) await yes.click();
}

/** "Saada hindamiseks" / "Saada uuesti" and its confirmation (spec §4.3). */
async function sendPractical(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.locator("[data-practical-submit]").click();
  await confirmStep(page.locator("[data-practical-confirm]"));
}

/** "Saada hinnang" and its one confirmation (spec §5.3): the screen says it was sent. */
async function sendAssessment(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.locator("[data-assess-send]").click();
  await confirmStep(page.locator("[data-assess-confirm]"));
  await expect(page.locator("[data-assess-sent]").first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
}

/** Maria on "Hindamine", from where the access's item in `group` opens. */
async function hindamine(page: Page, group: "practicals" | "tests" | "tries", accessId: number): Promise<Locator> {
  await page.goto("/admin/hindamine");
  await adminReady(page);
  return page.locator(`[data-queue="${group}"] [data-queue-item="${accessId}"]`);
}

test("§9 e2e 1: the lessons done, the test opens; a fail with its score and its wrong numbers, 'Proovi uuesti', a pass; the answer key never reaches her", async ({ page }, info) => {
  const s = await student("t1", info, { questions: E2E_QUESTIONS, points: [] });
  await signInAsClient(page, s.email);
  await page.goto(coursePage(s));
  await expect(step(page, "test", "locked")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-completion] [data-step="practical"]')).toHaveCount(0); // a course without points has no practical work
  // the only lesson, "Märgi tehtuks": the test opens
  await page.goto(`${coursePage(s)}/${s.lessonId}`);
  await page.locator("[data-mark-done]").click();
  await expect(page.locator("[data-lesson-done]")).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(coursePage(s));
  await expect(step(page, "test", "open")).toBeVisible();
  await page.locator('[data-completion] [data-step="test"] [data-step-link]').first().click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/konto/kursus/${s.slug}/test$`));
  await expect(testState(page)).toHaveAttribute("data-test-state", "none");
  // the first try: the second answer wrong — 50 %, under 80 %; the step names the try
  await answer(page, { q1: ["a"], q2: ["b"] });
  await page.locator("[data-test-submit]").click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Katse 1\/3/).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.locator('[data-test-page] [data-confirm="yes"]').first().click();
  await expect(testState(page)).toHaveAttribute("data-test-state", "open");
  await expect(page.locator("[data-test-result]").first()).toContainText(/Said 50\s%, vaja 80\s%/);
  await expect(page.locator("[data-test-wrong]").first()).toContainText("2");
  await expect(page.locator("[data-test-retry]")).toContainText(/2 katset jäänud/);
  // what her page reads has no answer key, before or after a try (Global Constraints: the key never leaves the server for the student)
  const read = await page.request.get(`/api/konto/kursus/${s.slug}/test`);
  expect(read.status()).toBe(200);
  expect(await read.text()).not.toContain('"correct"');
  // "Proovi uuesti": both right — passed
  await page.locator("[data-test-retry]").click();
  await answer(page, { q1: ["a"], q2: ["a"] });
  await submitTest(page);
  await expect(testState(page)).toHaveAttribute("data-test-state", "passed");
  await expect(page.getByText("Test on sooritatud").first()).toBeVisible();
  expect((await storedAttempts(s.clientId)).map((a) => [a.number, a.status, a.correct, a.total])).toEqual([
    [1, "failed", 1, 2],
    [2, "passed", 2, 2],
  ]);
  // no points: the pass completed the course (spec §4.4)
  await page.goto(coursePage(s));
  await expect(step(page, "test", "done")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(step(page, "done", "done")).toBeVisible();
  expect((await storedAccessRow(s.accessId)).completedAt).not.toBeNull();
});

test("§9 e2e 2 — Review Focus 1: a 6000×4000 phone photo with GPS goes up under 2 MB and is stored without EXIF; a sideways one stands upright; a lost upload's 'Proovi uuesti'; a HEIC is refused; 'Saada hindamiseks'", async ({ page }, info) => {
  const s = await student("t2", info, { points: E2E_POINTS, lessonsDone: true });
  await signInAsClient(page, s.email);
  await page.goto(practicalPage(s));
  await expect(practicalStatus(page)).toHaveAttribute("data-practical-status", "open");
  // the fixtures, drawn in this browser, with a made-up EXIF block: GPS at sea; and one held sideways (orientation 6)
  const big = withExif((await canvasJpeg(page, 6000, 4000, { grain: true })).bytes);
  const sideways = withExif((await canvasJpeg(page, 600, 400)).bytes, { orientation: 6 });
  expect([hasExif(big), hasExif(sideways)]).toEqual([true, true]);
  test.info().annotations.push({ type: "fixture", description: `6000×4000 with GPS: ${big.length} bytes` });

  // 1. point 1: the big photo, its first upload lost on the way (a weak signal); only that photo offers "Proovi uuesti"
  let posts = 0;
  await page.route(`**/api/konto/kursus/${s.slug}/praktiline/foto`, (route) =>
    route.request().method() === "POST" && posts++ === 0 ? route.abort("connectionreset") : route.fallback(),
  );
  await fileInput(page, 0).setInputFiles({ name: "IMG_6000.jpg", mimeType: "image/jpeg", buffer: big });
  await expect(point(page, 0).locator("[data-photo-retry]")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 });
  await point(page, 0).locator("[data-photo-retry]").click();
  await expect(storedOn(page, 0)).toHaveCount(1, { timeout: 60_000 });
  // 2. point 2: a HEIC this browser cannot open is refused in words; then the sideways photo
  await fileInput(page, 1).setInputFiles({ name: "IMG_0002.HEIC", mimeType: "image/heic", buffer: Buffer.from("\0\0\0\u0018ftypheic\0\0\0\0", "latin1") });
  await expect(page.getByText("Seda pilti ei saa avada. Vali JPG või PNG pilt.").first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(storedOn(page, 1)).toHaveCount(0);
  await fileInput(page, 1).setInputFiles({ name: "IMG_0003.jpg", mimeType: "image/jpeg", buffer: sideways });
  await expect(storedOn(page, 1)).toHaveCount(1, { timeout: 60_000 });

  // 3. what the server keeps: JPEGs without EXIF (no GPS), the full one at most 2 MB and 2048 px, upright, and their thumbnails
  const protocol = (await storedProtocolOf(s.accessId))!;
  const photos = await storedPhotos(protocol.id);
  expect(photos.map((p) => [p.stage, p.round])).toEqual([
    [0, 1],
    [1, 1],
  ]);
  for (const p of photos) {
    const full = localFile(p.key);
    const thumb = localFile(p.thumbKey);
    expect([...full.subarray(0, 3)], p.key).toEqual([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff]);
    expect(hasExif(full), `${p.key} has no EXIF`).toBe(false);
    expect(hasExif(thumb), `${p.thumbKey} has no EXIF`).toBe(false);
    expect(full.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(PHOTO_LIMITS.fullBytes);
    expect(thumb.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(PHOTO_LIMITS.thumbBytes);
    expect(p.size).toBe(full.length);
    expect(await jpegSize(page, full)).toEqual({ width: p.width, height: p.height });
    const t = await jpegSize(page, thumb);
    expect(Math.max(t.width, t.height)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(PHOTO_LIMITS.thumbEdge);
  }
  const [taken, turned] = photos;
  // 2048 px on the long side (1600 when the encoder had to try again: R6), the 3:2 shape kept
  expect([PHOTO_LIMITS.maxEdge, 1600]).toContain(Math.max(taken.width, taken.height));
  expect(Math.abs(taken.height - Math.round((taken.width * 4000) / 6000))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
  expect([turned.width, turned.height]).toEqual([400, 600]); // turned upright by its orientation tag before the metadata went

  // 4. "Saada hindamiseks": the page locks, waiting for Maria
  await sendPractical(page);
  await expect(practicalStatus(page)).toHaveAttribute("data-practical-status", "review");
  expect(await storedProtocolOf(s.accessId)).toMatchObject({ round: 1, sentRound: null });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Two at once** — create `tests/e2e/completion-race.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdtempSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import type { TestInfo } from "@playwright/test";
import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/postgres-js";
import postgres from "postgres";
import type { Db } from "../../src/db/client";
import * as schema from "../../src/db/schema";
import type { FileStore } from "../../src/server/media";
import { localStore } from "../../src/server/media-local";
import { addPhoto, submitPractical, type PhotoInput, type PracticalDeps } from "../../src/server/practical";
import { submitAttempt } from "../../src/server/test-attempts";
import { clientEmail } from "./account";
import { E2E_POINTS, E2E_QUESTIONS, insertCompletionCourse, storedAttempts, storedPhotos, storedProtocolOf, type CompletionCourse } from "./completion";
import { localDatabaseUrl, onLocalDb, removeClientRows } from "./fixtures";
import { runName } from "./protocols";
import { expect, submitsForms, test } from "./test";

// Spec §9 "Real Postgres" and Review Focus 2 (two devices, or a double tap): what the unit tests' single-connection PGlite cannot show. The
// app's own submitPractical, addPhoto and submitAttempt, in this process, on a pool of the local Postgres, with a store in a temporary folder:
// - two "Saada hindamiseks" at the same moment give one round and one notice to Maria; the other finds it sent;
// - the 3rd and a 4th photo of one point at the same moment give three photos: the cap is counted under the access lock, and the refused
//   photo's objects, stored first, are removed;
// - the lock order, by a test that never misses: another connection holds her access row, and a submit waits for it with her protocol's row
//   still free (access, then protocol: a submit that took the protocol first would hold it while it waited);
// - two submits of the same test answers at the same moment give one attempt: one try (the second is the same submission, Task 5).
// No browser: the desktop project runs these once.

test.skip(({ isMobile }) => isMobile, "no browser in these tests: the desktop project runs them once");

const made = new Set<string>();
/** The name this process's pool connects under, so the test finds its own backends in pg_stat_activity and no one else's. */
const APPLICATION = `mslab-e2e-completion-race-${process.pid}`;
let pool: postgres.Sql | null = null;
let db: Db;
let dir = "";
let store: FileStore;

test.beforeAll(() => {
  pool = postgres(localDatabaseUrl(), { max: 6, connect_timeout: 20, onnotice: () => {}, connection: { application_name: APPLICATION } });
  db = drizzle(pool, { schema }) as unknown as Db;
});
test.afterAll(async () => {
  await pool?.end();
});
test.beforeEach(() => {
  submitsForms();
  test.setTimeout(60_000);
  dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "mslab-e2e-practical-"));
  store = localStore(dir);
});
test.afterEach(async () => {
  for (const email of made) await removeClientRows(email);
  made.clear();
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const pause = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

type Waiting = { query: string; wait_event: string | null };
/**
 * This pool's backends that wait for a lock (pg_stat_activity by its application_name), asked again every 50 ms until there are `n` of them, or
 * `gone()` says the work it waits for is over, or `ms` have passed: a test proves the wait instead of sleeping and hoping.
 */
async function lockWaits(n: number, gone: () => boolean, ms = 15_000): Promise<Waiting[]> {
  const until = Date.now() + ms;
  for (;;) {
    const waiting = await onLocalDb(
      (other) => other<Waiting[]>`select query, wait_event from pg_stat_activity where application_name = ${APPLICATION} and wait_event_type = 'Lock'`,
      { marksPages: false },
    );
    if (waiting.length >= n || gone() || Date.now() > until) return waiting;
    await pause(50);
  }
}

type Job = () => Promise<unknown>;
/** The dependencies of the practical work's and the test's calls; their mails and notices are collected, never run: nothing is mailed. */
function deps(jobs: Job[]): PracticalDeps {
  const site = "http://localhost:3000";
  return {
    db,
    env: { KV: { get: async () => null, put: async () => {} }, MAIL_FROM: "MS LAB <info@send.example>", MARIA_EMAIL: "maria@example.test", SITE_URL: site },
    siteUrl: site,
    now: new Date(),
    later: (task) => void jobs.push(task),
    files: store,
  };
}

/** A file as the server checks a JPEG (its signature FF D8 FF and its size; the server decodes nothing), `bytes` long. */
function jpegFile(bytes: number, name: string): File {
  const b = new Uint8Array(bytes);
  b.set([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0]);
  b.set([0xff, 0xd9], bytes - 2);
  return new File([b], name, { type: "image/jpeg" });
}
const photo = (stage: number): PhotoInput => ({ stage, full: jpegFile(4096, "foto.jpg"), thumb: jpegFile(1024, "foto-t.jpg"), width: 2048, height: 1365 });
/** The full photos and thumbnails in this test's store. */
const storedJpegs = () => readdirSync(join(dir, "practical")).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".jpg"));

/** A student of an e-course of her own (E2E_POINTS, the lesson done, no test unless `questions`): her practical work is open. */
async function course(label: string, info: TestInfo, opts: Parameters<typeof insertCompletionCourse>[1] = { points: E2E_POINTS, lessonsDone: true }): Promise<CompletionCourse> {
  const email = clientEmail(`race-${label}`, runName(info));
  made.add(email);
  await removeClientRows(email);
  return insertCompletionCourse(email, opts);
}

/** …with a photo on each point: ready to send. */
async function ready(label: string, info: TestInfo): Promise<CompletionCourse> {
  const s = await course(label, info);
  for (const stage of [0, 1]) expect(await addPhoto(deps([]), s.clientId, s.slug, photo(stage))).toMatchObject({ kind: "added" });
  return s;
}

test("Review Focus 2: two 'Saada hindamiseks' at the same moment — one round, one notice to Maria; the other finds it sent", async ({}, info) => {
  const s = await ready("send", info);
  const jobs: Job[] = [];
  const results = await Promise.all([submitPractical(deps(jobs), s.clientId, s.slug), submitPractical(deps(jobs), s.clientId, s.slug)]);
  expect(results.map((r) => r.kind).sort()).toEqual(["already", "submitted"]);
  expect(jobs, "the notices queued: one").toHaveLength(1);
  expect(await storedProtocolOf(s.accessId)).toMatchObject({ round: 1 });
});

test("Review Focus 2: the 3rd and a 4th photo of one point at the same moment — three photos; the 4th refused as full, its stored objects removed", async ({}, info) => {
  const s = await course("cap", info);
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) expect(await addPhoto(deps([]), s.clientId, s.slug, photo(0))).toMatchObject({ kind: "added" });
  const results = await Promise.all([addPhoto(deps([]), s.clientId, s.slug, photo(0)), addPhoto(deps([]), s.clientId, s.slug, photo(0))]);
  expect(results.map((r) => r.kind).sort()).toEqual(["added", "full"]);
  const protocol = (await storedProtocolOf(s.accessId))!;
  expect((await storedPhotos(protocol.id)).filter((p) => p.stage === 0)).toHaveLength(3);
  expect(storedJpegs(), "three photos, a full one and a thumbnail each").toHaveLength(6);
});

test("the lock order: a submit waits while another transaction holds her access row, with her protocol's row still free; let go, it goes on", async ({}, info) => {
  const s = await ready("order", info);
  const protocol = (await storedProtocolOf(s.accessId))!;
  const jobs: Job[] = [];
  let sending!: ReturnType<typeof submitPractical>;
  let finished = false;
  await onLocalDb(
    (sql) =>
      sql.begin(async (tx) => {
        await tx`select 1 from course_access where id = ${s.accessId} for update`;
        sending = submitPractical(deps(jobs), s.clientId, s.slug);
        void sending.then(
          () => (finished = true),
          () => (finished = true),
        );
        const waiting = await lockWaits(1, () => finished);
        expect(finished, "the submit went past the access row's lock while it was held").toBe(false);
        expect(waiting, "this pool's backends that wait for a lock: the submit's").toHaveLength(1);
        expect(waiting[0].query, "what the submit waits at (server/completion.ts lockAccess)").toMatch(/from "?course_access"?[\s\S]*\bfor update\b/i);
        // the submit holds nothing of the protocol yet: another connection locks its row at once (NOWAIT fails otherwise, 55P03)
        await onLocalDb((other) => other.begin((t) => t`select 1 from protocols where id = ${protocol.id} for update nowait`), { marksPages: false });
      }),
    { marksPages: false },
  );
  expect(await sending).toMatchObject({ kind: "submitted" });
  expect(jobs).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(await storedProtocolOf(s.accessId)).toMatchObject({ round: 1 });
});

test("Review Focus 2: two submits of the same test answers at the same moment — one attempt, one try", async ({}, info) => {
  const s = await course("test", info, { questions: E2E_QUESTIONS, points: [], lessonsDone: true });
  const answers = { q1: ["a"], q2: ["b"] }; // one wrong: the test stays open for another try, so only the repeat rule keeps it at one
  const results = await Promise.all([submitAttempt(deps([]), s.clientId, s.slug, answers), submitAttempt(deps([]), s.clientId, s.slug, answers)]);
  expect(results.map((r) => r.kind)).toEqual(["submitted", "submitted"]);
  expect((await storedAttempts(s.clientId)).map((a) => [a.number, a.status])).toEqual([[1, "failed"]]);
});
```

```markdown
## 13. E-course completion: the knowledge test, the practical work, "Lõpetatud"

An e-course ends on the platform: the lessons, Maria's knowledge test, the practical work with photos that Maria assesses, then "Lõpetatud" (spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-ecourse-completion-design.md`, plan `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-13-ecourse-completion.md`).

1. **What runs where.**
   - **The student's pages:** the static shells `/konto/kursus/<slug>/test` and `/konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline` (`/ru/…` in Russian), and the "Lõpetamine" block on `/konto/kursus/<slug>`. Their data is `GET|POST /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/test`, `POST …/test/uuesti`, `GET /api/konto/kursus/<slug>/praktiline`, `POST …/praktiline/foto` (multipart), `DELETE …/praktiline/foto/<id>` and `POST …/praktiline/saada`. A photo is `GET /api/konto/praktiline/foto/<id>` (`…/pisi` the thumbnail): a 302 to a 5-minute signed R2 address, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`. All are `private, no-store` and behind the coming-soon gate until the launch, like every account route.
   - **Maria's pages:**
     - "Hindamine" (`/admin/hindamine`, after "Registreerimised", its badge the number waiting; the overview's "Ootab hindamist" card);
     - the test review (`/admin/hindamine/test?id=<attempt>`; `?ligipaas=<access>` lists a student's attempts);
     - the practical assessment, which is the protocol screen at `/admin/protokollid?ligipaas=<access>`.
   - **Maria's endpoints:** its notes autosave through `POST /api/admin/protokoll` (the body names `accessId`), each verdict tap through `POST /api/admin/hinnang`, and the photos through `GET /api/admin/foto/<id>` (`?v=pisi`). "Saada hinnang", the review's "Saada" and "Ava test uuesti" are server actions (`src/server/actions/admin-assessment.ts`).
   - **Configuration:** no new variable, no cron.
2. **The data.** Migration `0008_ecourse_completion` is additive. It runs on Railway before the deploy (section 6), and the live code does not name what it adds; its one loosening, `protocols.registration_id` becoming nullable, is harmless to code that always writes it.
   - `course_tests`: one row per course, holding the questions with the answer key, the pass mark and the tries. It is kept apart from `courses`, whose rows the public pages read. A course without a row has no test.
   - `course_access.extra_tries` ("Ava test uuesti" adds the course's tries) and `course_access.completed_at` (set once, never cleared; phase 3d reads it).
   - `test_attempts`: one row per submitted try, each with the frozen copy of the questions it answered.
   - `protocols.access_id`: a protocol belongs to a registration or to an e-course access, exactly one (`protocols_one_owner`). Also `verdicts`, `round`, `submitted_at` and `sent_round`.
   - `practical_photos`: one row per photo, with private R2 keys `practical/<uuid>.jpg` and `practical/<uuid>-t.jpg`; earlier rounds are kept.
   - The drop of `courses.modules` is migration 0009 (code first, then the migration, as planned in phase 3a).
3. **The rules.**
   - **The test:**
     - The test opens when every visible lesson is done. The practical work opens when the test is passed, or at once when the course has no questions. A step once passed stays passed, and `completed_at` is set once.
     - A try is a submitted attempt. Rewriting the answers Maria marked "Paranda" uses none. A submit made from questions Maria changed meanwhile is refused and writes nothing.
     - The student never sees the answer key: only the score and the numbers of the wrong questions.
   - **The practical work:**
     - The first round needs a photo on every point; later rounds only on the "Paranda" points. There are at most 3 photos per point and round.
     - "Saada hindamiseks" raises the round and resets the "Paranda" verdicts for Maria's next look.
     - "Saada hinnang" needs every point marked and a note under every "Paranda". It freezes the notes and the verdicts into `sent`, which is all the student is ever shown. When every point is approved, the course is completed. After that the verdicts are locked, and a change of the notes is sent as "uuendatud".
   - **Lock order:** every write about one access takes the `course_access` row (`FOR UPDATE`) first, then its protocol, then the attempts or the photos. Two devices or a double tap therefore make one try, one round and never a fourth photo (`tests/e2e/completion-race.spec.ts`). The account's deletion deletes the client, which cascades to all of these, and removes the photos from R2 after its commit.
4. **The photos.**
   - **In the browser:** the student's browser shrinks each photo before it is sent: JPEG, at most 2048 px, about 0.5–1 MB, plus a 480 px thumbnail. The re-encode drops all metadata, including the GPS position, and keeps a portrait photo upright.
   - **On the server:** it takes only a JPEG (the bytes are checked) of at most 2 MB, with a thumbnail of at most 200 KB. A request over the sum plus 64 KiB is refused before it is read (Vercel refuses bodies over 4.5 MB itself).
   - **Rate limits:** at most 120 photo uploads and 20 sends an hour per student; 10 test submits an hour.
   - **Storage:** R2 holds the photos privately, never served by `/media`. A photo that cannot be stored answers 503 "storage", and the student's page offers "Proovi uuesti".
5. **The mails.** All go after the commit, never undo what was saved, carry links only (never answers, notes or photos), and skip sample addresses.
   - **To the student, in her language:** "Sinu praktiline töö on hinnatud" (with "Paranda" points), "Palju õnne! Koolitus „…“ on lõpetatud", "Test on sooritatud", "Vaata üle oma testi vastused", "Test on sinu jaoks uuesti avatud", and the protocol mails for an e-course without points.
   - **To Maria, by mail and Telegram:** "Praktiline töö hindamiseks: {nimi}, {kursus}" ("(2. kord)" on a later round), "Test ootab hindamist: …", "Testi katsed otsas: …". They are sent for a sample student too, as her live check needs.
   - **Reply-To:** every mail without its own Reply-To has `MARIA_EMAIL`, so a student's reply reaches Maria. The exception is a mail to Maria herself; her notices reply to the student.
6. **The logs.** `[test] attempt N: submitted (failed|review|passed)`, `[test] attempt N: reviewed (passed|fix)`, `[test] access N: reopened`, `[practical] access N: photo added` / `submitted (round R)`, `[practical] access N: Maria notified by e-mail: …, Telegram: …`, `[practical] client N: a photo could not be removed: <error class>`, `[assessment] access N: sent (fix|passed|notes)`, `[completion] access N: completed`, `[completion] access N: the mail sent` (or `was not sent`). Never an answer, a note, a name, an address or an R2 key.
7. **Rollback.** A rollback of the code past this phase leaves 0008's additions in place, and the older code ignores them. It has no test or practical pages: a mail's link lands on a 404 until the code is back.
   - **Account deletion:** the older code does not remove the R2 photos. They are deleted with the database rows, but their objects stay in the bucket. Delete them by hand afterwards: the keys are under `practical/` and no longer named by any `practical_photos` row.
   - **The test:** the older course editor does not show "Teadmiste test", and saving a course there leaves `course_tests` as it was.
```

| 1 | §3.1 the test in columns on `courses` | Whole `courses` rows are read by the public queries (`db/queries/public.ts`) and passed to server components | **R1:** the table `course_tests` (course_id primary key); without a row the course has no test (defaults 80 / 3) (Tasks 1, 3, 4). |

| 3 | §5.3 the resubmission "raises `version`" so Maria's open screen reloads | The notes are unchanged by a resubmission; a version bump would open a false conflict notice | **R3:** the resubmission resets the fix verdicts and raises `round`; Maria's screen takes the new photos and verdicts on its next read (Tasks 7, 10, 11). |

### For the owner (Dim, and Maria where named)

1. **The Draft texts** of the Wording appendix (Dim), and the Russian native-speaker check of every new key.
2. **The correct answers are never shown** to the student, only the score and the numbers of the wrong questions (spec §4.2), so retries stay meaningful.
3. **"Ava test uuesti" gives the course's full number of tries again.**
4. **A verdict tap is saved at once, and the last tap wins** across two devices (R2). The notes keep the protocol screen's version check and conflict notice.
5. **Submitting the very same answers again after a fail** is taken as a double tap: no new try, the same result (U9).
6. **Photos of earlier rounds are kept** until the account is deleted (spec §3.5), so Maria can compare.
7. **A video lesson without a playable video** keeps the lessons step open (the existing lesson rule), so such a course cannot complete until its video is ready.
8. **Every mail without its own Reply-To now replies to Maria's inbox**, including the existing mails: login codes and payment confirmations (D8).
9. **The live check** (Task 16) creates a temporary unpublished sample e-course and one sample student, sends Maria three notices, and removes both afterwards by their exact slug and address.
